text: Beautifully situated bistro at the Djurgården Bridge with on-the-water service. The popular, well-stocked bar focuses on rosé wines and champagne. Strandbryggan serves shellfish, fish, salads, and regular fare in a setting that is a little more elegant than average. They also have boats for rent.

title: Strandvägen 1
label: Restaurant
text: Strandvägen 1 is an international all day-bistro located in the upscale neighborhood of Östermalm. Just next door to the Royal Dramatic Theatre and with a lovely view overlooking the docks at Nybrokajen, the restaurant and bar is a popular hangout on a warm summer day.

title: Sturehof
label: Restaurant
text: Classic brasserie and social stage at Stureplan in the center of Stockholm’s entertainment precinct. Swedish cuisine with international influences. Several bars. In summer the alfresco section is the place to see and be seen.

title: Surfers
label: Restaurant
text: Colorful, spicy, and good-natured – that’s the vibe at Surfers. It may be surprising from the name, but Surfers is home to an excellent Chinese restaurant. Inspired by the 23 flavors of Sichuan cuisine and 56 cooking methods, the menu is based on some fifteen small plates, and you get to choose which favorites to share with your friends. The gorgeous drinks feature Asian flavors and are worth the visit themselves. A sister restaurant is located in Visby on Gotland.

title: Humlan
label: Bar
text: Humlan is a summer bar and restaurant located on the corner of Humlegården Park, near Stureplan. The menu features a variety of Italian bread dishes and refreshing drinks. This version of Humlan is run by Oliver Ingrosso, who usually operates the restaurant Olli.

title: Sushi Sho
label: Restaurant
text: At first glance Sushi Sho looks like an ordinary sushi place, but it is, in fact, a Michelin starred restaurant. Here, high-quality sushi is served Tokyo-style, and the fish is selected with regard to sustainability and the environment. All guests are served a menu consisting of about 15 dishes - prepared and served from the open kitchen.

contact_text.text: Sushi Sho received its first Michelin-star in 2016.

title: Svartengrens
label: Restaurant
text: At Svartengrens they love meat, but they're not in love with the meat industry. That's why you'll only get served locally produced cuts from the Stockholm archipelago that have been smoked, brined, and hung by Svartengren's team of chefs. Served with a side of seasonal vegetables, of course. The menu changes often, some dishes even daily. The restaurant is located in a former pharmacy and the bar is also worth a visit, with its hand-cut ice and unusual cocktails.

title: Tak
label: Restaurant
text: Tak ("roof" in Swedish) is located, quite literally, in the heart of the city just a short walk from Sergels Torg. It's a restaurant, a raw bar, and a rooftop bar all rolled up into one. The menu mixes Japanese techniques and Swedish ingredients with a breathtaking view of central Stockholm.

title: Tako
label: Restaurant
text: Elegant Japanese and Korean-cuisine that brings out the best flavors of Asia on to one plate. Spacious Tako on Östermalm in Stockholm has both a sushi bar and kitchen and an Asian grill serving spicy tempura and skewers.

title: Teatergrillen
label: Restaurant
text: Teatergrillen is a playground for Stockholm’s media and cultural celebrities. You’ll dine well here in a traditional setting. The interior is largely unchanged since 1968, making this one of Sweden’s best-preserved restaurants. Red velvet and theater props dominate the decor, thanks to the nearby Dramaten theater.

title: Teatern
label: Restaurant
text: Teatern at Ringen Centrum near Skanstull combines the concepts of fine cuisine and popular food-court dining. Some of Sweden’s best-known restaurateurs share the 250 seats in the dining area – such as Adam Dahlberg & Albin Wessman, Sayan Isaksson, and Nobel pastry chef Daniel Roos. At Teatern, you can taste world-class sausages, vegan burgers, enjoy small plates from all over the world, or enjoy dishes inspired by Asian street food. Quick and unpretentious, at a price that will suit just about everyone. Teatern has quickly gained popularity and it can be packed at lunchtime.

title: Tegelbacken
label: Restaurant
text: Markus Aujalay's and Erika Michael's bright and welcoming Tegelbacken wants you to try everything. Fresh and unpretentious medium-sized dishes are served to help guests to have the appetite to try out just one more dish. And one more. And maybe one more.

title: Tennstopet
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurants come and go, but Tennstopet has endured for decades. Have a taste of Swedish home fare in a neighborhood restaurant with Vasastan charm. Not only does Tennstopet change its menu according to the season, but they also have special dishes that return each year like black soup and crow (yes, crow).

title: Terrassen Grand Hôtel
label: Bar
text: Sit outside on the terrace of Grand Hôtel and savor Mediterranean-inspired dishes or sip a glass of wine, while enjoying the view of the Royal Palace and the waterfront. Drop-in seats only.

title: The Border
label: Restaurant
text: The aptly named The Border is located at the southern edge of Södermalm, bordering to the southern suburbs of Stockholm. The menu pits American hamburgers against Mexican burritos. As the first burger joint in Stockholm, The Border also offers patties made from Wagyu-beef.

title: The Fishery
label: Restaurant
text: The Fishery is, as the name implies, all about fish, shellfish and plants from the depths. Simple yet delicious fish burgers, spicy salmon and fish taco with the freshest ingredients form our waterways.

title: The Italian Cousins
label: Restaurant
text: Started by cousins Davide and Enrico, The Italian Cousins is a great place for genuine pizza made of fresh produce from smaller Italian and Swedish farms and producers. Come in for a quick snack, lunch or dinner. They currently have three spots; a pizzeria in Vasastan, a pizzeria and bar in Normalm and a pizzeria and salumeria on Södermalm.

title: The Strand
label: Restaurant
text: The Strand is a Swedish brasserie serving classic flavors in a unique and relaxed venue. Enjoy everything from breakfast, brunch, and lunch to afternoon tea or fun after work-drinks with the lovely view of Nybrokajen.

title: The Veranda
label: Restaurant
text: Cosmopolitan, elegant and classic. The Grand Hotel veranda is an international rendezvous that serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner 365 days a year. The Veranda is also one of the few restaurants in Stockholm that offer a genuine Swedish smörgåsbord for most of the year. A beautiful view over the water and Gamla Stan is a bonus.

title: Torpedverkstan
label: Restaurant
text: The archipelago ambiance in the middle of the city – Torpedverkstan Restaurang & Bar is located on Skeppsholmen, only a ten-minute walk from the park Kungsträdgården. Industrial romance meets sea salt in a former torpedo factory right on the quay line with a lovely view of the boats, Nybroviken, Strandvägen, and Djurgården.

title: Totemo Ramen
label: Restaurant
text: The ramen trend has finally arrived in Stockholm. At Totemo you’ll get a hearty bowl of ramen served in laid-back surroundings. The ingredients are all locally produced and eco-friendly and the noodles homemade to ensure that every bowl, whether it’s a pork belly broth or a light vegetarian mix, is an explosion of umami flavor.

title: Tranan
label: Restaurant
text: Tranan has been serving Swedish cuisine evergreens since 1929. The fried herring with mashed potatoes has been a fixture on the menu since Tranan's early days, but their classic meatballs in gravy are just as popular. Both a restaurant and a bar, Tranan also hosts the occasional concert, club, or pub quiz.

title: Trattorian
label: Restaurant
text: Classic Italian cuisine in an inviting setting. Trattorian is located along the walking route on Norr Mälarstrand and is, along with Orangeriet a vibrant meeting place with lovely outdoor seating areas and proximity to the water.

title: Ulla Winbladh
label: Restaurant
text: ”Ulla, my Ulla.” This is the opening of a famous Swedish ballad by the eighteenth-century troubadour Bellman. The ballad is about his lover, Ulla Winbladh. The restaurant of the same name, with so much tradition behind it, is centrally located on the beautiful and lush island of Djurgården. Traditional Swedish home fare is served here year-round.

title: Villa Godthem
label: Restaurant
text: Villa Godthem in Stockholm’s central Djurgården island was built in 1874 as a private residence for local opera singer Carl Johan Uddman, before it was turned into an inn in 1897. The restaurant is well-known for their Swedish classic cuisine served in fantastic historical settings, and one of their signature dishes is the delicious ’plank steak’.

title: Villa Källhagen
label: Restaurant
text: Enjoy a beautiful natural setting and classic cooking with the Djurgård canal just outside the window. The restaurant changes the menu according to the change of seasons and concentrates on contemporary Swedish food. During the summer season, guests gather in the outdoor dining area in the garden, and on Sundays, a popular brunch buffet with Swedish delicacies is served.

title: Vina
label: Bar
text: A menu with both snack-sized tapas and hearty meals. Vina’s passion though is to serve you nature wines from all across Europe, from their dynamic wine list. Wines that are selected to, simply put, put you in a good mood.

title: Warung
label: Restaurant
text: This family-owned restaurant offers Indonesian dishes based on seasonal ingredients from the Swedish nature. In the bustling neighbourhood of Hornstull, owners Nizar Achmad and Anna Lindmark has created an à la carte restaurant that not only has been praised for its nasi goreng and gado gado, but also the creative cocktails.

title: Wedholms Fisk
label: Restaurant
text: Delicacies from the sea of the highest quality are served at Wedholms Fisk on Nybrokajen wharf. This gourmet restaurant, which has won an array of honors over the years, is one of the few pure seafood restaurants in Stockholm. The restaurant was founded by the legendary restaurateur Bengt Wedholm. Wedholms has also had a bar with classic style and an ocean view for several years.

title: Woodstockholm
label: Restaurant
text: Furniture store, food bar and bistro in one. Woodstockholm offers a themed menu that that changes regularly, focusing on organically produced food and wine. Small, crowded and very popular. Book in advance or hope for a seat at the bar.

title: Xarcuteria
label: Restaurant
text: Relaxed and informal tapas bar in Kungsholmen that offers more than 50 wines by the glass. Old classics are mixed with modern fusion tapas and the charcuterie platter is not to be missed.

title: Yuc Mexican
label: Restaurant
text: Yuc Mexican is a haven for lovers of garlic, cilantro, and chili; Mexican-styled fusion food with influences from Peru, Chile, East Asia and Sweden. Be sure to check out the award-winning bar as well!

title: Art Bakery
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Art Bakery combines the fine art of creating pastries with, well, fine art. Besides creating desserts that look and taste like no other the café, located in the NK department store, has an exhibition space showcasing contemporary art.

title: Bak
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: This bakery started off as a small and luxurious spot in the city – the owners of Bak have been responsible for the dessert at the Nobel Banquet twice. When they moved to larger premises in Hökarängen, they were able to open a spacious café. Visitors can now enjoy the freshly baked pastries on-site while looking at new bread being baked. Try the famous cinnamon buns for a mouthwatering fika experience.

title: Bergianska gamla orangeriet
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The old orangery is located in the Bergius Botanic Garden, ideally situated on Brunnsviken near the seaside. Visit for the relaxed atmosphere, the bakery, a great bread buffet– and of course, to see the beautiful old greenhouse.

contact.address: Veit Wittrocks väg 7, Stockholm, Sweden, 114 18 Stockholm
contact.label: gamlaorangeriet.se

title: Blåbär
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Blåbär is Swedish for blueberry, and the café’s signature drink is blueberry juice. But Blåbär is primarily known for its filling salads, which you can create yourself from a selection of ingredients. Other fare includes soups and grilled sandwiches.

title: Bröd & Salt Regeringsgatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Bröd & Salt is a local chain of artisan bakeries, with locations all over Stockholm. Everything is fresh, made from sourdough, and lactose-free. Besides fresh bread, buns, and cookies Bröd & Salt also has a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps if you’re hungry for lunch!

title: Bullar & Bröd Valhallavägen
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Bakery and café with an industrial feel. Go for their popular avocado toast – or try a single espresso, served in the same cup as their homemade gelato. Bullar & Bröd (meaning “buns & bread”) is open seven days a week and the owner was named the best baker in Sweden 2015.

title: Café Blå Lotus
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: A little piece of the Orient in SoFo: there are many varieties of tea and coffee to choose from at Café Blå Lotus. They offer sweet home-made pastries and filling sandwiches. The cozy décor is inspired by different parts of the East.

title: Café Ektorpet
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Round of a visit to Waldemarsudde’s art museum with a snack in Café Ektorpet’s lush and green garden. The café holds its doors open during the summer months and has a menu of both lighter snacks, lunches, and waffles.

title: Café Koya
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Koya combines Japanese desserts and cakes, with a love of Japanese popular culture. Have a simple fika - why not a matcha roll or kabocha pumpkin pie with yuzu tea or a matcha latte? - or drop by on one of their workshops to learn more about anime, cosplay or manga.

title: Café Pascal Vasastan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: A block from busy Odenplan, on a quiet corner, you'll find Café Pascal. In 2019 the coffee house won the prestigious Gulddraken award for best café in Stockholm. Great coffee and sandwiches with shrimp or porchetta to die for!

title: Café Proviant
label: Restaurant
text: Café Proviant is a restaurant with its own brewery. The food is mainly made by primary products from Swedish farmers. Their focus is to serve great meals and great beer to go with it. Sister restaurant to Proviant at Sturegatan.

title: Chaikhana
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Chaikhana in the Old Town (Gamla Stan) serves first-class teas from around the world. Their wide selection includes both delicious classics and lesser-known blends. Drop-in for an Afternoon Tea and a snack, or learn more about the mysteries of tea at one of their tea tastings.

title: Chokladkoppen
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: This cozy little café in the heart of Gamla Stan was one of the first openly LGBT-friendly establishments in Stockholm. Exquisite sandwiches and pastries, and in summer a popular alfresco section.

title: Cupcake STHLM
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Treat yourself to a playful and yummy cupcake at Cupcake STHLM. The small café serves up classic American cupcakes in all colors and flavor-variations, with a rotating selection of cakes depending on the season.

title: Delivore
label: Restaurant
text: The café Delivore is located inside its sister shop Goodstore; a vegan and vegetarian grocery store with plant-based alternatives for everything you might need in your everyday life. Delivore offers freshly squeezed juice, croissants, pies, wraps, smoothies and other snacks. All vegan, as well.

title: Drop Coffee
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: A popular place run by true coffee aficionados with very high focus on quality and craftsmanship. All coffee served is both organic and fair-trade and also roasted in their own award-winning roastery. Two-time winner of Barista Cup.

title: Fabrique Klarabergsgatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Fabrique is a local chain of traditional wood-fired bakeries that are located throughout central Stockholm. Here you'll find top-quality fresh-baked sourdough bread, rolls, and cakes baked by hand with natural ingredients according to time-honored traditions. Don´t miss out on the famous blueberry buns!

title: Fern and Fika
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The motto of Fern and Fika (previously known as STHLM Raw)  is that everybody deserves a fika every day, but without feeling like your stuffing yourself with unhealthy snacks. Hence, their delicious treats are made without additives, gluten, lactose or granulated sugar and instead filled with eco-friendly and sustainable sweats.

title: Flickorna Helin
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: A charming café in a secluded and leafy setting with a large and very popular selection of baked goods. The castle-like building is located along the pedestrian path on Djurgården, and it’s a splendid place for lunch or a coffee break between visits to Skansen, the Vasa Museum, and other nearby attractions.

title: Fosch Artisan Pâtisserie
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The brainchild of a classically trained pastry chef and a restaurateur with a childhood spent on farms and fields, Fosch Artisan Pâtisserie has garnered attention for the delicious French pastries and love of fresh and ecological ingredients. This award-winning bakery on Östermalm not only carefully selects the best ingredients for its petit choux, macarons, and croissants but also grows some themselves.

title: Gast
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Minimalistic but cozy café located just north of Hötorget. Gast is the sibling of Kaffeverket and Stora bageriet and serves up exciting blends of coffee as well as great buns, sandwiches, and even light lunches.

title: Gildas rum
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The décor is stylishly kitschy, with muted red and gold tones. The bookshelf pattern on the wallpaper and the comfy armchairs lend the feeling of an old-fashioned reading room. The selection of home-baked goodies is popular, as well as the fresh lunch menu. Located in Bohemian SoFo, with popular outdoor seating in the summertime.

title: Green Rabbit
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Celebrated chefs Mathias Dahlgren and Martin Berg are behind this innovative bakery, where organic ingredients and sustainability are front and center. In addition to bread and baked goods, the Green Rabbit bakery offers breakfast, Swedish varieties of Danish smørrebrød sandwiches and soup for lunch. Playfulness and curiosity set the standard, with great results for both the eyes and the taste buds. Swedish bread culture is nurtured here, while the food experience is spread to a broader audience.

title: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri – Vasastan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri is an artisan bakery in Stockholm's Vasastan area known for cakes, bread, and classic pastries with a modern twist. Everything from sourdough bread to buns and handcrafted cakes is baked using Swedish flour and carefully selected ingredients. In addition to Swedish fika, the bakery offers custom-made cakes and options for various dietary needs.

title: Il Caffé Södermannagatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Take a well-deserved coffee break in the heart of busy Södermalm at one of the local’s favorite “fika” spots. Unpretentious and cozy, Il Caffé offers pastries, simple lunches and fresh bread from their own bakery. Check out their other locations, too!

title: Java Whiskers
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Java Whiskers is a cat lovers dream. Besides serving coffee and fika the coffee shop in Vasastan serves as a shelter for cats and works towards finding new homes for them. Guests are welcome to pet and cuddle the cats, as long as they follow the rules of the café.

title: Johan & Nyström Swedenborgsgatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Combined coffee bar, roastery and concept store for coffee aficionados. The fair-trade organic beans are roasted in their own roastery. Try the "roast of the week" or ask the friendly and knowledgeable baristas for personal advice on what to order.

title: Kaferang Nytorget
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The trendy Kaferang has two locations, one in Norrmalm and one in the heart of SoFo at Nytorget. Both serve refreshing snacks and brunch, and hearty lunch sandwiches if your appetite is larger still.

title: Kaffe
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Movie and Swedish crime-fans might recognize the cozy Kaffe as Daniel Craig’s coffee bar of choice in the film adaption of The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo. The coffee served is strictly Italian, with bitter espressos and creamy lattes, but the snacks are from all over.

title: Stora Bageriet Östermalm
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Stora Bageriet is located on Östermalm in the oldest industrial building in Stockholm; a bakery that used to supply the military with fresh bread. They're open for breakfast, fika and lunch, and their outdoor terrace is perfect for a refreshing drink in the shade.

title: Konditori Lyran
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Walk up the stairs in the tower of this 150-year-old sun yellow house and enjoy the stunning views of Mälaren. Lyran is a pastry shop, famous for its shrimp sandwiches and afternoon tea. Famous people who have visited Lyran over the years include King Oskar II and author Selma Lagerlöf.

title: Kungsholmens glassfabrik
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: A combination ice cream factory, store, and café just a short walk from City Hall. They make premium ice cream in intriguing flavors that you can either enjoy immediately or take home with you in a small container.

title: La Gelateria SoFo
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: La Gelateria SoFo contrasts the harsh cold of northern Sweden with the sunny warmth of Italy. Classic flavors like pistachio and limoncello mingle with nordic newcomers like cloudberries, lingonberries and sea buckthorn. All the ice cream in the store is artisanally made on-site.

title: Lasse i Parken
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Not far from the city center in Hornstull you find Lasse i Parken, a green paradise with garden seating for 300 people. The house is from the seventeenth century and inside you´ll find the café. Visit for coffee, lunch or live music during summer.

title: Lillebrors bageri
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Tiny bakery with a huge ambiance. The wooden counter takes up most of the space, but in the warmer months guests can enjoy a cup of coffee and the freshly baked pastries outdoors as Rörstrandsgatan turns into a car-free street during summer. Go for a croissant – with 27 layers of dough and butter it will melt as soon as it touches your mouth.

title: Louie Louie
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Named after the rock ’n roll song, Louie Louie features music on stage, for sale, and in the rockabilly decor. The cafe attracts a younger SoFo crowd with sandwiches, pastries, and coffee at reasonable prices.

title: Lykke Nytorget
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Lykke Kaffegårdar is on a mission to produce good coffee, made under decent conditions. At Lykke Nytorget you can taste the fruits of their work; the beans are harvested at Lykke's own plantations around the world, and roasted at proprietary roasteries in Berlin and Stockholm.Brunch and home-baked goods are also served, and in the evenings cocktails and a simple but delicious dinner menu is offered. Lykke also hosts concerts on the regular – check out their Instagram profile for updates!

title: Mahalo
label: Restaurant
text: Mahalo specializes in plant-based breakfasts and lunches. Enjoy American pancakes and a smoothie at the start of the day or come back later for a fresh lunch bowl or a plate of loaded vegan fries.Mahalo has several locations in Stockholm, including Kungsholmen, Vasastan, and Södermalm.

contact_text.text: Also has a location at Odengatan 26, in the Vasastan district.

title: MR. Cake
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: MR. Cake brings an American sensibility and style to your Swedish fika. Delicious cinnamon rolls and pastries, fresh sandwiches and salads, and jaw-droppingly beautiful cakes. (They also have locations at Regeringsgatan 57 and Stockholm Central Station.)

title: Petite France
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: At the Petite France Bakery, you’ll find an abundance of French specialties: genuine croissants, brioches and several types of pastries. They offer lovely breakfast specials and affordable lunches – all high quality and with a French touch.

title: Pom & Flora Södermalm
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The breakfast deal at Pom & Flora is known to be one of the best in town. The café on the corner of Bondegatan 64 in Södermalm serves up both beautiful interior and a menu worth returning for – whether you're up for breakfast or lunch. They also have a café in Vasastan, on Odengatan.

title: Ritorno
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Ritorno is a classic Stockholm bakeshop and café which has been in business since 1959. Today Ritorno is decorated in a warm and welcoming 1950s style, and it's a popular spot for long coffee breaks. Classic Swedish meatball sandwiches complement Ritorno's image as a Stockholm bakeshop where the traditional rules.In addition to the patisserie on Odengatan, Ritorno has bakeries on Dalagatan and Torsgatan.

title: Robin Delselius bageri
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Robin Delselius is a third-generation baker from a family with over 30 years of bakery experience. He continues the family tradition of delicious buns, bread, cookies, and pastries with his own bakeries in Gamla Enskede, Nacka, Kvarnholmen, and Södermalm. They also run a seaside summer café in Stavsnäs. If you're hungry, there are also light lunches like salads and wraps. In 2020, Robin Delselius won the prestigious Gulddraken award for best café in Stockholm.

title: Rosendals Garden Café
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Rosendals Trädgård is one of Stockholm’s true gems! The garden café is located in a fantastic setting on Djurgården island and offers salads, soups, sandwiches and pastries made in the bakery next door. The café uses organic and biodynamic ingredients, a lot of them even come from their own garden. Many Stockholmers make the pilgrimage to Rosendal on sunny days, but there’s room for numerous guests. In the summer you can sit on the grass in the orchard. Don't miss to pop in to the little boutique before you leave. Best way to get here is to walk from the bridge Djurgårdsbron, follow the canal and you will see the signs.

title: Rosenhill
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Rosenhill is a magical, inviting garden outside town. This peaceful family farm produces organic vegetables, apples and apple juice and you can enjoy it all in the garden café. Sit down and relax among the apple trees, nap in a hammock or make your own cider – or stay overnight.

title: Saturnus
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: People go to Saturnus to drink large bowls of hot latte with the legendary cinnamon rolls – they are the biggest, and they’ve been described in the press as the best in town. A café and lunch spot with inspiration from France, where the decor has warm colors, a stone's throw from Stureplan and close to cultural attractions such as the Zita movie theater and the National Library of Sweden.

title: Scarfó
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Genuine artisan gelato, made from a combination of the best ingredients imported from Italy and seasonal Swedish produce. Scarfó is located in Ålsten, an affluent and trendy part of the Bromma suburb, characterized by “Per-Albinhusen”; villas in the style of functionalist architecture. In other words, it’s ample opportunity to take your delicious ice cream to-go and experience classic Swedish architecture from the 1930’s that’s always in high-demand on the housing market.

title: Skroten
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Skroten started at the old marine store on Skeppsholmen but is now located at the shipyard on beautiful Djurgården. Stop by for a coffee or stay for a bowl of fish stew and a glass of wine. This charming place is worth a visit all year round.

title: Snö
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Snö makes traditional Italian gelato, dense and rich in flavor - both unique blends and time-tested classics. Just a stone’s throw from Vasaparken it’s the perfect spot to stock up on delicious ice cream to binge on, during a sunny summer day in Vasastan. They also have a shop on Kvarnholmen island in the Nacka district. Perfect for a visit with the public transport ferries!

title: Stikki Nikki Mariatorget
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Stikki Nikki serves fresh, homemade gelato, ice cream, and sorbet. Stikki Nikki has several ice cream cafés around Stockholm; for instance on Götgatan, Drottninggatan and Mariatorget.

title: Stockholms glasshus
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: With its large selection, long experience, and extraordinary craftsmanship, this place lives up to its name - which means "The Stockholm Ice Cream House." There are about 40 flavors of ice cream, gelato, sorbet and other tasty treats on the menu, and plenty of seating.

title: Sup46
label: Co-working space
text: Industries: all, in particular, tech Shared desk, lounge: yes Own desk: yes Office space: yes Vision"The leading Startup hub in Sweden! We help companies succeed faster through our network & ecosystem: fundraising, recruitment, international expansion, PR & Marketing plus office space in Stockholm."

title: Tössebageriet
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Occupying the same address since 1920, Tössebageriet is well-known as one of Stockholm's most historic classic bakeshops. Take a lunch break with a sandwich made from home-made bread in the cozy bakeshop atmosphere, or enjoy a pastry if you're able to choose from among their tempting creations. They have everything in the way of pastries and cakes, and their Semlor makes the "Best Of" list for the city every year.

title: Vetekatten Kungsgatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Vetekatten in central Stockholm is a coffee-and-pastry institution. A well-preserved, tradition-packed café where you can sample traditional Swedish pastries of superior quality. They have six branches throughout the city and their first has been open, almost every day, since opening its door at Kungsgatan 55 in 1928.

title: Vintervikens Trädgård
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Take a break from city life and head to a green oasis. Just a few stops by subway from the city center you will find Vintervikens Trädgård: an inspiring garden and organic café where you can simply enjoy the sound of the breeze in the trees. Open all year round.

title: Vurma
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: High cozy factor among the colorful interiors. With a personal and friendly style, considerate staff and tasty sandwiches with names like ‘buddy’, ‘stranger’ and ‘scruffy’, Vurma has become a popular spot for many locals in Hornstull.

title: Winterviken
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: In the suburb of Aspudden, in an old Nobel-factory from 1891, you find the popular café Winterviken. Located just a short train ride from the center but close to nature, this is the perfect place for a small excursion away from the city life. Open every day, all through the year.

title: Zetas
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Zetas is an inspiring destination outside town where you can explore a beautiful garden, buy plants and indoor and outdoor furnishing - or enjoy a lunch or coffee in the lush settings.

title: 20hundra5
label: Bar
text: Small and cozy but fully stocked with everything to make a fantastic drink and then some! The award-winning 20hundra5 has created quite a buzz since it opened its doors. Both for their own creations – like a Windom Earle or a H.Y.S.H – or their take on cocktail classics. And while you’re there, why not take a jab improving your high scores in some NES classics?

title: Americain
label: Bar
text: The cocktail bar Americain draws inspiration from 1920's American ballrooms and hotels. Located in the Haymarket-hotel the bar serves classy and elegant drinks, simple dishes and offers an elegant vibe with live music.

title: Berns
label: Nightclub
text: Berns is a unique, well-preserved 1860s art nouveau entertainment temple, located in the center of the city. It has a large dance floor where you can dance the night away under huge chandeliers, a popular patio, an expansive dining room and several bars. Berns also doubles as a hotel and concert venue, with a range of international artists performing year-round.

title: Brasserie Godot
label: Restaurant
text: The favorite joint of well-to-do Stockholmers. Brasserie Godot was established in 2001 with the aim of opening a classic French brasserie with the city’s best bar. The bar has a huge drink list focusing on fresh fruit and berries. The small dining room is simple and stylish, serving classics, seafood, and a three-course vegan menu. A great wine list. The feel is inviting yet exclusive. Brasserie Godot is located on Östermalm and partly becomes an open-air restaurant during the summer months.House artist Eric Ericson has decorated the walls, windows, lamps, plates, and the bar, and some of his work is for sale on the menu.

title: Cadierbaren Grand Hôtel
label: Bar
text: Luxurious, elegantly cozy bar with comfortable sofa groups and ravishing views of the water and the Royal Palace. Innovative bar menu and popular weekend brunch and Afternoon Tea. A classic Stockholm experience.

title: Café Opera
label: Restaurant
text: Everyone who is anyone has partied here, and quite a few nobodies, beneath the famous crystal chandeliers. This recently renovated club is housed in magnificent interior spaces in the Opera House, adjacent to with the equally famous Operakällaren restaurant.

title: Cliff Barnes
label: Nightclub
text: Cliff Barnes serves food from all over the world, with a focus on American cuisine. This small place is always full of people on the weekends. Lively, cheerful atmosphere. Around 11, the restaurant becomes a nightclub playing mostly dance band music and 70s hits.

title: Club Backdoor
label: Nightclub
text: Decadent gay club with three bars, awesome sound system, and three dance floors that play techno, house, 90’s pop and all great party music in between! Located near Tele 2 Arena and open until 5 am.

title: Corner Club
label: Bar
text: A cozy at-home feeling and friendly bartenders behind the bar will guarantee a great time at Corner Club. The bar’s creed is to keep things simple and to have a drink list as varied and dynamic as the seasons themselves. If you get hungry, you can either order a burger or snacks from the bar or go downstairs to the gastropub The Flying Elk.

title: Debaser
label: Nightclub
text: Down at the waterfront, called Hornstull Strand, you find Debaser - a legendary concert and club venue. Enjoy a concert or go dancing almost every day of the week. Under the same roof is also the Italian restaurant Capricci and Bar Brooklyn which serves American beer and classic American dishes.

title: Debaser Pontonen
label: Bar
text: When beloved rock club Debaser opened up a new open-air bar, it quickly became one of the hottest summer hang-outs in Stockholm, and not just because of the warm weather. Located in the waters in front of Debaser, Pontonen serves light summer dishes, refreshing drinks, and artisan ice cream from King Scoopa. Expect DJs spinning great music, live music, and awesome vibes all around. No reservations, walk-in only. Open May - August.

title: Erlands
label: Bar
text: Café and cocktail bar in vintage style, where everything from the music to the bartender´s outfit is from the 50´s and 60´s. Although the ambiance most definitely inspires to ordering high-quality cocktails, you can also enjoy wine, beer, and snacks.

title: Fasching
label: Nightclub
text: Long-lived, legendary jazz club with club nights and concerts featuring jazz, soul, and Latin. An ambitious, varied program, year-round.

title: Chewie's Bar
label: Bar
text: Chewies Bar on Kungsholmen serves natural wines and craft beer in a homey and cozy atmosphere. Even dogs are allowed inside, as Chewies has a special brew made just for your four-legged companion.

title: Gården Bar & Grill
label: Restaurant
text: Bar and restaurant in the middle of the city - the perfect place for a beer with friends. Gården Bar & Grill is located in a former schoolyard by Norra Bantorget, close to Drottninggatan. Great location and a safe bet when you feel like having a snack, dinner, or drinks in the city center.

title: Grand Central by Scandic
label: Bar
text: Trendy New York-inspired hotel bar in downtown Stockholm near Central Station. Grand Central by Scandic draws hotel guests as well as Stockholm locals who come in for a drink after work - and there is plenty of room for all. If not in the bar, in the lobby or one floor up. The hotel restaurant, Teaterbrasseriet, is on the ground floor.

title: Guldbaren, Nobis Hotel
label: Bar
text: Guldbaren, (The Gold bar) at the five-star Nobis Hotel is as elegant as it sounds. The walls and ceiling are covered with gold-framed mirrors and the cocktails are master-class. Hang out at the bar or relax on a sofa in the beautiful atrium right next to it.

title: Hell’s Kitchen
label: Nightclub
text: Since many of the other clubs around Stureplan close at 3 a.m., Hell’s Kitchen is often seen as the obvious choice to keep the party going - they're open until 5 am. The beats are primarily mainstream house and the latest dance music. Arrive early, preferably by 2 a.m. The later you go, the harder it is to get in.

title: Himlen
label: Bar
text: Elegant, luxurious cocktail lounge and sky bar with spectacular 360-degree views of Stockholm, from the top of a skyscraper in Södermalm. Also a stylish restaurant.

title: Hornstulls Bodega
label: Bar
text: Hornstulls Bodega is the popular restaurant Tjogets wine bar. As the name suggests – “bodega” is a Spanish storehouse for aging wine – the bar is an unpretentious haven for wine connoisseurs. The bar likes to keep its winelist ever-changing with the only requirements being that wines are from Europe and, of course, delicious to drink.

title: Icebar Stockholm by Icehotel
label: Bar
text: The planet’s first permanent ice bar, made of ice from the world-famous Icehotel in Jukkasjärvi, Lapland. Everything except the liquids in the drinks is made of ice, and the temperature is kept at a constant 23 degrees Fahrenheit.

title: Judit & Bertil
label: Bar
text: A warm, homey atmosphere prevails at Judit & Bertil. This is the place to encounter locals eating affordable well-prepared food in a relaxed setting. The bar is also very popular. All in honor of the real Judit & Bertil, the maternal grandparents of one of the owners.

title: Katarina Ölkafé
label: Bar
text: Located on Katarina Bangata is this snug beer pub that has succeeded in the art of being both personal and trendy. The beer comes from ultralocal microbreweries, and the snacks come in great flavors. Especially the pastrami sandwiches are much talked about. In the summer there is a small sidewalk cafe.

title: Kvarnen
label: Bar
text: Legendary restaurant, bar, and waterhole with a century’s history, in the old blue-collar district of Södermalm. Enjoy well-made, classic Swedish fare in a beautiful setting, with high ceilings and plenty of patina. Kvarnen is also featured in Stieg Larsson's Millennium-books as the meeting place for Lisbeth Salander and her bandmates in the rock band Evil Fingers.

title: Le Hibou
label: Bar
text: Le Hibou is a rooftop bar, located centrally, in the Bank Hotel. An elegant setting, lovely drinks, and a stunning view make it a perfect little oasis in the bustling heart of Stockholm.

title: Lemon Bar
label: Bar
text: A gem of a bar in a popular Kungsholmen neighborhood. The small bar has a good atmosphere and a mix of guests. With a focus on Swedish pop hits, you can come here any day of the week and dance.

title: Lilla Hotellbaren
label: Bar
text: A spacious, elegant lounge on the ground floor of Scandic Malmen. The modern style suits all occasions and the central location by Medborgarplatsen on Södermalm is a good place to meet friends for a drink. Live music and DJs several nights a week. Mostly jazz.

title: Lucy's Flower Shop
label: Bar
text: Find the entrance, hope to be let in and then walk through the abandoned flower shop and try to locate the hidden door that leads you to the bar. If you succeed, you'll step into a purple world with subtle lightning and a short, yet impressive cocktail menu. Your drink will be served with a presentation of every ingredient that made it into the glass. In short, a high-class speakeasy in Stureplan where everyone is welcome.Winner of the prestigious Gulddraken award for best bar in Stockholm 2020 and named the best bar in the Nordic countries by Difford's Guide.

title: Marquise Club
label: Nightclub
text: Marquise Club is the largest of the clubs in Stockholm open until 5 a.m every Friday and Saturday. This place attracts a younger crowd that come here to dance on the two large dancefloors with massive light shows and well known DJ's playing upbeat mixes all night long. The club is centrally located just steps away from Sergels Torg.

title: Morfar Ginko
label: Bar
text: Morfar Ginko is one of Stockholm’s most popular bars. It’s a place for mingling, hanging out, or even playing a game of ping-pong. The DJ works from a loft above the bar, which makes the place feel roomy. There’s a courtyard open in the summer and a great bar done up entirely in white downstairs.

title: Mosebacketerrassen
label: Bar
text: Södra Teatern’s terrace is a classic among locals spending the summer in Stockholm. Here, you can enjoy good food, cold brews, and great company—all with a stunning view over the city.

title: Musikaliska Gård
label: Bar
text: Musikaliska Gård has a trendy and large courtyard in a traditional and beautiful environment at Nybrokajen, where music lovers mingle with the capital’s jet-setters. Fridays and Saturdays are club nights, and although the place is crowded, there’s plenty of room to dance and scope out the bar scene.

title: Omnipollos Hatt
label: Restaurant
text: This award-winning brewery and bar is the place to go when you´re up for trying interesting beers with a tasty slice of pizza. Each new week brings new beer, ale, and stouts to the taps and new toppings for the pizzas.

title: Orangeriet
label: Bar
text: This convivial cocktail bar and outdoor cafe are located on Norr Mälarstrand seafront. The bartenders are topnotch, and the stylish décor is reminiscent of English gardens.

title: Patricia
label: Nightclub
text: Patricia has become a staple of the capital's nightlife scene offering a dynamic mix of music, entertainment, and energy across three dancefloors and six bars.During the summer, the open-air terrace is a hangout spot with food, cocktails, and DJs playing to the backdrop of the waterfront skyline.

title: Pharmarium
label: Bar
text: At Pharmarium, right on Stortorget in the Old Town, the choice of cocktails determines the choice of food. Signature cocktails are served along with well prepared medium-sized dishes composed of seasonal ingredients and traditional medicinal herbs. The bar is inspired by Sweden's first pharmacy, which opened to the public in 1575 in the area. Just as its first druggist Anthonius Busenius the owners have created a place of medicine, beauty and magic.

title: Riche
label: Bar
text: Classic meeting place in the city center, with multiple bars and restaurants. Stockholm’s art, fashion and club crowds gather here to see and be seen.

title: Sailor Bar
label: Bar
text: This small, intimate rooftop terrace at at Scandic Sjöfartshotellet near Slussen has a playful Caribbean sailor theme to it. Sit down and enjoy your glass of champagne by the Stockholm waterfront.

title: Side Track
label: Nightclub
text: For gays, the Side Track bar has long been the natural watering hole on Södermalm. Many people see the place as an old, reliable friend because of its intimate atmosphere, pleasant staff, and good, inexpensive food. The DJ plays a mix of pop and old hits.

title: Slakthuset
label: Nightclub
text: Slakthuset is a former slaughterhouse turned nightclub. The residual industrial vibe creates a unique atmosphere with multiple dance floors and clubs playing everything from house and techno to hip-hop and R’n’B. In the summer, their 600-square-meter patio serves as a popular watering hole for Stockholm's club kids and hipsters.

title: Soap Bar
label: Nightclub
text: The Soap Bar keeps the party going seven days a week, 52 weeks a year, always until 3 a.m. and always with free admission. Visitors are a variety of ages and the music can vary, but it's usually hit-focused.

title: Södra Teatern
label: Bar
text: Södra Teatern at Mosebacke is a classic meeting point with a modern atmosphere. Here you’ll find stage shows, live concerts, nightclubs, culinary experiences, and a great vibe—all under one roof. Come to relax, discover something new, or dance the night away. With an impressive view of Stockholm, you can enjoy warm summer evenings on their terraces.

title: Spy Bar
label: Nightclub
text: In the heart of Stureplan is Spy Bar – perhaps Stockholm’s most famous nightclub. Here, media names rub shoulders with a more alternative crowd. If you want to be sure to get in, arrive early. The club is always packed and the line is long. The atmosphere is at its best between 3 and 5 a.m.

title: Stampen Jazzpub
label: Bar
text: Stampen is a cozy pub for a mix of folk. All the swing, Dixie, trad, blues, and 50-60s rock enthusiasts gather here. With two floors, two stages, and two crowded bars, it is definitely worth a visit if you’re interested in music. Live music daily.

title: Stigbergets Fot
label: Bar
text: Stigbergets Fot offers 24 taps with experimental craft beer from their own brewery as well as local and international guests. Originally a brewery from the Swedish west-coast, this location opened in February 2020 and is run in collaboration with Barrels Burgers & Beers. Not so fond of beer? Don't worry, Stigbergets Fot also serves self-imported wines from the Chateau Pesquie vineyard – on tap, of course.

title: Stockholm under Stjärnorna
label: Bar
text: Stockholm under the stars - SUS - is a rooftop bar located in the middle of Stockholm, just a short walk from either the T-Centralen or Kungsträdgården metro station. A mixed crowd, relaxed atmosphere, good drinks and great music (with sets that are regularly broadcast on their Facebook page) makes SUS a great hang out spot during warm summer evenings, with a killer view to boot!

title: Story Hotel
label: Bar
text: The spacious bar at the trendy Story Hotel is a popular after-work scene for the city crowd. A cool, jazzy atmosphere during the week heats up from Thursday to Saturday, when the DJs step up the beat. The adjacent restaurant "Ling Long" has quickly become a favorite among locals, serving creative dishes from the Asian kitchen.

title: Sturecompagniet
label: Nightclub
text: Sturecompagniet is one of Stockholm’s largest and most prestigious nightclubs in the heart of Stureplan, with a variety of bars and dance floors featuring different music styles on several levels. Arrive early. The clubs around Stureplan fill up quickly around 1 and 2 a.m.

title: Thaiboat
label: Nightclub
text: The popular restaurant Thaiboat is docked in Södermalm. Club nights are also held here, with a focus on house, techno, and disco. People usually start their evening by the artificial sandy beach and then move inside, where there dancing goes on until 1 a.m.

title: Tiki Room
label: Bar
text: A tropical oasis in the heart of Stockholm, Tiki Room is Stockholm’s only Tiki bar. Great drinks, relaxing exotica-music and a soothing atmosphere. If you’re in dire need of a quick fix of some Hawaiian-beach party vibes, Tiki Room is the place for you.

title: Tjoget
label: Bar
text: Tjoget is an interesting combination of restaurant, wine bar, and beer café. The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere and a vibrant bar that has quickly become popular among the residents of Hornstull in Södermalm. Order a perfectly composed cocktail or take your pick among the carefully selected beers or vines. The bar has been named one of the best in the world more than once.

title: Trädgården/Under Bron
label: Nightclub
text: Trädgården is an ultra-popular outdoor club located under the Skanstull Bridge in Södermalm. If you're craving an authentic festival feel, this is where you should spend your late hours. Here, you can drink beer from plastic cups, dance, watch live performances and play table tennis or pétanque. Arrive early to avoid long lines. Trädgården is open during the summer season only, but its indoor venue Under Bron is an all-year-round affair.

title: Takpark by Urban Deli
label: Bar
text: The popular restaurant concept Urban Deli manage their own rooftop bar at Sveavägen, called Höjden (meaning "the height"), on the 9th floor. Go for the cocktails, the view, or just the complete experience. Open all year round.

title: India's
label: Restaurant
text: India's is an elegant take on colorful and spicy Indian cuisine, mixed with Swedish produce. Traditional dishes like daal, seekh, and chaat meet ingredients like perch, deer, halibut, and Västerbotten cheese. The bar serves evergreen drinks with a spicy twist, like a "Curry Colada" or "Kashmir Spicy Margarita".

title: Wallmans
label: Nightclub
text: Teatergatan 3 has long been associated with music. During the funky disco 70’s it was home to the nightclub Atlantic. Today it’s the Stockholm home of Wallmans. At Wallmans, not only do the waiters bring you great food and drinks, but also provide the evening’s entertainment with song and dance-numbers in a classic ‘krogshow’, a kind of Swedish variety show/cabaret.

title: Wirströms Pub
label: Bar
text: Live music Tuesday through Saturday in a classic pub setting. Wirströms pub has become a popular hangout for Stockholm’s large English-speaking population. They have a large selection of beers and arrange whiskey tastings.

title: WKND
label: Nightclub
text: A large and popular summer club in a central location that primarily caters to a younger crowd. You'll find plenty of space both indoors and out, several bars and dance floors with a variety of music.

title: American Football
label: Activity
text: American Football is relatively new in Sweden, with the first teams forming in 1982. Superserien, the premier league of American Football in Sweden, started in 1991. Since then, one of Sweden’s most successful teams in the sport has been Stockholm Mean Machines, winning the series seven times and the Swedish Championship-title ten times.Superserien is played April to June and has both a men’s and women’s division. Zinkensdamns IP is Stockholm Mean Machine's home arena, and tickets can be bought in the ticket booth.

title: Axelsons Spa
label: Activity
text: Head to toe treatment center in a shopping galleria. Axelsons aspires to offer the consummate treatment experience by creating a harmonic environment in all treatment rooms through the use of light, sound, space, form, and color.

title: Bandy
label: Activity
text: Introduced in Sweden in the late 19th century, bandy was for a long time one of the biggest sports in Sweden. Although interest has waned since then it’s still a beloved sport deeply ingrained in Swedish culture.Originally from England, bandy is the second biggest winter-sport in the world, with some 350 000 registered players. And the Swedish players are right at the top with both the national men’s and women’s teams considered among the best in the world, having won the 12 and 8 World Cup titles respectively.The most prominent Stockholm club is Hammarby Bandy, and their home stadium Zinkensdamm IP is hallowed bandy-ground. The bandy-season lasts from October to February, and tickets can be bought on-site or through the club’s webpage.

title: Basketball
label: Aktivitet
text: Basketball was introduced in Sweden in the 1890’s but rose to prominence in 1945 when refugees from Latvia formed Sweden’s first club JKS. Since then basketball has become a mainstay in Sweden. In 2009 Jonas Jerebko made history as the first Swedish player to be drafted into the NBA, to The Detroit Pistons.Stockholm has several successful clubs. On the women’s side, AIK and Alvik Basket compete in Basketligan, the highest league in basketball, and KFUM Central och KFUM Fryshuset Basket in Superettan (the second-tier division). AIK and Alvik Basket also have men’s teams that, along with Djurgården, play in Superettan. Basketball season lasts from October to March. Visit basket.se for more info about the teams, matches and how to get tickets.

title: Active Scandinavia
label: Activity
text: Active Scandinavia offers self-guided bike tours and trips, in and around Stockholm. A good way to discover places where tourist buses don't go. For more info, visit their homepage.

title: Boulebar Rålambshov
label: Activity
text: Boulebar Rålis is located at the corner of Rålambshovsparken on Kungsholmen and a great place for a drink or two while playing some pétanque during the summer.The newly built restaurant is designed by architecture firm Bornstein Lyckefors and open year-round. Large glass sections reflect the shifting of seasons in the park. The menu offers classic French dishes and beverages for lunch, dinner, and brunch on the weekends. Perfect to go with a game of petanque, in other words.

title: Boulebar Tanto
label: Activity
text: Boulebar Tanto is a great place for hanging out in the summer; play some pétanque, eat and have a drink or two. Located by Tantolunden in Södermalm, overlooking the waterside of Årstaviken. The nearest subway stop is Hornstull. Boulebar Tanto opens up every may, and is open during the summer months.

title: Bro Hof Slott Golf Course
label: Activity
text: Many people consider this large and beautifully situated golf course on Lake Mälaren to be the best course in Sweden. It has hosted the Scandinavian Masters. The 36-hole golf course is just over seven kilometers long. There is also a gourmet restaurant, and accommodations are available at nearby manor houses. The golf course is half an hour from Stockholm by car.

title: Brunnsvikens Kanotklubb
label: Activity
text: Rent a canoe or kayak and paddle through a national park within the city, past palaces and beautiful green areas. Open daily June through August. Advance reservations are required in May and September.

title: Brunnsviksbadet
label: Activity
text: A swimming beach in Frescati Hage at Brunnsviken in the Ekoparken park. There are also charming inlets and beaches near Haga Park for experienced swimmers. Walk or take the subway to the Universitetet station.

title: Centralbadet – CLOSED for renovations
label: Activity
text: This bathhouse is located in a beautiful art nouveau building with a courtyard from 1909. Swimming pool and fitness activities available. Try different types of therapeutic baths along with facial and body treatments. The bathhouse entrance is in a shady courtyard of the shopping street.Note: Centralbadet is closed for renovations during 2026. More info on their website.

title: Cykelstallet
label: Activity
text: Rent bikes for yourself or large groups. Cykelstallet also rents long-distance ice skates and related equipment.

title: Elfviks gård & café
label: Activity
text: Elfviks gård is a reminder of Lidingö's past as an island covered by green forests and farmland. Besides getting to know the farmstead's animals - sheep, rabbits, chickens, horses, and pigs - you can buy locally produced cheese and soap at the farm shop. There's also a bistro and café serving fika, dinner, and lunch.

title: Eriksdalsbadet
label: Activity
text: The new Eriksdalsbadet baths replaced the old facilities in 1999 and were built during Stockholm’s application for the 2004 Olympic games. It’s the city’s largest and most modern swimming facilities with pools for recreational swimming, a gym and an aqua park with waterslides. Eriksdalsbadet is open every day of the week (with exception for certain holidays) and during the summer its open-air pools are a popular spot for families and recreational swimmers alike.

title: Fågelbro Golf & Country Club
label: Activity
text: A golf club on Värmdö island for the person who wants to combine golf with time in the archipelago. Fågelbro Golf & Country Club is considered one of the country's finest courses and has hosted popular tournaments. The club has an 18-hole and a 19-hole course, as well as access to a driving range and a putting green.

title: Farsta Strandbad
label: Activity
text: Farsta Strandbad is a popular and family friendly beach with jetties by the lake Magelungen in southern Stockholm. Toilets, dressing rooms, a kiosk, an outdoor gym and more activities are available here. Around lake Magelungen you’ll find several nice and accessible walking paths.

title: Flatenbadet
label: Activity
text: The lake of Flaten is one of Stockholm’s cleanest swimming lakes. At the Flatenbadet beach in southern Stockholm you’ll find several jetties and a diving tower. The area is accessibility adapted with a ramp leading to the beach and the water. Nice walking paths through untouched nature leads around the lake.

title: Flottsbrobacken
label: Activity
text: The highest and longest ski slope in Stockholm has five downhill slopes, jump ramps, ski rental, and an inn. The resort is located in Huddinge, a suburb about a half-hour by car from central Stockholm, but there are good connections via public transport as well. In the summer, Flottsbrobacken is a popular outdoor recreation area featuring a swimming beach, hiking trails, and a range of activities. The skiing is at a relatively easy level.

title: Fredhällsbadet
label: Activity
text: Experienced swimmers will enjoy swimming from the rocks with a view of Lake Mälaren. Located in a residential area in the central Kungsholmen island.

title: GolfRent
label: Activity
text: Do you really have to haul your heavy golf clubs around the world just because you want to play a round on your vacation? No!GolfRent delivers top-tier rental equipment directly to your hotel or golf club. It's run by two golf-loving travellers who also have compiled an extensive list (and ranking) of golf clubs in the regions surrounding Stockholm.

title: Grand Hôtel Nordic Spa & Fitness
label: Activity
text: With its design inspired by Stockholm’s waterside location and the islands of the archipelago, the luxurious spa at the Grand Hôtel has been called one of the best spas in the world. Patrons are invited to partake in a wide range of spa treatments, swim in specially designed pools, and enjoy the sauna, gym, and much more.

title: Hammarbybacken ski resort
label: Activity
text: A Stockholm landmark, Hammarbybacken is a popular weekend destination for many Stockholmers during the winter months. Hammarbybacken is easy to reach, either by taking the Tvärbanan-tram to Sickla Kaj or bus number 74. There are three easy-to-ski downhill slopes, a snowboard park, ski school, equipment rental, and a café.

title: HaningeStrand Golf Club
label: Activity
text: Haningestrand Golf Club is a 25-minute drive from central Stockholm, next to the southern part of the Stockholm archipelago. The 18-hole course is a mixture of forest and park, designed by course architect Bengt Lorichs. There are five different tees and the club welcomes all categories of players.Haningestrand’s philosophy is that 'the course should be fun to play, easy to find the ball and good playing rhythm'.Horsfjäderns Vandrarhem, a family-owned hostel, has a close collaboration with Haningestrand Golf Club and cabins overlooking the courses.

title: Hellasgården
label: Activity
text: If you enjoy the outdoors, the Hellasgården recreation area, 20 minutes from downtown Stockholm, should be on you Stockholm bucket list. Here, you can walk or bike along the paths, or swim by the sandy beach. For the sporty visitor, open-air activities abound, including petanque, beach volleyball, fishing, tennis, canoeing, and yoga. During the winter ice skating and cross-country skiing dominate, with a hole cut in the ice for the bravest swimmers. (There is also a sauna on-site.) Hungry visitors can head to Storstugan, where fika, light lunches, and vegetarian dishes are served.

title: Highvalley Skateworld
label: Activity
text: Located in the southern suburb of Högdalen (which quite literally translates to Highvalley), Highvalley Skateworld is a popular skate park with bowls, ditches, ramps, rails, and a kid area. The park regularly hosts competitions and festivals, like the annual Bowlstock. Although a public park, accessible all year-round, the renting booth and courses are only available during the spring and summer months. The park can be reached by taking the subway's green line to Högdalen.

title: Hökarängsbadet
label: Activity
text: Hökarängsbadet is a family friendly swimming area with a beach, jetties and opportunities for different activities. It’s located by the large lake Drevviken in southern Stockholm. Toilets, a kiosk and an outdoor gym are available. This is a popular area with nice nature surroundings for long walks and outdoor activities.

title: Hot air ballooning
label: Activity
text: Experience the city from above, suspended in the wind, as the earth turns. Keep in mind that ballooning is very dependent on the weather, so there is no guarantee that the balloon can lift as scheduled.Far & FlygFar & Flyg is Sweden’s oldest and most experienced ballooning company with thousands of ascents since opening in 1981. farochflyg.seUpplands ballongflygOffers hot air balloon tours in Stockholm and Uppsala during the summer season. Expect a flight that takes at least 60 minutes.uppballongflyg.se

title: ICEguide
label: Activity
text: Want to skate on the natural ice around Stockholm? Be safe and go with an experienced guide!  ICEguideoffers guided package tours including skating- and safety equipment, clothing, lunch, and transportation. Book a private tour or choose from any of their scheduled tours during the winter months. Depending on weather conditions, the location of your adventure and the skating conditions may vary.  You could go to a small lake, to Lake Mälaren (the 5th largest lake in Europe) or to the Baltic Sea in Stockholm’s Archipelago – wherever you end up, it’ll be a fantastic experience.

title: Ice skating in Kungsträdgården
label: Activity
text: Gliding around this ice-skating rink in the middle of the city is a must for many winter visitors to Stockholm. The rink is free and open to all. It is open in the winter season (weather permitting). Get more info here (in Swedish).

title: Ice skating in Vasaparken
label: Activity
text: A large and popular ice-skating rink that is maintained several times a week and open between 8 am–9 pm weekdays, and 10 am–9 pm on weekends. Opens between November and March, but is dependant on weather conditions. Skating on the rink is free and open to all.

title: Ice skating with Green Trails
label: Activity
text: Take a lovely trip out on the ice-covered lakes of Stockholm with Green Trails. Choose from tours for beginners or more experienced skaters, as well as 6-7 excursions to 2-3 day treks.

title: Ice skating with True Nature Sweden
label: Activity
text: Enjoy a wonderful day out on the ice on one of Stockholm's frozen lakes. A perfect way to spend a winter day, whether your a seasoned skater or beginner. True Nature Sweden's ice skating tours are available during the winter season, mid-December to March.

title: Jog around town
label: Activity
text: It’s probably safe to say that jogging is one of the most popular ways to keep in shape, not only in Sweden but the rest of the world as well. It’s also a great way to experience a new city in a different light, for example when the rising sun hits lake Mälaren and Stockholm springs to life in the morning hours. Some of the city’s most trafficked jogging tracks are on Djurgården and Gärdet, Kungsholmen, Norrmälarstrand, and Årstaviken. For a more comprehensive list, check out Stockholm’s official map of jogging tracks around town.

title: Kanaanbadet
label: Activity
text: Kanaanbadet is a family-friendly swimming area with two nice beaches in northern Stockholm. Large lawns, swings, a diving tower, outdoor showers, and toilets (including a handicap toilet) are on site. The café Kanaan serves ice cream, fika, and lighter refreshments.

title: Kayak in the Stockholm Archipelago
label: Activity
text: Escape the city and paddle your way through the beautiful Stockholm Archipelago. The kayak tour through the various islands lets you explore the area at a slower pace with the help of a professional guide. Lucky visitors might even spot a seal or two! The kayak tours with True Nature Sweden are available for a just one-day escapes as well as multi-day trips.

title: Kungsängen Golf Club
label: Activity
text: The club has two 18-hole courses: the King’s Course and the Queen’s Course. It has hosted several major tournaments, including the Scandinavian Masters four times. The varied courses present obstacles including water, woods and more.

title: Långholmen Kajak
label: Activity
text: Rent a kayak and experience the beautiful surroundings of the lush island Långholmen. For beginners as well as for experienced kayakers. Open from May to September.

title: Lida Nature Reserve
label: Park
text: Lida Nature Reserve is located in Tullinge, just south of Stockholm. The large forest has lots of beautiful nature to experience, a lake for swimming – and a sauna raft! Several walking paths cutting through the forest. For climbers, there's also a high-altitude treetop adventure park and a small parkour track. During winter, the walking paths are turned into cross-country skiing tracks.

title: Mälarhöjdsbadet
label: Activity
text: A beautiful beach along lake Mälaren in southern Stockholm. You'll find a large lawn, a playground and a diving tower by the beach, as well as an outdoor public gym and a beach basketball field.

title: Mälarö GK Skytteholm
label: Activity
text: Mälarö Golf Club is located on the island of Ekerö, 30 kilometers from Stockholm city. They offer a 9-hole course that is playable all year round, and an 18-hole course that is open from April to November.The 18-hole course was inaugurated in 1994 and it’s a classic links course with a few water hazards, many bunkers, and fasts greens. Number 17, which is the golf club’s signature hole, has been voted one of Sweden’s 100 best holes by the magazine Svensk Golf.In 2003, Mälarö GK got another 9 holes, that course is a little narrower with more water hazards.A good drive from Mälarö GK you’ll find Skytteholm, a beautiful hotel and conference facility. Here, you can end the day with a sauna, a barbeque dinner, or spend the night. Guests staying at Skytteholm can also borrow golf clubs and balls for free.

title: Mälaröarna's hiking trails
label: Activity
text: Also called Mälarölederna, these are a collection of hiking trails stretching over a few islands in Lake Mälaren, belonging to Ekerö municipality. Nature is rich in wildlife and dramatic shifts.Lovö hiking trail goes through Lovö nature reserve and over forest paths and beaches. The hiking trail is about 18 kilometers long and has one huge attraction above all: Drottningholm Palace. Ekerö-Munsö hiking trail part 1 is an 18-kilometer long path that passes, among other things, a swimming area and Skytteholm where you'll find a hotel and a golf club. Ekerö-Munsö hiking trail part 2 is 15 kilometers long with lots of swimming opportunities in small lakes along the way. Adelsö hiking trail takes you to ancient tombs and a tower with nice views over Lake Mälaren. The trail is 16 kilometers long.Keep in mind that none of the trails in Ekerö municipality offer shelters for overnight stays.

title: Moose & Wildlife Safari Stockholm
label: Activity
text: Curious about Stockholm's wildlife? With Green Trails you can get up-close-and-personal with moose, birds of prey and different species of deer. You'll learn more about Sweden's indigenous animals from an experienced guide and the trek will be capped off with a cozy campfire dinner.

title: Mountain bike tour with True Nature Sweden
label: Activity
text: Enjoy a fast-paced mountain bike ride in the forests och Nacka in Southern Stockholm. The tour starts in Skärmarbrink, just a 10-minute subway-ride from Stockholm Central Station and you'll be surrounded by green foliage in a matter of minutes. All equipment and cycling gear are included in the tour as well as a small lunch.

title: Mountainbikeskolan
label: Activity
text: At Mountainbikeskolan, you can rent a mountain bike and explore the forest on your own—complete with tips for trails that match your skill level—or book a guided tour with a coach. Bookings are available for individuals, groups of friends, or the whole family. The latest bikes are available, including both front and full suspension mountain bikes in all sizes, as well as gravel bikes. Here, you'll find a wide variety of trails for both beginners and experienced cyclists, along with gravel roads and small paths through scenic surroundings. Nearby, you'll also find Källtorpssjön, a lake perfect for swimming, a bike park, and the garden café Kafé Källtorp. On Sundays, you can also book Mountainbike with Brunch—an activity combining guided cycling, food, and relaxed hangout time. Mountainbikeskolan and Kafé Källtorp are open for the season from April to November.

title: Nordic Trails
label: Activity
text: Nordic Trails offers a canopy of different self-guided outdoor tours, mini-breaks, and activities in and around Stockholm and the Stockholm archipelago. Cycling, paddling, hiking, mountain biking, and more. Currently, they also offer long-term bike rentals.

title: Open-air gyms
label: Activity
text: Don't want to spend a beautiful day indoors in the gym? No worries, Stockholm has over 80 open-air gyms around town. Often near a park, the gyms are open to the public and free of charge. Check the city's official map to see where the nearest one is to your location.

title: Ourway Tours
label: Activity
text: Ourway Tours specializes in unique tours with a twist, both in larger groups and with a private guide. Take a craft beer tour in Old Town, take a class in Swedish cooking, or learn about true stories and events that have shocked Sweden!

title: Oxhålsbadet
label: Activity
text: A beach located in the residential area of Stora Essingen. Three jetties, large grass lawn, and toilets. Bus number 1 takes you all the way, get off at "Flottbrovägen".

title: Paradiset Nature Reserve
label: Activity
text: Deep untouched forest, sun-warmed cliffs, and a large population of capercaillies – that's the Swedish version of paradise. Paradiset Nature Reserve is located in Huddinge, south of Stockholm City. Besides primeval forest, the nature reserve consists of bogs, fields, pastures, and several lakes.It's a popular place for hiking, as both Sörmlandsleden and Huddingeleden trails go through the area. There are also three shorter hiking loops in Paradiset Nature Reserve: Sameslingan (5 kilometers), Tornbergsslingan (6 kilometers), and Brinkslingan (8 kilometers). Resting areas and wind shelters are available. Maps are for sale in the cabin, open on Sundays only.

contact.address: Paradisets naturreservat, Vandrarstigen, Huddinge, Sweden,  Huddinge
contact.label: paradiset-hanveden.se (page in Swedish)

title: Parkteatern – free outdoor theatre
label: Activity
text: Every summer, Parkteatern welcomes Stockholmers and locals to music, theatre and dance performances all around the city – completely free of charge! (Tip: Come early to get good seats.)

contact.address: Parks and spaces in Stockholm,  Stockholm

title: LEK MER – Eden Kayak & SUP
label: Activity
text: Lek Mer (Swedish: Play more) provides rentals and courses for paddlers of all skill levels. From this scenic spot, you can easily access the city's beautiful waterways passing famous landmarks like Stockholm City Hall and explore the tranquil Långholm channel. Rent equipment on the spot or book in advance online.

title: Rent-a-bike
label: Activity
text: Rent regular bikes, mountain bikes, and tandems by the hour or for several days. This place is located on the dock of Strandvägen, close to many of Stockholm's attractions including Djurgården. Guided tours are also available.

title: Roomescape by Fox in a Box
label: Activity
text: Train your brain with an exciting and tricky escape-adventures. Fox in a Box has roomescape activities ranging from horror and thriller themes like Zombie Lab or The Zodiac Killer to crime-capers like Life Sentence or Tesla's Mystery.

title: Royal Drottningholm Golf Club
label: Activity
text: Just a stone's throw from Drottningholm Palace lies the green of Royal Drottningholm Golf Club, the venue for the first-ever Volvo Open competition in 1970. The course har a park-like character with an open landscape, as well as forested areas and offers free-play to non-members.

title: Saltsjöbadens Friluftsbad
label: Activity
text: Like a castle made of wood, this open-air bathhouse lies in the sea in the Stockholm suburb of Saltsjöbaden. The building was designed by architect Torben Grut in the early 1900s and is open during the summer.

title: Selma City Spa
label: Activity
text: Selma City Spa, a branch of the highly regarded Selma Spa in Värmland, is located at the top of the Clarion Sign Hotel. They offer spa treatments, gym, sauna – and a popular outdoor pool and bar on the roof terrace.

title: Soccer
label: Activity
text: As in practically all European countries, soccer/football is a beloved sport with many passionate fans in Sweden. Of all the sports in Sweden, it’s also the one with the highest number of club members and active players.The three most prominent Stockholm clubs are AIK (Allmäna Idrottsklubben, nicknamed “Gnaget”), DIF (Djurgårdens Idrottsförening, or simply “Djurgården”) and HIF (Hammarby Idrottsförening, commonly referred to as ”Bajen”), represented by both women’s –and men’s teams.To accommodate for the colder climate, organized league football is played from late spring in April, all through the summer months and up until October. Tickets can be bought either at the arena on game day, through the different clubs’ web pages or (depending on the team and arena) through Ticketmaster, Stockholm Live and Friends Arena.

title: Söderkajak
label: Activity
text: Starting at Söderkajak in Vinterviken you can kayak or SUP to any of your favorite islands in the city. You can easily get to Drottningholm, Långholmen, City Hall and much more. Söderkajak is also a shop, so if you catch the paddling bug, you can buy your own equipment once the tour is over.

title: Sörmlandsleden
label: Activity
text: Sörmlandsleden is one of the longest hiking trails in Sweden. Just south of Stockholm, it stretches over 1,000 kilometers and passes through towns like Nynäshamn, Södertälje, Eskilstuna, Nyköping, Oxelösund, and Trosa.The landscape is varied and diverse, like Sweden in a miniature. The 92 sections let you experience culture and history, mountains and deep forest, lakes, and coastlines. A challenging hike or a Sunday stroll – it’s up to you. Some of the paths are adjusted for people with disabilities.On Sörmlandsleden you can hike for a few hours or several days. For those who wish to stay overnight, there are a number of wind shelters along the way.Looking for a fun challenge while walking? Combine the hike along Sörmlandsleden with geocaching.More information in English about hiking Södermandsleden can be found here.

title: Speedway
label: Activity
text: Sweden has some of the best motorcycle speedway racers (or just speedway, as it’s called here) in the world. In this motorcycle sport, teams compete on an oval dirt track over multiple heats to determine which team has collected the most points and thus won the game.Currently, there are no speedway clubs based in central Stockholm. But one of Sweden’s best teams, Rospiggarna, can be found just north of Stockholm in Hallstavik. The speedway season last from May to August.

title: Stockholm Adventures
label: Activity
text: For those who like adventure and nature, but prefer to eat and sleep comfortably, Stockholm Adventures offers activities and guided tours all year round. During the summer they offer sailing, kayaking, wildlife safaris, bicycle tours, and winter time they will take you out ice skating on natural ice. Choose from either their scheduled tours, or book a private tour.

title: Stockholm Food Tours
label: Activity
text: Eat your way through Stockholm! The tours "Culinary Södermalm" and "The Nordic Experience" will take you to a number of carefully selected restaurants and shops where you will learn about traditions and new influences and enjoy delicious samples.

title: Stockholm Ghost Walk
label: Activity
text: Join The Stockholm Ghost Walk for 90 minutes of history and mystery in the Old Town. Stockholm Ghost Walk takes you on a walk steeped in history and brings to life stories of legends, diseases, murders and of course, ghosts. Explore the dark streets and alleyways that make up the oldest parts of Stockholm.

title: Stockholm SUP
label: Activity
text: Enjoy a fun summer activity while seeing Stockholm city from the water – try Stand Up Paddleboard! You’ll find the renter Stockholm SUP in Gröndal right in front of Reimersholme. The friendly staff will help you with the right board and knowledge according to your level. Rent a board and explore the city built on water on your own, or why not try their Big SUP for up to 8 people? They also offer kayak rentals

title: Sturebadet
label: Activity
text: Enjoy this luxury spa milieu from the 1800s with pool, exercise equipment, and spa treatments from head to toe. Parties of up to 20 persons can also hire the private Turkish bath floor.

title: Surfbussen
label: Activity
text: Surfbussen offers SUP-rentals (stand up paddleboard) and accompanied paddling. Starting in the calm waters of Karlbergssjön, you can easily paddle your way to the City Hall in 30 minutes. Or, join the kite school that certifies students with the International Kiteboarding Organization. They also offer electric hydrofoil.

title: Tanto SUP och Kajak
label: Activity
text: Rent a kayak or a SUP (Standup Paddleboard) for a day of exploration of the waters around Södermalm. Tanto SUP och Kajak helps you gear up during the summer season (June through August) to enjoy the waterways of central Stockholm.

title: Tensta Parkour
label: Activity
text: Tensta Parkour, in the northern suburb of Tensta, is Stockholm’s first public parkour course. Suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike, it offers visitors a wide variety of obstacles to traverse and climb. The park located is just a short walk from Tensta station on the subway’s blue line.

title: The Green Trails
label: Activity
text: The Green Trails organizes guided outdoor experiences and day trips around Stockholm, year-round and close to both the city and the water. In summer, the program includes a shorter sailing tour in the city, a mountain bike safari in a nature reserve, and an outdoor cooking experience focused on edible plants and a three-course meal.
