The lunch restaurant, located in the NK department store, was completed in 1915 and its early 20th-century interior breathes elegance and fine dining. Since 2015 Bobergs is owned by Björn Frantzén, of Frantzén fame, and serves French classics with a Nordic touch.

title: Magnus Johansson Bageri & Konditori
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Magnus Johansson has made dessert for the Nobel banquet a total of 11 times, which makes him the current record holder! At his own café and bakery in Hammarby Sjöstad you'll get a taste of his pastries, cakes, cookies, bread and buns. Also in Hammarby Sjöstad, just a stone's throw away, you'll find Magnus Johansson Glass & Konfektyr where you'll be treated to artisan ice cream and sweets.

title: Inferno Online Södermalm
label: Activity
text: Inferno Online is kitted with virtually every popular computer game right now, Sweden's first Xbox arena, and a selection of NES games for the retro aficionado. They also regularly host boot camps for anyone wanting to hone their skills, all-night gaming, and e-sport tournaments. Inferno Online is an inclusive space open for all ages.

contact_text.text: Inferno Online also has branches in Täby Centrum, in northern Stockholm.

title: Villa Wera
label: Restaurant
text: The breakfast and lunch restaurant Villa Wera in Solna describe their menu as “homemade 2.0”; beloved classics and contemporary dishes made with great craftsmanship and from carefully selected produce.

title: Cirkus
label: Attraction
text: Cirkus on the island of Djurgården was built in 1892, as a permanent venue for travelling cirkus troupes visiting Stockholm. The popularity of cirkus shows might have declined since then, but Cirkus has evolved and the grandiose building is a beloved arena for concerts, musicals, stage productions and other events. Since 1983 Cirkus has been designated as an listed building, and 2015 saw the opening of it's modern annex Skandiascenen.

title: Kayakomat by Point 65 Sweden
label: Activity
text: Experience Stockholm from the water by kayak or on a SUP board when it suits you. New, comfortable and stable kayaks from leading brand Point 65 Sweden, life jackets, and accessories are included. Available in many locations. Book online – unlock with a code – paddle!

title: Vrak – Museum of Wrecks
label: Museum
text: Nowhere else in the world are there as many well-preserved wooden wrecks as in the Baltic Sea. Discover their fascinating stories at Vrak – Museum of Wrecks! Vrak takes you on a deep dive among the wrecks and remains of the Baltic Sea. With the help of digital technology, the museum takes the stories to the surface but leaves the wrecks on the bottom where they are best preserved. The museum is located on the island of Djurgården in Stockholm, with former shipyards, shipwrecks, and the Baltic Sea itself just around the corner.

title: Café Pascal Södermalm
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Pascal has four locations; Odenplan and Gävlegatan in Vasastan, Skånegatan on Södermalm, and Sturegatan in Östermalm. All are defined by their generous sandwiches, a large selection of pastries, and freshly brewed coffee.

title: Nour
label: Restaurant
text: Nour is a stylish but intimate restaurant best described as alternative fine dining. Restaurant manager Sayan Isaksson – known for Michelin-starred Esperanto and Imouto – describes the feeling as "coming home to someone for dinner". The cuisine is Nordic with Japanese influences, with ingredients following the changing of the seasons.

contact_text.text: Nour received its first Michelin star in 2022.

title: Två Små Svin
label: Restaurant
text: Två Små Svin has specialized in Danish smørrebrøds with various tasty toppings. The small restaurant in the suburb of Årsta also serves Chech beer, and akvavit, and schnaps from its own distillery.

title: Knut
label: Restaurant
text: At Knut restaurant and bar in central Stockholm, guests can enjoy northern Swedish cuisine and try various specialties and delicacies such as game stew, minced moose steak, northern Swedish style pizza. Knut has two locations; at Upplandsgatan 17, and Regeringsgatan where brunch is served every Saturday between 11.30 and 15.30.

title: Texas Longhorn Gamla Stan
label: Restaurant
text: Texas Longhorn is a Swedish chain of steakhouse restaurants focused on American bbq classics. Burgers, ribs, bangers, and steaks with a side of fries, coleslaw, or mac 'n cheese. There are several locations in Stockholm; Gamla Stan, Flemminggatan, Hornsbergs Strand, and Upplandsgatan to name a few.

title: Hernö Gin Bar
label: Bar
text: Award-winning Hernö Gin became Sweden's first gin distillery in 2011, and in 2021 the company opened a bar at Södermalm in Stockholm. Focusing unsurprisingly on gin drinks and cocktails, both classics and new creations, the bar also has a light menu with snacks and smaller dishes.

title: Omayma
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: It's never too late to start your day at Omayma, a café on Södermalm that serves breakfast all day long. The menu has many vegan and gluten-free options, and they also serve lunch, fika, and weekend brunch.

title: Coquetel Social
label: Bar
text: Cocktailbar Coquetel Social on Stureplan is a classy, yet homey bar, serving wine, beer and classics drinks. If your behind on trying out a Whiskey Sour, Gibson, Daiquiri, Godfather, Cosmopolitan or Side Car this is a great place to start.

title: Siv & Åke
label: Shop
text: The vintage-boutique Siv & Åke is located on Sankt Paulsgatan on Södermalm, just a short walk from Mariatorget subway station. Here you'll find timeless and carefully selected clothes, bags, and accessories from the 90s, 80s, 70s, and 60s.

title: Restaurang Nabo
label: Restaurant
text: Just next to Tegnérlunden Park, in central Stockholm, you'll find Restaurang Nabo; a spacious brasserie that still has that homey feeling of a neighborhood restaurant. The menu is a mix of Swedish flavors, restaurant classics, great wines, and innovative cocktails.

title: Bar Apropos
label: Bar
text: Cozy Bar Apropos in the Vasastan district harkens back to the prohibition years of the 1920s and secret speakeasy bars. A light menu bar menu with snacks and Tarte flambé, beer, wine, and a mix of drinks that are both new inventions and reimaginings of cocktail classics. And if you ask nicely, the bartender might guide you to the bar-in-a-bar The Blind Buther.

title: PS Vin & Mat
label: Restaurant
text: For over 20 years PS has run a studio for cooking classes, conferences, and private events at Nytorget. Since 2020 they also run a restaurant, catering to everybody who likes a tasty meal with a glass of exciting wine. The cuisine is a blend of dishes from Sweden, the Mediterranean, and the Middle East and the wine list collects new and talked-about wines.

title: Moyagi
label: Bar
text: Karaoke bar Moyagi is located in central Stockholm, at Brunkebergs square. Every party gets their own room, with sound equipment, widescreen tv, tables, and comfortable sofas. Song selection can be made through the Singa-app, food, and beverage orders are made through a tablet in the room. Besides beer, wine, and drinks, Moyagi serves Asian fusion tapas like miso fries, spring rolls, and bao.

title: Humana Mariatorget
label: Shop
text: Humana is a second-hand chain with two stores in Stockholm; on Norrmalm and Södermalm. Both stores offer a curated selection of vintage clothes, shoes and accessories. The Humana store in Mariatorget offers the latest fashion trends, vintage designer pieces and unique finds in the middle of hip Södermalm. You can also hand in clothes you don't use anymore and give them a second chance. Humana Second Hand is part of the non-profit association Humana sweden, where all the surplus goes to various development projects around the globe.

title: Stockholms Stadmission Nytorget
label: Shop
text: Stockholms Stadsmission have several stores in the Stockholm-area. On Södermalm alone they have two; one at Nytorget and one on Hornsgatan. Here you'll find second hand clothes, furniture, books, music, kitchen ware and much more. Stockholms Stadsmission also run the fashion brand Remake, with garments made from recycled clothes and materials.

title: Pop Stockholm
label: Shop
text: Pop Stockholm deals in handpicked clothes and accessories from the '50s, '60s', '70s, '80s an '90s. In other words you'll find cool leather jackets, colorful shirts and skirts, and comfy t-shirts and sweatshirts alike.

title: Hedengrens Bokhandel
label: Shop
text: Hedengrens Bokhandel is one of the oldest bookstores in Stockholm, dating back to 1897. The shop has wide selection of Swedish and international literature of all kinds. Besides the shop at Grev Turegatan, Hedengrens also has a web shop with world-wide shipping.

title: Asket
label: Shop
text: Asket started out as a men's wear brand in 2015 but has since then branched out into women's clothes as well. Sustainability and transparency are paramount to Asket's ethos. The materials are selected with great care from farms and factories around the world, and the company practices full transparency when it comes to detailing the production chain and costs of its garments. The company's flagship store is located at Norrmalmstorg in Stockholm, but they also offer worldwide shipping.

title: Bergsgruvan's park and playground
label: Park
text: Bergsgruvans park and playground on Södermalm is located just a short walk from Södra Station's commuter train station. Here you'll find a fun jungle gym, a sandbox, swings and several activities with accessibility features.

title: Matsu Sushi Bar
label: Restaurant
text: The small sushi parlor is almost in the middle of the long, long Hornsgatan street on Södermalm. Its relative closeness to Skinnarviksberget and Mariatorget makes the restaurant a great place for take-away lunch on a warm on a beautiful day.

title: The Tea Centre of Stockholm
label: Shop
text: The Tea Centre of Stockholm opened in 1979 and has provided the residents of Södermalm with delicious a aromatic tea blends since then. Their most famous tea is the Söderblandning, originally called the "Accidental blend" since it was made from a tea leaves that were dropped and mixed up on the floor.

title: Fållan
label: Nightclub
text: Nightclub and concert venue Fållan opened up in 2019 in Stockholm's former meatpacking district Slakthusområdet. In 2024 Fållan moved into bigger and renovated digs, just a stone's throw from the old location. The programming is a cross-genre blend of dance music, hip-hop, indie, and hard rock, and mixes concerts and club parties with smaller festivals.

title: Dionysos
label: Restaurant
text: Dionysos on Södermalm is one of the oldest greek restaurants in Stockholm, having opened in 1974. The menu offers classic dishes like souvlaki, biffteki and typical greek seafood dishes.

title: L:A Bruket
label: Shop
text: L:A Bruket makes its own artisan soap, lotion, shampoo, conditioner, and various other skincare products. Everything is made from natural and sustainable ingredients. The company was founded in Varberg, on the western coast of Sweden, and the Stockholm shop is located on Södermalm.

title: A Day's March
label: Shop
text: A Day's March is a Swedish fashion brand selling simple an stylish design, with a focus on making the production chain sustainable. The Stockholm store is located on Nytorgsgatan, in the heart of Södermalm.

title: Bistro Marie
label: Restaurant
text: French, Italian and Swedish culinary tradition all come together at Bistro Marie, for a relaxed dinner with something tasty for everyone. The restaurant also has a well-stocked wine cooler and a generous menu of refreshing drinks.

title: Vanadislunden
label: Park
text: Vanadislunden, named after the Norse goddess Vanadis/Freya, is one of Stockholm's largest parks. Here you'll find several jungle gyms, walking paths among the trees, and a fantastic view of Stockholm. During the summer months, you can also take a swim in the open-air swimming pool Vanadisbadet.

title: Östergårds
label: Restaurant
text: Östergårds is a former estate-turned-conference center and events space for private receptions and parties. You'll also find a popular restaurant here that serves both lunch and dinner.

title: Peppar
label: Restaurant
text: Peppar is a beloved restaurant in Vasastan known for its American-inspired menu and its garish and kitschy interior. Peppar's over-the-top Christmas decorations have become something of a holiday tradition.

title: Kronobergsparken
label: Park
text: Kronobergsparken on Kungsholmen was made into a public park in the early years of the 20th century. Formerly the site of a mill, its a beloved oasis for the residents of Kungsholmen with both lush greenery and a playground for children.

title: Söderbergs Bageri
label: Café
text: At Söderbergs Bakery near Telefonplan, you will find a wide range of bread, buns, and cakes. They also offer freshly roasted 100% organic coffee that you can enjoy on the outdoor terrace or as a takeaway.

title: Il Caffé Drottninggatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Take a well-deserved coffee break in the heart of busy Norrmalm at one of the local’s favorite “fika” spots. Unpretentious and cozy, Il Caffé offers pastries, simple lunches, and fresh bread from its own bakery. Check out their other locations, too!

title: Kaferang Gamla Brogatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The trendy Kaferang has two locations, one in Norrmalm and one in the heart of SoFo at Nytorget. Both serve refreshing snacks and brunch, and hearty lunch sandwiches if your appetite is larger.

title: Jensen I Sleepacy
label: Shop
text: Sleepacy on Norrmalm is the world's first sleep concept store. Besides selling unique beds, tailored to your personal needs, the stor carries bed linnen, pajamas, pillows and other sleep-related accessories, all designed with the latest in sleep science in mind. The store also offers sleep coaching to help troubled sleepers get their nightly routines in order.

title: Myrqvist
label: Shop
text: Swedish shoe brand Myrqvist produce menswear in a variety of models. Both sneakers in suede and leather and fancier shoes like loafers and brogues. The store is located in the MOOD Gallerian mall in central Stockholm, but the shoes are crafted by hand in Portugal.

title: Restaurang Artes
label: Restaurant
text: Artes is a Spanish restaurant located in Kulturhuset, but with a separate entrance from Drottninggatan. The menu is mainly Spanish, with a small selection of mains and quite a few smaller tapas-dishes to chose from.

title: Ganni
label: Shop
text: Danish fashion brand Ganni is famous for its bold use of vivid colors and patterned textiles. The company's Stockholm location is located on Norrlandsgatan in central Stockholm.

title: Mancini
label: Restaurant
text: Mancini on Tunnelgatan has been hailed as the best Italian restaurant in Sweden by Gambero Rosso magazine. The menu is genuinely Italian and is accompanied by a wine list with a bottle of delicious bianchi, rossi, spumati, or dessert wine to go with any meal.

title: Ricordi
label: Restaurant
text: Italian restaurant Ricordi leans on memories, both with an interior that breathes vintage elegance and a name that translates to "memories", for a dinner experience that you'll hopefully remember for a long time. The menu is modern Italian; timeless classics with a twist.

title: Nygårdsanna
label: Shop
text: Swedish brand Nygårdsanna, founded by Anna Bengtsson, has two stores in Stockholm. One on Mäster Samulesgatan, and a summer-pop-up store in Old Town selling garments from past collections. Their low-key clothes are made from naturally sourced materials and in natural colors. True to its sustainable company profile Nygårdsanna also offers in-store repairs on any garments that need some extra love.

title: Blommor från Norrmalmstorg
label: Shop
text: Blommor från Norrmalmstorg has been selling flowers at Norrmalms square since 1998. Here you'll find lovely bouquets for your home or to give a loved one, but can also pre-order arrangements for weddings, parties, or other functions.

title: Lyko
label: Shop
text: Family business Lyko is one of Sweden's leading online stores for beauty products, hair products, and skin lotions. They also operate several physical stores, like Concept Skin on Birger Jarlsgatan. Primarily focused on skin lotions, the store also offers various therapies and treatments on-site.

title: Norrmalms Elektriska
label: Shop
text: Norrmalms Elektriska has been around since 1917 and moved to their current location in 1924. In the beginning the store sold various home utensils, but as time has gone by has refined its business to specialize on lamps, bulbs and armatures.

title: CHIMI
label: Shop
text: Swedish eyewear-brand CHIMI was founded by childhood friends Daniel Djurdjevic and Charlie Lindström in 2016.  Their collections are inspired by iconic designs, made in handcrafted Italian acetate

title: Åkersbro & co
label: Activity
text: Kayak, SUP rental, and summer café are located next to Åker's canal by the small wooden bridge on Norrö. In the canal, it is safe to paddle, play and swim. The outdoor café offers ice cream and coffee. Playful courses are arranged for children and young people who want to learn to paddle a kayak.

title: Italienaren i Gubbängen
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: In a short period of time, Italienaren i Gubbängen has become the obvious weekend-hangout spot for the residents of the Stockholm suburb of Gubbängen. The small café is also a gelateria, pizzeria and Italian deli all rolled up into one. The ice cream is made on-site and is classically creamy Italian gelato and sorbet.

title: Restaurang Drama
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurang Drama is a bistro located at the Filmstaden Scandinavia-multiplex movie theater in Solna. Enjoy drinks, something to eat or order something to bring with you into the Scandinavia's VIP-cinema.

title: Ängsö Nationalpark
label: Park
text: Ängsö Nationalpark is located on the island of the same name, in the northern Stockholm archipelago. The park is famous for its beautiful flora and its preserved 19th century farmlands. Ängsö is only reachable by boat. Either by docking with your own at one of the islands natural harbors, or taking a ferry from central Stockholm.

title: Tyresö Palace
label: Attraction
text: Tyresö Palace is beautifully situated by Kalvfjärden in the municipality of Tyresö, south of Stockholm. The castle was built in the 1630s but nowadays you can see it the way it looked like as a private residence around 1900. The castle is open in the summer for weekend tours. The beautiful parks around Tyresö Castle are open to visitors all year round. Nearby there is a café, a restaurant, a garden shop, and a hostel.

title: La Belle Epoque
label: Restaurant
text: Situated in the Kung Carl Hotel, right by famed night-life area Stureplan, La Belle Epoque is one of Stockholm's newest French-inspired bistros. They specialize in mussels or, as it is more commonly known, moules. With Northern Atlantic being the menu's backbone you will also find other frequent regulars on the menu such as lobster, crayfish, oysters, steak tartar, dry-aged steaks, and tuna.

title: Coup d'Etat
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurateur Erik Videgård has, for several decades, introduced new cuisines to the Swedish masses and has run a wide variety of successful restaurants with eclectic orientations. The Coup d'Etat restaurant aims to create something luxurious and appealing to everyone, with Persian cuisine as its foundation and influences from France, Russia, India and Turkey. Videgård himself describes such a bold endeavour as nothing less than –that's right – a coup.

title: Gazza
label: Restaurant
text: Gazza is a spaghetteria with craft pasta at its core. The menu varies, but can include anolini – small saucers filled with liquid parmesan – or ravioli with rabbit ragu, lardo and sage. They spend days making the foccacia just right and the espresso machine is, of course, imported straight from Milano. If you're not one for pasta, stracciatella cheese, charcuterie and carne cruda are also on the menu, but Book in advance, because the room tends to get filled quickly.

title: Hasselsons
label: Restaurant
text: "Fast food from the sea" is the Hasselson motto. From its humble beginnings as a hole-in-the-wall food hatch in the Gothenburg archipelago, Hasselsson has now finally established himself in Stockholm. The short but sweet menu includes seafood super hits such as moules frites, fish & chips as well as their crispy fish burger. Tasty!

title: Stockholms Aeter- & Essencefabrik
label: Shop
text: Stockholms Aeter- & Essencefabrik opend up for business in 1889, which makes it one of the oldest stores in Stockholm. The shop, which has much of the old interior intact, specializes in spices, essences, natural coloring agents and other aromatic products.

title: Panem
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Panem is latin for "bread" and fittingly enough also a bakery in Gamla stan, serving up freshly baked bread, rolls and buns everyday. Panem also doubles as a bistro with a menu of lighter snacks, like sandwiches and pizza slices, with a glass of beer or wine.

title: Hökens gata 2
label: Attraction
text: In the Millenium-books, the corner of Hökens gata and Götbacksbacken is notable for being the adress where the eponymous Millenium magazine has it's editorial offices, on the second floor of the building.

title: Sneakershyllan
label: Shop
text: Sneakershyllan is a treasure trove for vintage sneaker aficionados. You'll find both oldies-but-goldies and rare collectibles, and if you have any old sneakers just collecting dust in your wardrobe Sneakershyllan accepts trade-ins.

contact.address: Sneakershyllan, Westfield Mall of Scandinavia, Stjärntorget, Stockholm, Sweden, 169 79
contact.label: sneakershyllan.se

title: Röda Huset
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurant and bar Röda Huset (literally: "The Red House") is located fittingly enough in the red building overlooking Sergels Torg from Malmskillnadsgatan. The drink menu is designed by award-winning bartender Hampus Thunholm and incorporates local flavors from Sweden like carrots, plums, and raspberries.

title: Maxos
label: Restaurant
text: "The best falafel in town" is a confident slogan, but the long lines around lunchtime prove that Maxos delivers what they promise. Of course, middle-east staples such as merguez and börek are served here. Besides, the owners swear that the entire menu is just as delicious as in the town Akko – "the gastronomic heart of Palestine".

title: L'Usine Bleue
label: Shop
text: L'Usine Bleue is all about durable and no-nonsense French workwear. The small boutique, located in the heart of Södermalm, stocks caps, shirts, shoes, pants, and more, carefully selected from brands that are known for durability and climate-friendly business philosophies.

title: Soth's Kitchen
label: Restaurant
text: Soth's Kitchen is located at Courtyard by Marriott, on Kungsholmen. As an all-day eatery, guests are welcome for breakfast, lunch, or a relaxing dinner. The menu is grounded in Swedish seasonal cooking but with international influences.

title: Omnipollos Flora
label: Bar
text: Omnipollos Flora, run by Stockholm craft brewery Omnipollo, mixes relaxed bar vibes with an inner-city picnic. Open during spring and summer in Humlegården, the bar serves unique brews under the lush, green foliage of the park's trees. Don't miss the ice cream.

title: Paradox Museum Stockholm
label: Museum
text: Paradox Museum is an experience-based museum in central Stockholm. Its interactive exhibition challenges and toys with visitors' perception with over 70 installations, objects, and rooms. Experience revolving walls, meet a piano that composes personalized melodies, and step into a room where children grow past their tiny parents.

title: Fullersta Gård
label: Museum
text: Fullersta Gård is a 17th-century mansion in southern Stockholm and one of the oldest settlements in the municipality of Huddinge. Today the estate has been turned into a modern art museum but also has a permanent exhibition with works by Karin Boye, and Ewert Karlsson.

title: Avicii Experience
label: Museum
text: Avicii Experience is an interactive museum honoring one of the true icons of modern popular culture, as well as one of the most prolific Swedish songwriters, producers, and artists of our time; Tim "Avicii" Bergling. Discover unpublished music and untold stories, sing VR karaoke, and perform in front of thousands of screaming fans in this immersive exhibition. The exhibition celebrates the music and sheds light on the artist in touching and inspiring ways.

title: Ramen Ki-mama
label: Restaurant
text: Ramen Ki-mama precedes the Swedish ramen trend by almost 20 years. The small restaurant opened up in the early aughts as Stockholm's first (and for a long time only) eatery dedicated to Japanese noodle soups. The menu is simple, packed with flavor, and has made the hole in the wall restaurant a Vasastan-classic.

title: Racamaca
label: Restaurant
text: Small and cozy Södermalm-restaurant Racamaca quickly garnered attention for its Basque-inspired tapas. Garbanzo, boquerones, and chistorra-sausage turn up in unusual combinations coupled with a great selection of wine and beer.

title: Las Brasas
label: Restaurant
text: The tapas menu on Las Brasas in Vasastan mixes the classically Spanish with typically Nordic ingredients. Manchego, pulpo, and pata negra meet trout, leaks, and cabbage. And if you're still hungry for more the restaurant's barbecue offers a selection of prime cuts.

title: Magari Pizza
label: Restaurant
text: Nicolas Cappiello and Giuseppe De Bernardo founded Magari Pizza with the ambition of bringing Stockholm the authentic taste of the Campania region – "where the real Italian pizza was born". Apart from its eponymous specialty, Magari Pizza serves tasty pasta dishes for lunch on weekdays. Gourmet Italophiles will also be happy to find the menu rife with Neapolitan antipasti and desserts, such as the famous babà roll!

title: Capital
label: Bar
text: The roof bar Capital is located on the 8th floor of the hotel Scandic Contiental. Here you get one of the most beautiful views of Stockholm. Great emphasis is placed on well-designed signature cocktails with a continental touch. The bar menu also includes a wine list, a large selection of beers, and bar food.

title: Fjäderholmarnas Krog
label: Restaurant
text: Fjäderholmarnas Krog is located on Stockholms closest archipelago island, Fjäderholmarna. The menu offers both meat and vegetarian options, but primarily lots of fish and seafood. The restaurant is open during the summer season but also serves a popular Christmas buffet in December.

title: Möja värdshus & bageri
label: Restaurant
text: Möja värdshus & bageri has been the obvious meeting place on the small island of Möja, since the 1960s. The restaurant is open all year round, serving fresh seafood and restaurant classics, and during the summer season also opens up a small bakery.

title: La Barra
label: Restaurant
text: La Barra wants to take a piece of Spain to Stockholm, or Stockholmers on a trip to Spain if you will. Not only with their tapas dishes which are unmistakenly Spanish, but with a relaxed a lively atmosphere buzzing around the large bar in the middle of the dining room.

title: The National Library of Sweden (Kungliga Biblioteket)
label: Attraction
text: The National Library of Sweden (Kungliga biblioteket, or just KB) is tasked with preserving and storing everything that is published in Sweden, whether it's a school book, fashion magazine, a DVD movie, or a news bulletin broadcast on the radio. Its vast collection includes well over 18 million items, of which the oldest are over a thousand years old. KB has been housed in its current location, in the middle of Humlegården park, since 1877.

title: Eden
label: Restaurant
text: Eden is located at the far end of Smedsudden, in a historic 19th-century building formerly known as Annexet. Today, it’s a modern restaurant, bar, and entertainment venue. Now featuring a new food concept, 'Eden Gone Fishing' – a tribute to fish, seafood, and rustic simplicity. Swedish ingredients meet the aromas and flavors of the Mediterranean. In addition to the food, you'll find Eden’s intimate club floor, where the calendar features everything from daytime parties to guest appearances, theme weeks, and spritz evenings.

title: Myrorna Mäster Samuelsgatan
label: Shop
text: Myrorna i Sweden's largest chain of second-hand shops. A part of The Salvation Army's Swedish chapter, Myrorna can be found in several locations in Stockholm. The most central shop is at Mäster Samulesgatan.

title: Hemma Hos Annika
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: The café, restaurant, and shop Hemma Hos Annika (At Annika's home) is located in Ängby castle that was built in 1692-1696. You can enjoy your coffee or lunch in homey, cozy premises inside or outdoors in a lush park environment. There is also the possibility to book meetings and parties here.

title: Texas Longhorn Hammarby Sjöstad
label: Restaurant
text: Texas Longhorn is a Swedish chain of steakhouse restaurants focused on American bbq classics. Burgers, ribs, bangers, and steaks with a side of fries, coleslaw, or mac 'n cheese. There are several locations in Stockholm; Hammarby Sjöstad, Gamla Stan, and Kungsholmen for example.

title: Sjöstaden Skybar
label: Bar
text: At top of Sthlm 101, the tallest building in Hammarby Sjöstad, you'll find Sjöstaden Skybar. Enjoy the view, overlooking Södermalm and Stockholm's southern suburbs, while sipping on a drink or something nice to eat from a menu mixing various restaurant classics. For busy parents, they also offer a nanny service to take care of the kids – free of charge.

title: Capricci
label: Restaurant
text: An Italian restaurant and bar at Hornstulls strand. Neapolitan pizza, pasta, and other Italian delicacies are served here. Experience dinner in the sparkling new restaurant or enjoy a glass of wine on the outdoor terrace.

title: Pong Henriksdal
label: Restaurant
text: Family-friendly Pong is a chain of pan-Asian restaurants that can be found in several locations in Stockholm. The menu is a mix of some of the most beloved dishes of Asian cooking; sushi, dim sum, gyoza, and pad thai.

title: Tezukuri Sushi
label: Restaurant
text: Tezukuri is a sushi restaurant, located by the shore of Lake Hammarby in Hammarby Sjöstad. Chose between a selection of maki, sashimi, and moriwase or a warm dish like gyoza, tempura and yakitori.

title: Lek Mer – Pampas Kayak & SUP
label: Activity
text: Lek Mer (Swedish: Play more) offers paddling opportunities for both beginners and more experienced seafarers. Through guided tours, visitors can explore Stockholm's unique waterscape,from relaxing sunset outings to exciting winter adventures.The company has several locations in Stockholm, including on Kungsholmen.

contact.address: LEK MER | Pampas kajak & SUP, Karlbergs strand, Solna, Sweden, 171 73 Solna
contact.label: lekmer.nu

title: Kennys Gelato Sickla
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: In 2022 Kenny Mattsson – founder and namesake of Kennys Gelato – was crowned Swedish ice cream master at the national ice cream championships. The flavors at his parlor vary from timeless classics (vanilla, chocolate, pistachio) to creative combinations (rhubarb and cardamom, lemon, and ginger sherbert).  Currently, Kennys Gelato has seven locations: at Markusplatsen Square in Sickla; just outside The Viking Museum on Djurgården; by the docks in Tollare; in Nacka Centrum, between Nacka Forum and the fire station; at Kungsbroplan; at Sergelterassen; and at Malmskillnadsgatan 15.

title: Golfbaren Nacka Strand
label: Activity
text: The Nacka Strand Golf Bar is beautifully situated by the water with the archipelago as a backdrop and offers enjoyable mini golf for the whole family or a group of friends, as well as good food and drinks on a large outdoor terrace.The Golf Bar franchises currently span four courses in Stockholm. Three outdoor courses open in the summer, and one indoor facility open all year round.

title: Stockholm Roast
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Stockholm Roast wants to challenge both the coffee industry and coffee lovers' tastebuds. In practice, this means building personal relationships with sustainable farms all over the world. You can taste the fruits of their labor at their café in Slakhusområdet or buy a bag for home-brewing and you'll also find a selection of coffee essentials like mugs, glasses, and coffee makers.

title: Boule & Berså
label: Activity
text: Boule & Berså is a summer-open petanque bar, secluded under the Danvik bridge in Nacka. As long as the weather permits, B&B is a great place for some summer-petanque, a simple meal, or a drink by the waterfront.

title: Schmaltz
label: Restaurant
text: Swedish cuisine meets European staples at Schmaltz, in a setting and presentation inspired by New York-style deli culture. The menu offers patées, pickles, fish, bagels, and Reuben sandwiches, as well as coffee and classic drinks.

title: SkiStar Sports & Adventures
label: Activity
text: In 2022 Skistar opened its summer activity park at the Hammarbybacken ski slope. Activities include ziplining, several mountain tube tracks, a speedy mountain coaster, and special grass for summer skiing. In other words, you don't have to wait for winter and snow for a great day on the slopes anymore!

title: Hornsbergs strandpark
label: Park
text: Hornsbergs strandpark is a relatively new park, located at Kungsholmen's northern shore. The park consists of a walking path, running along the water, with several great spots for a nice summer swim along the way.

title: Vinterviksbadet
label: Activity
text: Vinterviksbadet is beautifully located in the small gulf called Vinterviken. You'll find the beach just a short walk from Gröndal's tram station but another great option is to travel to Aspudden and take a nice walk along the water until you reach the beach.

title: Grisslinge havsbad
label: Activity
text: Grisslinge havsbad by Grisslinge bay on Värmdö. The beach is easy to get to by local transportation, with several busses from Slussen stopping just by the beach. You'll find changing booths, port-a-potties, and a jungle gym here. And if you forgot to bring lunch or snacks, there's a restaurant and café by the bus stop.

title: GuideU
label: Activity
text: A guide app dedicated to the rich history of Gamla stan (the Old town) with several audio tours to choose from while exploring the old streets and buildings. Currently, there are 4 tours to choose from, and GuideU:s geofence feature automatically plays audio when you're near a point of interest. The app is free to download, but unlocking individual tours come at an additional fee. The tours are available in Swedish, English, German, French, and Danish.

title: Bio Aspen
label: Activity
text: Independent movie theatre screened its first movie in the 1940s, but the cinema closed its doors in 1962. A number of tenants later, and after a longer period of just standing empty, the cinema reopened in 2019 as a cozy single-screen movie theater. The renovated cinema has room for 81 moviegoers, as well as a bistro that doubles as a venue for smaller events and concerts.

title: Sandemar nature reserve
label: Park
text: Sandemar nature reserve is located around its namesake rural manor. The reserve is famous for its coastal meadows, a flora of rare flowers, and is a popular destination for bird watchers. The easiest way to reach Sandemar is by taking the commuter train to handed and then switching to bus 839.

title: Royal Walks
label: Activity
text: The Royal Walks app offers self-guided walks in beautiful settings through several of Stockholm's royal parks. Discover the parks of Haga, Drottningholm, Tullgarn, Djurgården, and Ulriksdals, and learn about their history and historic landmarks. The app is free and is available in English and Swedish.

title: Stockholm 1793 City Walk
label: Activity
text: The City Museum's self-guided Stockholm 1793 City Walk is based on the book series by Swedish author Niklas Natt och Dag. Available in Swedish and English editions, it leads you to places and events from the three books in the series. In addition, in-depth information is given about life in late 18th-century Stockholm. The tour starts at the City Museum, which also sells the map.

title: Yta
label: Co-working space
text: Industries: allShared desk, lounge: yesOwn desk: yesOffice space: yesVisionIt's never been easier to find the right coworkingspace for your needs. Get free of charge help from our experts to guide you through the market and handle all the showings, dialogue with operators and comparison of offices - or browse our marketplace with real time information on all the rooms and their vacancy in coworkingspaces in Stockholm. By combining traditional brokerage with a powerful platform we help over 200 companies every year to find the right coworkingspace in Stockholm.

title: Äventyrsbanan Stockholm
label: Activity
text: An adventure park located in Älta at the south of Nacka's nature reserve. Here you will find one of Stockholm's longest and fastest ziplines as well as high rope courses for the whole family. Challenge your family or friends on this adventure. Book your visit directly on their website.

contact.address: Äventyrsbanan Stockholm - Höghöjdsbana, Ältavägen, Nacka, Sweden, 138 37 Älta
contact.label: Äventyrsbanan.se

contact_text.text: Open slots for the public are available for spring, summer, and autumn. Only open for group bookings over the wintertime.

title: The Matchstick Palace (Tändstickspalatset)
label: Attraction
text: Ivar Kreuger's opulent palace in central Stockholm is an excellent example of Swedish Grace in architecture, art, and interior design. The work of architect Ivar Tengbom, The Matchstick Palace also features contributions by several of Sweden's most famous artists and designers like Carl Milles, Elsa Gullberg, and Carl Malmsten. Today the listed building is a members club, co-working space, and conference center.

contact.address: Västra Trädgårdsgatan 15, Stockholm, Sweden, SE-111 53 Stockholm
contact.label: tandstickspalatset.se

title: Archipelago day cruise with Viking Line
label: Aktivitet
text: Viking Line's day cruise is an 11-hour trip through Stockholm's lovely archipelago. The ship departs at 7.45 am, and takes the scenic route past the islands and islets of the Archipelago to the Åland Islands where there's a change of ship for the return trip. There are also several restaurants, shops and a spa on board.

title: Sightseeing Ride
label: Activity
text: Sightseeing Ride is a guided tour on electric boat through the waters of central Stockholm. Fascinating stories are mixed with personal and humorous anecdotes on a tour that wants to show a lighter side of Stockholm.

title: Hotel Villa Dagmar
label: Restaurant
text: At Villa Dagmar’s restaurant, Dagmar, the menu is inspired by the Mediterranean, with influences from Southern France and Italy. Here you'll find two of Sweden’s most acclaimed chefs, including Niclas Jönsson, with dishes prepared under the leadership of Head Chef Matias Åslund. The focus is on fresh, seasonal ingredients. Dishes are served alongside a carefully curated selection of wines and cocktails. In the glass-roofed courtyard, you can also enjoy lunch and brunch.

title: Olli
label: Restaurang
text: "Kom tidigt och stanna sent" är Ollis motto. Syditalienska rätter och en imponerande vinlista är blott halva upplevelsen; Ägaren Oliver Ingrosso är som bekant artist med band till flera kända svenska musiker, så du kan förvänta dig extra noggranna låtval i den vackra cocktailloungens högtalare.

title: Riche Fenix
label: Restaurant
text: Riche Fenix is the newborn sibling of Riche, an over-century-old fixture in the Stockholm nightlife in the swanky Östermalm district. This new venue promises "uncomplicated and thoughtful" food made from the finest ingredients – yet with complex flavours! Located in the middle of the hip Södermalm neighbourhood, the brazen bar states it "will stand out like a pink full moon" with the confidence that only generational experience can provide.

title: Index – The Swedish Contemporary Art Foundation
label: Museum
text: Index has been active since 1974, initially as a gallery and magazine showcasing Scandinavian photography and contemporary art. In 2011 the foundation opened its current exhibition hall on Kungsholmen in Stockholm; a gallery where artists are invited to showcase their work, conduct research and interact with their audience through special events and vernissages.

title: Klarabiografen
label: Activity
text: Klarabiografen is located in Kulturhuset and describes itself as "Stockholm's most central cinema". In addition to its program of movies, Klara is a popular festival cinema and has a busy schedule of special screenings and events. Its film club, for example, has monthly screenings of curated films.

title: Happy Day Racing Experience
label: Activity
text: Happy Day's Racing Experience lets you take a seat behind the wheel on some of the world's most popular sports cars;  Mercedes AMG GTR,  Porsche Cayman,  Mercedes AMG GT 63S. The experience can be booked during the summer season, May-September. You'll get to drive the cars at Drivelab Test Track 1 in Arlanda, one of Scandinavia's most modern test tracks.

title: IKEA City
label: Shop
text: An 8,000 square meter store spanning three floors in the shopping center Gallerian is part of IKEA's major investment in Stockholm. At IKEA City you will find a wide range of home furnishing products and shop in their second-hand store. IKEA's specialists and interior designers can help you plan your home interiors. And of course, at IKEA City you can eat meatballs!

title: Golden Hits
label: Nightclub
text: Three dancefloors, karaoke and dinner shows – Golden Hits aims to give its guests a complete all-night experience. The establishment opened its doors 1992 and has established itself as a polar opposite of the exclusive, "cool" side of the nightclub scene. At Golden Hits, you can expect to recognize the songs being played (hence the name), and perhaps this is the reason for its mixed clientele – with different generations dancing and singing the night away, side by side.

title: Punjabi Masala
label: Restaurant
text: Punjabi Masal serves Indian cuisine that packs a spicy punch. The unassuming restaurant in the suburb of Tensta has a menu full of beloved flavors like Tikka, Karhai, Vindaloo, and Madras.

title: Kista Galleria
label: Shop
text: Kista Galleria, in the northern suburb of Kista, is one of Stockholm's largest shopping malls. Originally built in the late 1970s, the mall was renovated in 2002 and today has over 180 stores, a multiplex cinema, a bowling hall, a go-kart course, and a large food court with a diverse selection of restaurants and flavors.

title: Husbybadet
label: Activity
text: Husbybadet in the northern suburb of Husby is a popular gym and swimming pool. Great for both a swim as well as rest, relaxation, and exercise.

title: Husbygårdsparken
label: Park
text: Husbygårdsparken is beautifully located on the northern side of the large Järvafältet nature area. Besides a playground, slides, and jungle gym there's an old estate nearby with picturesque 19-century cottages housing a café and art hall. During summer there's also a waddling pool, perfect for toddlers and small kids to cool off.

title: Tekniska restaurant
label: Restaurant
text: Future, innovation and sustainability are the starting points of Tekniska restaurant’s modern food concept. The base is vegetarian dishes, cooked using fresh seasonal products. For those who like fish or meat, it is also available on the menu.

title: Pang Pang Festaurang
label: Restaurant
text: Microbrewery Pang Pang, with its innovative and flavorful brews, was one of the first to establish itself during the Swedish beer boom of the 2010s. Besides the brewery and a summer open taproom, Pang Pang runs a restaurant and bar at Hornstull on Södermalm. Here you'll find a selection of beers, ales, and stouts on tap and a menu of snacks and entrees. Early customers during the weekends will also find a hearty brunch menu to start the day with.

title: Alba
label: Restaurant
text: Cozy wine bar Alba welcomed its first guests in May 2022 and quickly became a hotspot for nature wine aficionados and champagne lovers around Nyttorget. The wine list is updated on a weekly basis and the menu is a rustic mix of french and Italian cuisine.

title: Dirty Taco
label: Restaurant
text: Tacos may be a Mexican specialty, but Dirty Taco on Folkungagatan takes culinary cues from the four corners of the world. Here you'll find tacos filled with, for example, Swedish meat, Cypriot halloumi, vegan "kebob" or Vietnamese spices in new and unique combinations.

title: Boulebar Rådhuset
label: Activity
text: French boule, or petanque, is a beloved french pastime normally associated with warm spring and summer days. At Boulebar Rådhuset you can enjoy it all year round, though, at indoor courts below the streets of Kungsholmen. Don't forget to unwind after the game, at Boulebar's restaurant, with something French to eat and drink.

title: Swing by Golfbaren
label: Activity
text: SWING by Golfbaren in Vasastan is a 30's-fell indoor minigolf venue with its own restaurant and bar. Here you can play regardless of weather and combine the game with dinner, drinks, or delicious snacks in the Back Alley Bar.At the time of writing, the golf baren has four minigolf facilities in Stockholm; three outdoor courses open in the summer and one indoor facility.

title: Akalla 4H Farm
label: Activity
text: The non-profit 4H organization was founded in the USA, and today has activities in over 80 countries. Its motto is "learning by doing" which in practical terms means for example tending to, and feeding farm animals. At Akalla 4H kids get to know some of our most common farm animals, like sheep, ponies, and rabbits. Come by to just meet them, sign up for a course or day camp, or just visit the farm and the nearby café.

title: Dagges
label: Bar
text: In the wine bar Dagges you will find the best of Mediterranean wine culture. Take a seat in the bar, in the outdoor area, or on one of the couches and enjoy the music and the great ambiance.

contact.address: Hotel Villa Dagmar, Nybrogatan 25-27, Stockholm, Sweden, 114 39
contact.label: hotelvilladagmar.com

title: Vanak
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurant Vanak in Akalla is all about flavorful Persian cuisine. The family restaurant has a wide selection of traditional barbecue dishes, either meat or vegetarian, served with rice or barbari-bread.

title: New Mamma Africa
label: Restaurant
text: New Mamma Africa specializes in East African cuisine from Ethiopia and Eritrea; spicy stew, deep in flavor, scooped up with traditional Injera bread. The restaurant is located near the Kista Galleria shopping mall, in northern Stockholm.

title: Lavin
label: Restaurant
text: Lunch and dinner restaurant Lavin serves flavorful and homey Middle Eastern and Kurdish cuisine: kebab, shawarma, Quzy chicken and lamb, Tashrib, fasolja, okra stew, and more. The restaurant is located in Kista, in northern Stockholm.

title: Anatolia Kolgrill
label: Restaurant
text: Anatolia specializes in Turkish-style barbecue, cooked over hot charcoal. Get your fill of kebab, iskender, Adana, Mevlana, falafel, or beyti with a generous serving of vegetables and bulgur in this comfort food eatery, located in Husby.

title: Akalla Orient Gross
label: Shop
text: Akalla Orient Gross is a small but well-stocked supermarket where you'll find many otherwise hard-to-find spices, vegetables, and products. Fresh okra and karela, imported spice blends like sumac and baharat and halal cuts of meat

title: Matvärlden
label: Shop
text: Looking for Polish pickles or genuine Thai basil? Armenian Harissa, Ethiopian Injera, or Argentinian dulce de lece? Supermarket Matvärlden (literally meaning "World of Food") is a goldmine for anyone looking for products that are otherwise har-to get in Swedish supermarkets and grocery stores.

title: STHLM Brunch Club
label: Restaurant
text: STHLM Brunch Club in Vasastan is, obviously, all about breakfast and brunch. They say breakfast is the most important meal of the day, after all. So why not make every meal breakfast? Eggs Benedict, bowls, generous brekkies (breakfast plates), sweet pancakes, freak shakes, and coffee. As of 2023, they also have a location on Karlavägen 75.

title: Café Ugo
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Ugo on Kungsholmen is an Italian-style espresso bar, serving espresso, macchiato, americano, cappuccino, and Italian snacks and pastries. Stop by for a quick pick-me-up, brewed on imported beans from San Remo, or stay longer and grab a focaccia or panino as well.

title: Il Caffé Bergsgatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Il Caffé quickly became a favorite coffee haunt for the residents around Nytorget and has since then opened up in several more locations. For example on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm and on Bergsgatan in Kungsholmen. The concept is simple; coffee, Italian-style, with a simple snack like a sandwich or cinnamon bun on the side.

title: Bröd & Salt Hantverkargatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Bröd & Salt is a local chain of artisan bakeries, with locations all over Stockholm. Everything is fresh, made from sourdough, and lactose-free. Besides fresh bread, buns, and cookies Bröd & Salt also has a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps if you’re hungry for lunch!

title: Komet Café
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Cozy café Komet opened in 2021 and soon became one of the most popular cafées and bakeries on Kungsholmen. You'll find French classics, like croissants and pain au chocolate, Swedish favorites like cinnamon buns and seasonal semlas, coffee from Stockholm Roast, and vegetarian sandwiches for lunch.

title: Grain Café
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Porridge is king at Grain Café on Kungsholmen. The café makes its own porridge, all day every day, from local and seasonal ingredients. Grain Café also serves vegan salads, soups, and stews during lunch hours.

title: Volca Coffee Roaster
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Volca Coffee Roaster on Kungsholmen is both a café and a specialized boutique by, and for, coffee aficionados. Take a fika break on location or bring one of their specially imported blends home with you. Coffee is carefully selected by forming personal bonds with the farmers themselves. Volca also offers courses and workshops where you'll be able to take your brewing skills to the next level by learning more about roasting or various coffee drinks.

title: Konditori Genuin
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Konditori Genuin is a cozy hole-in-the-wall bakery and café on Kungsholmen in Stockholm. Here you'll find freshly baked bread, buns as well as lunch salads and sandwiches. The bakeshop prides itself on a large emphasis on sustainability. For example, it uses green energy to power its ovens, locally sourced ingredients, and renewable materials for its packaging.

title: Österlånggatan 17
label: Restaurant
text: Österlånggatan 17 has the atmosphere of a cozy neighborhood restaurant, just a short walk from the Royal Palace in Gamla Stan. The menu offers both small snacks, mid-size dishes, and full meals. Lunch is served every weekday and during weekends you can start your day of Old Town exploration with a hearty brunch.

title: Petit Marché
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Petit Marché is Stockholm's probably smallest market where you can buy flowers and plants, or just enjoy a cup of coffee in a nice cozy environment.

title: BodyBuddy
label: Café
text: Delicious food at BodyBuddy is made with nutrient-dense ingredients that sustain health. They also strive to use organic, local, and seasonal ingredients and minimize food waste and plastic use. BodyBuddy is located inside The Yogayama studio at Jungfrugatan 8 and at Smålandsgatan 24.

title: Fix
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Fix is one of Stockholm's oldest cafés. It was opened in 1910, got popular right from the start and in the 40s it became known as a "celebrity cafe". In 2019, the café was renovated. The premises were modernized but Fix's former glory was preserved by keeping old details. Café Fix offers a large selection of good food: filling hot dishes, sandwiches, and coffee. Here you can also always find vegetarian and vegan options.

title: Wilmer Kungsholmen
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Wilmer is a family business that was started on Kungsholmen in 2011 and has since become a popular and well-visited place in the area. Here you can enjoy a cup of freshly brewed coffee, cakes, and buns, have breakfast, lunch, or buy takeaway.

title: Poli Caffè
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Poli is a nice little espresso bar with delicious coffee and a genuine Italian atmosphere. Caffe Poli has many loyal customers who come here to enjoy an excellent espresso, a pastry, or a panini.

title: By:fiket Stadshagen
label: Restaurant
text: Given that By:fiket stems from the Federation of Swedish Farmers (LRF) their penchant focus on local – often organic – produce, should come as no surprise, nor should its old-timey interiors. The daily specials, posted weekly on Instagram, features culinary fixtures such as Wallenbergare and raggmunk, but also more contemporary favorites such as Teriyaki chicken or pulled pork. All pastries are, of course, made on-site, and should (weather permitting) be enjoyed on the shores of the nearby Karlbergssjön canal.

title: Pom & Flora Vasastan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Pom & Flora runs two cozy neighborhood cafés in Stockholm. One in Södermalm and the second in Vasastan. Popular for its breakfast menu, of bowls, porridge, and sandwiches, Pom & Flora is also a good place for a light lunch or afternoon fika.

title: Stockholm Brewing
label: Bar
text: The Stockholm Brewing Co is located inside a former warehouse in Frihamnen, the free port of Stockholm, and here you can try newly-tapped beer the same day it’s released or beers that have been barrel-aged for up to 30 months. There are guided brewery tours and tastings on Saturdays and it's also possible to book private tours for larger groups. Apart from tasty fresh beers, there's delicious Latin American food from much-hyped Santa Salsa running the restaurant. Dogs are very welcome!

title: Pepstop
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: At Pepstop, food and drinks are handmade from scratch with extra love and in their purest form – plant-based, organic, gluten-free, unprocessed, and without additives. There is also a Matchabar by Renée Voltaire with hot and cold matcha drinks and other green snacks.

title: The Princess Estelle Sculpture Park
label: Attraction
text: The Princess Estelle Cultural Foundation was founded in 2019 on the initiative of Crown Princess Victoria and Prince Daniel. Its purpose is to promote cultural activities in Sweden, and the initial focus will be the development of the Princess Estelle Sculpture Park at Royal Djurgården. With this sculpture project, the Foundation wants to make contemporary art available, to enrich our shared environment, not only for the creation timeless monuments, but also to inspire for discussions and contributing to a better quality of life for everyone in the longer perspective.In the sculpture park, you’ll find contemporary artworks including “Hoop-La” by Alice Aycock, “Life Rings” by Elmgreen & Dragset, “Wind Sculpture in Bronze I” by Yinka Shonibare, “Osagd” by Charlotte Gyllenhammar, “The Inner Flow of Life” by Giuseppe Penone, and “Museum” by Monika Sosnowska.The artist of the year 2026 is Cristina Iglesias, with the sculpture “Aurora Borealis Star Dome.”

title: Scandic Victoria Tower
label: Attraction
text: Scandic Victoria Tower is located in the northern Stockholm suburb of Kista. Besides being a great hotel for anyone wanting no more than a short walk to the Kistamässan convention center next door, Victora Tower has a popular sky bar on the 34th floor, offering a magnificent view over the city.

title: Kistamässan Convention Center
label: Activity
text: Kistamässan opened in 2008, as northern Stockholm's largest convention and congress hall. Over a total area of 15 000  m², it features two large convention halls, conference and congress facilities, and three restaurants. The convention center is easily reached by computer train, either going from T-Centralen or Arlanda Airport to Helenelund station.

title: Kista Science Tower
label: Attraction
text: Standing at 124 meters (almost 407 feet) Kista Science Tower is the tallest office building in Stockholm and the fourth tallest buidling in Sweden. Primarily hosting offices from the tech hub Kista Science park, the tower is also a venue for conferences, and has a lunch restaurant at ground level open to the public.

title: Café Portiken
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Portiken is a small and unasuming café on Kungsholmen. Located in the gatehouse of Serafim Park, Portiken serves sandwiches, fika, and lunch every weekday.

title: Järva Discgolfpark
label: Activity
text: Järva Discgolfpark is located in Kista in northern Stockholm. What in the mid-'90s was an overgrown field full of weeds like giant hogweed and warty cabbage today is a popular natural recreational area. The course has even found international renown, having been crowned as the world's best disc golf course in 2020. In addition two the 27-hole course, you'll find a clubhouse with a café and a small shop.

title: Dirty Coco
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Dirty Coco is a campy and fun color explosion located on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm. The café's motto is that life is too short to be boring. This translates into a kitschy and colorful café, serving sweet deserts and pastries, copious bowls, crispy lunch sandwiches, juice, and coffee.

title: Chez Jolie
label: Restaurant
text: Ingmar Bergmas gata 2 is a renowned gastronomic address, having housed several restaurants and bars. The latest, Chez Jolie, is an entirely french affair. A classic bistro, both cozy and posh, with a menu of beloved french classics and a wine cellar full of delicious wines.

title: Årstaviken
label: Park
text: Årstaviken is the area of Lake Mälaren located between Södermalm in the north, Johanneshov/Årsta in the South, the Liljeholms bridge to the west, and the Hammarby floodgate to the east. The cove is a popular area for walks and exercise as there are several outdoor gyms along the way. You'll also pass several popular Södermalm locations like Tantolunden beach, Eriksdalsbadet and the nightclub Trädgården/Under bron.

title: Zum Franziskaner
label: Restaurant
text: Bierhalle Zum Franziskaner is one of Stockholm's oldest restaurants. Opened in 1889, it's been located at its current Old Town address since 1910. Here you can enjoy a menu of classic Swedish and German comfort food like cabbage rolls, Wienerschnitzel, and black pudding. And, naturally, beer from small and independent breweries, some of which are specially brewed for the restaurant.

title: Sandqvist
label: Shop
text: Sandqvist designs bags and accessories for an urban lifestyle. Sustainable materials are combined with meticulously designed details and functionality. Sandqvist describes its products as beautiful and uncomplicated, and we can only agree. The flagship store is located in Södermalm, but there is also a store on Jakobsbergsgatan 9 in Östermalm.

title: Lykke
label: Restaurant
text: At Lykke, the bright ash-tree interiors and hand-picked design chairs hint at the Scandinavian modernity reflected in its menu. The cooks serve Nordic cuisine with a loving twist, flirting with flavors from the Middle East as well as southern Europe. The large community table makes for social brunches and dinners. (And, if you're feeling a bit privately minded, separate seating is available, too.)

title: Tenstadalen
label: Park
text: Tenstadalen is a playground and activity park in the northern Stockholm suburb of Tensta, that opened in the fall of 2022. The new park features several jungle gyms, picnic and barbecue areas, new lighting, and benches. The park also features several areas for training like a parkour track.

title: Cityquizwalks: The Old Town – a Self-Guided Quiz Tour
label: Activity
text: City Quiz Walks combines a city walk and a quiz. You can take on the challenge yourself, or compete in teams with relatives and friends. To get from start to finish, you follow maps and answer questions. After each question, you will find out if you have answered correctly. When you have finished, you get your points.

title: Järvabadet
label: Activity
text: The Järvabadet public pool opened in the summer of 2020. Open during the summer season, it features three pools, and a small café and has designated places for family barbecues.

title: Filmstaden Sergel
label: Activity
text: Filmstaden Sergel is Stockholm's most centrally located cinema. With 14 screens, and 2098 seats it's also downtown Stockholm's largest. The movie theatre was built in 1995 and the former single-screen cinema located here, Sergelteatern, was turned into Sergel's main auditorium.

title: Stadsarkivet (The City Archive)
label: Attraction
text: The City Archive of Stockholm collects and stores all public information, and publications released by the City of Stockholm. In other words, it's a great place to learn more about the city's history, or maybe your own family's, as you'll find everything from birth and marriage certificates, tourism pamphlets and magazines, building permits, and much more. The archive's main building is located at the top of Kungsklippan, while a new annex opened at Liljeholmen in 2019 to increase the storage capacity.

title: Uggleparken
label: Park
text: Uggleparken (meaning "Owl park") is a playground full of wooden animals and mushrooms for kids to climb in and explore. The playground is in the larger Kristineberg Castle Park, in northern Kungsholmen.

title: Fly Over Stockholm
label: Activity
text: Get a stunning birds-eye view of Stockholm with a helicopter tour. Fly Over Stockholm's tours depart from Bromma airport and take 20 minutes for the Stockholm tour, or 30 minutes for the Vaxholm tour – or fly out to have lunch on one of the islands in the archipelago.

title: Spånga IP - Athletic Track
label: Aktivitet
text: Spånga Idrottsplats (or just Spånga IP for short) is a sportsfield in northern Stockholm, ideal for both soccer and athletics. When the field isn't being used for training or a game by a club, it's open to the public. During winter the athletic track is remade into a cross-country skiing track, with ski rentals for anyone lacking the proper equipment.

title: Kista public library
label: Activity
text: Kista public library opened its doors in 2014. The following year the library received the IFLA's award for the best public library in the world. Besides being a treasure trove of great literature and magazines, Kista library has several study rooms and public access computers.

title: Tradition
label: Restaurant
text: As its name suggests, the popular restaurant Tradition is a place to enjoy beloved Swedish classics. Meatballs, toast Skagen, kroppkakor, apple pie, and more. All made with fresh and uncomplicated ingredients.

title: Kungsträdgården
label: Park
text: Kungsträdgården is one of the city's most important meeting places. It is open to everyone all year round and offers more than 200 different events, such as festivals, ice skating, and sports and cultural activities. The cherry blossoms in spring in the northern part of the park attract large numbers of visitors.

title: Bord
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurant Bord serves à la carte dinners every day, and four-course Saturday lunches prepared from well-chosen seasonal ingredients. It is a small intimate place with an open kitchen and room for 24 guests.

title: Liljevalchs+
label: Museum
text: Liljevalchs+ is an extension of Liljevalch Art Gallery. It was designed by Wingårdh Arkitektkontor with the architect Gert Wingårdh and glass artist Ingegerd Råman and was completed in 2021. Liljevalchs+ has three floors and provides 2,400 square meters of space for exhibitions, a shop, and the café Blå+ with a vegetarian menu.

title: Freyja
label: Restaurant
text: Freyja opened in mid-March 2023 and is Stureplangruppens' first restaurant on Södermalm. The new venture is located on Hornsgatan, just a short walk from Slussen, on a spacious rooftop floor. Besides a great panoramic view over Stockholm, Freyja offers a menu of classic Swedish dishes, infused with international flavors.

title: Café Pascal Östermalm
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Pascal has four locations; Odenplan and Gävlegatan in Vasastan, Skånegatan on Södermalm, and Sturegatan in Östermalm. All are defined by their generous sandwiches, a large selection of pastries, and freshly brewed coffee.

title: Forma
label: Restaurant
text: Forma opened in 2023, and is a bistro mixing typical French dishes and cookery with Asian flavors and spices. The restaurant, located in Hornstull on Södermalm, also runs a bar open until 03 in the morning.

title: Stadsgårdsterminalen
label: Attraction
text: Stadsgårdsterminalen opened in early 2023 and is a venue and space for art, music, nightclubs, and events. It also features a bar, rooftop terrace, and the live stage Kollektivet Livet. Stadsgårdsterminalen is located near Slussen, in a former ferry terminal.

title: Blivande
label: Attraction
text: Blivande is a co-working space in Frihamnen that leads a double life as an event -and club space. Outside of the wooden red house, you'll also find a small square, constructed from shipping containers, that hosts mini-festivals, flea markets, and more.

title: Reimersholme Hotell
label: Restaurant
text: Reimersholme is tucked away on the city-close island with the same name, easily reached from Hornstull by foot or bus. Besides being a hotel, Reimersholme has a bar and restaurants and a program of intimate concerts, stand-up comedy nights, improv theatre, and other events.

title: Brasserie Balzac
label: Restaurant
text: A favorite among locals, Brasserie Balzac somehow manages to be both spacious and intimate at the same time. Qualitative ingredients from small suppliers and an authentic lively atmosphere make Balzac a fine dining experience for Francophiles and large groups alike. The eye-catching interior and the remarkably long bar (with an equally long cocktail list) also makes it a great place for having a drink on the go.

title: Hornstulls bokhandel
label: Shop
text: Hornstulls bokhandel is a small independent bookstore in the Hornstull neighborhood of Södermalm. The store carries everything from novels and children's literature to poetry, non-fiction, and the occasional graphic novels. In conjunction with the store, you'll find a small art gallery, organizing exhibitions, and the store hosts regular author talks.

title: Mikkeller Södermalm
label: Bar
text: Mikkeller is an award-winning craft brewery and chain of bars, founded in Copenhagen in 2006. Besides an exciting selection of ales, IPA, lager, and other beers, Mikkeller has a small selection of  wood-fired pizzas and snacks like a deli platter of cold cuts and Danish smørrebrød sandwiches.

title: STHLMGRÖN
label: Shop
text: STHLMGRÖN is a vintage and secondhand shop located next to Mariatorget on Södermalm. Here you can find bargains for all ages. The garments are handpicked with care and fashion awareness and different trends are mixed with classic style.

title: Grillska Huset
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Everything on Grillska Huset's menu is prepared from scratch using excellent ingredients. It is also a classic Swedish pâtisserie that offers sandwiches, cakes, pastries, pies and tarts. All bread and pastries are from their own bakery. Coffee that is served here comes from the Kersh micro-roastery in Gustavsberg, just outside of Stockholm.

title: Fabrique Gamla Stan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Fabrique is a local chain of traditional wood-fired bakeries that are located throughout central Stockholm. Here you'll find top-quality fresh-baked sourdough bread, rolls, and cakes baked by hand with natural ingredients according to time-honored traditions. In the Old Town, it is located as well at Slussplan 5.

title: Solen
label: Restaurant
text: Solen is Michelin-starred duo Adam Dahlberg and Albin Wessman's newest venture. The restaurant is located just outside central Stockholm in Slakthusområdet, the former meatpacking district. The name translates into "The sun" which is reflected on a menu of dishes and flavors from the sunnier parts of the world, like the Mediterranean, the Middle-east, and South America. Fire is also a recurring theme. Both on the menu – with many ingredients being roasted, grilled, or smoked over open flames – and in the interior design with a large fire pit as the centerpiece in the dining room.

title: Pava
label: Restaurant
text: Pava looks to the diversity of Californian cuisine for inspiration, with a mix of French, Italian, Pacific, and South American flavors. The art deco-style restaurant is located on Malmskillnadsgatan in central Stockholm, in the new neighborhood of Sergelstadsn.

title: Främmat
label: Restaurant
text: Främmat, a small and intimate restaurant in Vasastan, quickly became one of the most talked about restaurants in Stockholm when it opened in 2020. The menu's foundation is classic French cookery, but at the same time constantly experimenting with new dishes and flavors.

title: Sthlm City Food Hall
label: Restaurant
text: Sthlm City Food Hall opened in January 2023 and is Stockholm's newest food court. Arguably it's the city's most central as well, with its Sergels Torg location. Here you'll find street food staples as burgers, tacos, ramen and pizza.

title: Miyakodori
label: Restaurant
text: The Izakaya (a type of informal Japanese bar that serves smaller snacks and dishes) Miyakodori opened in late 2022. The menu is a mix of lighter dishes, like salmon sashimi and deep-fried kara-age chicken, small snacks, and deserted. Their speciality though is their selection of barbecued skewers. You'll find both typical yakitori skewers, fish skewers, and vegetarian options.

title: The Swedish Holocaust Museum
label: Museum
text: The Swedish Holocaust Museum's mission is to preserve and pass on the memory of the Holocaust. The museum is intended to deepen and develop knowledge of the Holocaust on a national level, through exhibitions, lectures, and other events. The museum was established in 2022, as a digital museum, but opened as a physical museum in the summer of 2023 on Torsgatan.

title: Cirkus Second Hand
label: Shop
text: Cirkus Second Hand is located in Råsunda, in Stockholm's neighboring municipality Solna. It opened in 2021 and moved to a larger space in 2022. Here you'll find a selection of women's and children's clothing, shoes, bags, accessories, and design objects.

title: Artikel2 Solna
label: Shop
text: Artikel2 is a humanitarian organization and chain of secondhand boutiques. Currently, Artikel2 operates three shops in Stockholm; in Södermalm, in Liljeholmen, and in Solna.

title: Everlong
label: Shop
text: Vintage store Everlong lies just a short walk from Solna Centrum. Here you'll find vintage garments, mainly from the 1920s and onwards. From fancy 50s capes and psychedelic dresses from the 60s, to modern pants and shirts from the 2000s.

title: Hippieyaya Second Hand
label: Shop
text: Secondhand boutique Hippieyaya is located along Solna's "secondhand promenade" on Råsundavägen. The shop stocks clothes, jewelry, design objects, and various colorful objects, and is a treasure trove for lovers of flower power fabrics.

title: Råsunda Barnkläder
label: Shop
text: The secondhand shop Råsunda Barnkläder opened in 2014. It features a large collection och pre-used clothes, books, games, and toys for children between the ages of 0 to 10. The shop is located just a short walk from Solna Centrum, and is also a place where you can turn in clothes and toys your children don't need anymore.

title: Robinette
label: Shop
text: Robinette is a secondhand institution in Råsunda. For over 50 years, since the 70s, the boutique has offered a selection of women's clothes, handbags, purses, accessories, and design objects.

title: Stockholms Stadsmission Solna
label: Shop
text: Stockholms Stadsmission is a secondhand chain with 18 boutiques in the Stockholm area. Both in the city center and surrounding areas. Besides its shops, Stadsmissionen has its own brand, Remake, producing garments from recycled materials.

title: Pieces of Raoul
label: Activity
text: A digital citywalk connected to the app Raoul Wallenberg Center offers visitors a walk in the footsteps of Raoul Wallenberg, the Swedish hero that saved over 10'000 lives during the Holocaust in Hungary. The app has a sound story read by Raoul's sister Nina's granddaughter Cecilia Åhlberg. Pictures from the family's personal archive, augmented reality experience is a part of the tour that takes 45 minutes from the first stop on Raoul Wallenbergs Square to the last stop in Berzelii park.

title: Bröd & Salt Gamla Stan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Bröd & Salt is a local chain of artisan bakeries, with locations all over Stockholm. Everything is fresh, made from sourdough, and lactose-free. Besides fresh bread, buns, and cookies Bröd & Salt also has a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps if you’re hungry for lunch!

title: Café Krans
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Krans is located on Västerlånggatan, just a stone's throw from Stortorget and the Royal Palace. The café serves, coffee, tea, pastries, pies, and lighter lunch sandwiches.

title: Kaffekoppen
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Kaffekoppen is a classic café in Gamla Stan, having been open on Stortorget since 1994. The café is in a cozy basement, close to the district's most popular attractions, and serves fika, pastries, sweet pies, soup, and lunch sandwiches.

title: Restaurang Eld
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurang Eld is a chef-led restaurant by the water on Djurgården. Here Nordic gastronomy, seasonal ingredients and refined craftsmanship meet. The menu is based on game, fish and local products that follow the rhythm of nature. Under the leadership of head chef Irene Frantzen, a personal cooking style is formed with influences from Ukraine, where precision and expression go hand in hand.

title: Mackverket Vrak Café & Bar
label: Restaurant
text: Mackverket serves hearty sandwiches made from fried sourdough bread, fresh vegetables, and meat from Swedish producers. The restaurant started as a food truck, that still is around, but also operates three permanent restaurants; at STHLM Food Hall, Teatern Food Court on Södermalm, and in VRAK - Museum of Wrecks.

title: Pom Friterie
label: Restaurant
text: Pommes frites, chips, french fries, "pompa". At Pom Friterie the beloved side order has been turned into the star attraction. The menu centers around quality fries, topped with various delicacies and flavors from around the world, but also offers snack-sized bites, beer, wine, and cocktails.

title: Edsbacka Krog
label: Restaurant
text: Edsbacka Krog is a legendary name in Swedish gastronomy, with 400 years of history. The current restaurant has occupied the same building in northern Stockholm since the 18th century but was founded in 1626, which makes it one of Sweden's oldest restaurants. Located in the lush surroundings of Edsviken in Sollentuna, the restaurant serves classic Swedish dishes made from fresh ingredients, and ice cream for dogs for anyone who's brought the family's best friend to dinner.

title: Stjärtilleriet
label: Bar
text: Stjärtilleriet descibes itself as "Östermalm's most UNserious coctail bar". But the drinks are seriously inventive, with exciting combinations and presentations. The bar is located in Artilleriet, the museum restaurant at The Army Museum, and also runs a sunny outdoor bar during the summer.

title: Asian Post Office
label: Bar
text: Panasian restaurant Asian Post Office at Regeringsgatan takes its cues from culinary traditions covering all of Asia. Japanese techniques meet Indian spices and Korean ingredients in an exciting fusion. The bar has become as talked about as the menu, with the gin-based Thai Basil becoming the signature cocktail.

title: Black Milk Gastro Bar
label: Restaurant
text: Black Milk Gastro Bar is an omakase-style restaurant where guests don't order their food from a menu but enjoy an evening of smaller dishes being served one by one. The cuisine gets its influences from all over the world, with a global mix of techniques and flavours. The main pairing here is not with wine or beer, but with cocktails.

title: Bar Oas
label: Bar
text: Bar Oas is a literal oasis at Drottninggatan, central Stockholm's busiest street. The small homey bar, serves wine, cava, snacks, and light dishes. Perfect for a breather after a hectic day visiting Stockholm, in other words.

title: Skeppskattens Hamnkrog
label: Restaurant
text: Skeppskattens Hamnkrog is in Åkersberga, in Stockholm's northern archipelago, beautifully located at the banks of Bammarbo Bay. The menu offers simple and classic pub food, like burgers, char, Wallenbergare, and fish stew.

title: Rögrund
label: Excursion
text: Rögrund is a small island in Nämdö Bay, south och Ingarö and between Stavsnäs and Dalarö. At the quiet and serene island – located just at the edge of the outer archipelago – you will find Grundet, a hostel and restaurant open during the summer, surrounded by the island's beautiful nature. The easiest way to get to Rögrund is by taking the Waxholm ferries, but there is a guest harbor if you're traveling in your own boat.

title: Museum of the Future
label: Museum
text: The Museum of the Future is an experience museum where visitors can get a glimpse into the future. Meet social robots and try VR-games and advanced AI systems! The museum is suitable for both children (from age 6) and adults.

title: Häståkeriet
label: Activity
text: Häståkeriet offers horse riding in a genuinely unique location at the Royal National City Park. They arrange tours for both experienced riders and beginners. They also provide exclusive rides in the dawn, through a sleeping Stockholm followed by breakfast or Twilight-, and Midnight rides. All bookings are made on the website, including group bookings.

title: Curiosa
label: Activity
text: Experience a combination of a walking tour, tales of the past, and fun challenges, all packaged as an interactive digital adventure. While you make your way down the cobbled streets of the Old Town, Curiosa will take you on a journey through Stockholm's history. The self-guided walking tour is packed with fascinating stories, fun facts, and challenges.

title: Glada Stinsen
label: Bar
text: Glada Stinsen is a neighborhood pub, with a friendly atmosphere, located at the Södra Station commuter train station. The kitchen serves classic Swedish pub dishes and a selection of Balkan specialties, and Glada Stinsen also has a popular pub quiz every Sunday.

title: Söders hjärta
label: Restaurant
text: Söders hjärta is a small and cozy restaurant and bar just off Hornsgatan. Serving both lunch and dinner, the food is a mix of classic dishes and Swedish favorites. Hjärtat, as the locals lovingly refer to it, also hosts regular music quizzes every Tuesday.

title: Gastropol
label: Restaurant
