text: In the newly opened Fenix Sthlm conference facility lies Gastropol deli, bistro and rooftop bar, managed by Mattias Berggren – known from Omaka, Eataly and Bianchi. The menu is eclectic, featuring business-lunch classics (steak tartar, oven-baked salmon) as well as more unorthodox elements (katsusando, chirashi sushi). Organic, local and sustainable ingredients abound, and all bread and pastries are made on-site in the bakery. The rooftop bar frequently features DJs, and the view of Hagastaden burough is hard to beat.

contact.address: Gastropol, Norra Stationsgatan, Stockholm, Sweden, 11364 Stockholm
contact.label: Gastropol website (in Swedish)

title: Bar Kaja
label: Bar
text: Bar Kaja is a small cozy bar on Södermalm, serving empanadas and tasty craft beer on tap.  The bar also hosts a popular pub quiz in English, every Thursday.

title: Seafood Gastro
label: Restaurant
text: Seafood Gastro opened in the summer of 2023 and is Chef Mathias Dahlgren's latest venture. Located at Grand Hôtel, the exclusive tasting menu sources its flavors and ingredients from the sea: fish, shellfish, algae, water plants, and seabirds. In 2024, the restaurant received its first star in Guide Michelin.

title: Svedjan Bageri
label: Café
text: Svedjan offers its patrons a taste of northern Sweden. Since 2020, the bakery/café offers home-made sandwiches, exquisite pastries, and freshly brewed coffee. All dairy products used are from the eponymous farm, managed by the owners parents.

title: Restaurang Leijontornet
label: Restaurant
text: Leijontornet takes wine seriously. Describing itself as "ultra-vinous restaurant and wine bar " with around 3000 bottles in its copious cellar. The restaurant is located in Gamla Stan, in the gastronomic block Leijontornet.

title: Kungsholmens Vinbar
label: Bar
text: Kungsholmens Vinbar opened in 2020, and quickly became one of the district's most beloved hangout spots. The friendly bar naturally has a large selection of wines, but also serves smaller dishes, snacks, and light desserts and sweets.

title: Bar Ninja
label: Bar
text: Bar Ninja is an intimate hole-in-the-wall bar in Södermalm. You'll find a small menu of mid-size dishes, snacks, and, more importantly, lots of delicious wines. Wine importer Niklas Jakobson runs Ninja and focuses especially on natural wines, with a wide selection to choose from.

title: Dryck Vinbar
label: Bar
text: Dryck is a social wine bar at Mariatorget in Stockholm – a vibrant meeting place where a passion for wine and drinks shines through in every glass. It´s focus on carefully selected artisanal wines and small-scale beverages from both Europe and Sweden. Swedish wines, cider, kombucha, and other unique drinks from local and sustainable producers.

title: Nektar Mat & Vin
label: Restaurant
text: Homey neighborhood wine bar Nektar can be found on Rörstrandsgatan in Vasastan. The menu varies depending on the season, with snacks and mid-size dishes, and the cooler is stocked with tasty natural wines. During the summer Nektar also has an outdoor serving area for anyone wanting a glass of wine or two in the balmy summer evening.

title: Gaia Matbar
label: Restaurant
text: Lively neighborhood restaurant Gaia quickly made a name for itself in Midsommarkransen, with its playful menu of inventive mid-size dishes. The restaurant in Southern Stockholm also has a good eye for natural wines, offering different bottles every week.

title: Grus Grus
label: Bar
text: Grus Grus is restaurant Tranan's sister bar and focuses on craft wines and food that follow the seasons. Here you can drink wines on obscure grapes from unknown areas or order in a really classic bottle. The menu includes snacks, cheese, cold cuts, smaller and bigger dishes to share, all matched with wines selected by the sommelier.

title: Kasten Bistro & Vinbar
label: Restaurant
text: Since Kasten takes its name from a legendary sommelier, restaurant-goers come with high expectations. The Vinstocken wine bar offers natural wines and other hip drinks, while the more classic wines are served in the restaurant section. The menu consists of mid-sized servings with extra attention paid to the (seasonal) ingredients. With extensive outdoor seating across from the Oscar church – close to Strandvägen in Östermalm – this is a great place to drop in after a seaside stroll.

title: Bistro Leoparden & Snabba Katten Bakficka
label: Restaurant
text: In dreamy, peach-pink premises on Tegnérgatan, Bistro Leoparden is managed by experienced restaurateur siblings Markéta and Jakub Vávra. Here, italophiles can enjoy delicacies such as Tuscan mortadella, Italian oysters, and ricotta cake. However, bistro rests firmly on two foundations: firstly, the artisanal pizza (baked in a special oven from – of course – Naples) and, secondly, the fresh beer. In true Czech fashion, it is poured into a chilled tankard to form a large, creamy head. At the same address lies the newly opened sister establishment Snabba Katten, which targets beer lovers to an even greater extent.

title: Ågesta friluftsområde
label: Park
text: Ågesta friluftsområde is a nature area in southern Stockholm, located by Magelungen Lake. It features several hiking and terrain paths, and an outdoor gym, and is adjacent to the Ågesta - Orlången nature reserve. Its most popular feature is the winter-open cross-country skiing track, prepared with artificial snow yearly. Although Ågesta is in the neighboring municipality of Huddinge it can be easily reached by bus from the Farsta Centrum bus terminal.

title: Houdini
label: Shop
text: Houdini makes minimalist sportswear with maximized sustainability ambitions. They never mix synthetic materials with natural ones, and their clothes are made with longevity and versatility in mind.In the Houdini stores, you can not only repair your clothes or have them sold second-hand, but you can also rent garments for shorter periods of time.

title: Meetballs & Pancakes
label: Restaurant
text: Meetballs & Pancakes is a newly opened restaurant on Södermalm that offers classic, homemade meatballs with mashed potatoes, lingonberry jam, and cucumber salad. Here, everything is cooked from scratch and there are vegetarian and vegan meatballs available. There are also classic and American pancakes on the menu.

title: Bambi
label: Restaurant
text: Laidback French bistro and wine bar Bambi opened its doors in the fall of 2023. The menu is unpretentious, but with great ambitions, and constantly changing from week to week. Lively, welcoming, and with a wine list that leans heavily on natural wines.

title: Wisdome Stockholm
label: Attraction
text: Wisdome is a spherical 360° educational cinema at the National Museum of Science and Technology. The unique building was completed in 2023 and is primarily made of wood. The roof, floor support beams, and walls are made of laminated veneer lumber and cross-laminated timber bent to create the arched ceiling over the round center piece (also made of wood) housing the movie theater. Tickets are bought through the museum's webpage.

title: Stockholm Kayak and Hike
label: Activity
text: Discover the city of Stockholm from the water, or discover the archipelago and its islands and birds, outside of Stockholm. In both cases, you will be enjoying a safe paddling tour together with a professional kayak leader.

title: Källarbyn
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: In spite of its prime location in the tourist-dense Old Town, Källarbyn has earned a reputation among its many regulars for being not only cozy and authentic, but even and good value. The atmospheric 18th-century cellar with its eclectic decoration attracts mixed crowds. The frequent live concerts, extensive wine (– and tea!) list, and multiple vegan options all make for a – sometimes lively – café experience worth remembering.

title: Apans Andra Hand
label: Shop
text: Apans Andra Hand is a gathering point for everyone who loves to express themselves through their style in a sustainable and responsible way. Here you will find unique pearls that enhance your wardrobe - whether you're looking for somehting special or the timeless classic.

title: Banankompaniet (B-K)
label: Nightclub
text: In 2023 Banankompaniet opened up as a nightclub and multicultural venue, hosting concerts, parties, and on occasion exhibitions, and fairs. It has two stages, four bars, and a large outdoor area open during the summer. The building was formerly owned by Banan-Kompaniet (hence the name), Scandinavia's largest banana importer, but hadn't seen much use since the 1970s when the company set up new banana storage facilities in Southern Sweden.

title: Medley Tyresö Aquarena
label: Activity
text: Medley Tyresö Aquarena is a bath, and aquapark in the neighboring municipality of Tyresö. It features a large pool, a kid's pool with slides, jacuzzis, saunas, and a gym. Tyresö is located in the southern parts of Stockholm and is easiest to reach by taking a bus from Gullmarsplan or Handen.

title: Älskade Traditioner
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Retro-café Älskade Traditioner mixes the typically Swedish with international evergreens (how about a cinnamon bun freakshake?). But the highlight of the menu is the waffles, both sweet and savory (called "wraffles").

title: Dalarö Kajak
label: Activity
text: Dalarö Kajak is a kayak rental on the archipelago island Dalarö. Beginners can paddle in the calm waters closest to the rental, while those more experienced can venture into the scenic outer archipelago, or to one of the many uninhabited coves to pitch a tent. (All equipment is available for hire, and the staff are happy to give tips for different routes.)For those who want to learn more about the area and nature, guided tours can also be booked. There is also a selection of multiple-day packages – accommodation and food included – for happy campers with time on their hands.Dalarö Kajak is reachable within an hour from Stockholm by public transportation.

title: Internationella Pressklubben
label: Restaurant
text: Intertntionella Pressklubben om Vasagatan serves a seasonal menu of classic pub and Central European dishes. But Pressklubben's main event is its beer menu. The restaurant has one of Stockholm's largest selections of Belgian beer—the bar stocks around 800 kinds of Lambic, Blonde, Pils, and Trappist from 150 breweries.

title: Akkurat
label: Bar
text: Akkurat is a well-known name among beer aficionados, not only in Sweden but internationally as well. The bar on Hornsgatan pops up regularly on lists and rankings of the world's best beer bars. Akkurat has a rotating selection of 28 brews on tap and a large cellar of vintage beer, with over 500 bottles of aged beer.

title: Historical Escapes
label: Activity
text: Experience Stockholm's exciting history through Escape Rooms! At Historical Escapes, the room challenges are all based on historical events, and take place in their historical settings. Solve the mission within 60 minutes and save the yesterday!For 2–6 players, from 12 years and up.

contact.address: Historical Escapes, Lundagatan, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm

title: Stockholm Nature
label: Activity
text: Owned by passionate nature lovers and travel enthusiasts, Stockholm Nature organize tours with small, intimate groups and an environmentally-friendly perspective in mind. Their offering ranges from three-hour kayaking tours to hikes spanning several days.

contact.address: Stockholm Nature AB, Horisontvägen 16, Stockholm, Sweden, 128 34
contact.label: stockholmnature.com

title: 3Sixty Skybar
label: Restaurant
text: As the name suggests, 3Sixty Skybar offers a stunning panoramic view over Stockholm from its location close to Liljeholmen. The interior is inspired by 1920s elegance, with the round bar serving refreshing cocktails.

title: Rosetta's
label: Restaurant
text: The relaxed feel of Rosetta's is akin to that of a retro dive bar in Los Angeles (or a Swedish summer cottage, depending on whom you ask). In the hip Hornstull area, the restaurant has become appreciated not only thanks to the atmosphere, but from the successful marriage between comfort-foods and plant/seafood ingredients. Here, golden oldies like mac'n cheese and hamburgers get new, fresh makeovers appealing to meat lovers and vegetarians alike. And, in keeping with the theme, you can order great cocktails to accompany your meal, too!

title: Crêperie Fyra Knop
label: Restaurant
text: Fyra Knop, open in the cozy neighborhood of Södermalm in 1993, was the first French crêperie in Stockholm and probably in Sweden. Besides the great variety of galettes and crêpes with different fillings, you‘ll find organic wine and farmhouse cider here. The ambiance, accompanied by eclectic music and paintings on the walls, is easygoing, casual and full of charm.

title: Restaurant Reisen
label: Restaurant
text: The hotel business at the historic Hotel Reisen dates back to 1819. The restaurant’s menu blends international dishes and brasserie classics with a modern twist, all with a spectacular view of Skeppsbron.

title: Riddersholm nature preserve
label: Excursion
text: Riddersholm is a nature reserve in Rådmansö, an ideal destination for year-round excursions. The reserve features 20 kilometers of walking trails that make it easy to explore the area. Many visitors stay overnight, either camping or at the youth hostel within the reserve.The best thing about Riddersholm is its accessibility. Although located on the mainland, it offers a unique archipelago feel, with its beautiful countryside and proximity to the sea.

title: Norra Malma nature preserve
label: Park
text: The nature preserve, located southeast of Lake Erken, is abundant with oaks. In the east part of the nature preserve, you will find a graveyard with graves from the first part of the Iron Age.The reserve next to Erken is very scenic and is easily accessible.

title: Häverö Prästängs nature preserve
label: Park
text: In Häverö prästäng along the Roslagen coast, beautiful meadows spread out. Here, hepaticas and wood anemones bloom early in the spring. The area is known for its intense spring and early summer bird song. Häverö prästäng is one of the few bigger mowings in Roslagen that still harvests traditionally to preserve the rich flora.A deciduous forest dominates outside the meadows, but coniferous forests, outcrop, and shore meadows are also prevalent. In the nature preserve you can find beaches and swimming possibilities.

title: Nyckelviken
label: Excursion
text: In Nyckelviken, walks await by the sun-warmed cliffs and explorations along the many forest paths. At the heart of the nature reserve lies Stora Nyckelviken, a manor with a café surrounded by a barn with cows and horses.Nyckelviken offers a mix of culture, nature, and activities such as pony riding and historical discoveries in the Local Heritage Museum. Both adventurers and families are welcomed here year-round.

title: Burvik Golf
label: Activity
text: Burvik Golf Club is situated in Knutby, about an hour's drive from Stockholm. The golf club is surrounded by beautiful natural scenery and features a challenging 18-hole course with a mix of forested areas and expansive views. The clubhouse is known for its warm hospitality and is a welcoming place for visitors.

title: Ingarö Golf
label: Activity
text: Ingarö Golf Club offers a unique golfing experience in the heart of the beautiful archipelago with two 18-hole courses. Surrounded by natural beauty and with cozy facilities near the clubhouse, the club creates a welcoming atmosphere. For experienced golfers and beginners, Ingarö Golf Club is the place for an unforgettable round of golf in the Stockholm archipelago.

contact.address: Ingarö Golfklubb, Fågelviksvägen 1, Ingarö, Sweden, 13464 Ingarö
contact.label: igk.se

title: Nynäshamn Golf
label: Activity
text: Nynäshamn Golf Club is located an hour south of Stockholm and is known for its varied and challenging courses. The club offers 27 holes spread across three 9-hole courses. Each day, the courses combine two distinct 18-hole courses, ensuring a diverse and enjoyable golf experience. The club also offers excellent training facilities with a large putting green, two chipping greens, a short game area, and a driving range with covered tee-off spots, making Nynäshamn GK a complete golf destination.

title: Café Roddarhuset
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Since 2007, Café Roddarhuset, located in an old boathouse in Vaxholm, has offered a blend of art and culinary delights. Guests are treated to the day's lunch, fresh salads, pies, sourdough sandwiches, coffee, tea, cold beverages, homemade pastries, and ice cream. Visitors can enjoy arts and crafts from all over the country while savoring a meal or coffee by the water.

title: Roslagens Maritime Museum
label: Museum
text: Roslagens Maritime Museum on Väddö takes you on a journey through the maritime world of Roslage. Here, you can experience life at sea with items, photos, and stories showcasing seafaring's history. The museum talks about sailors' lives, how shipping started, and its importance to the area. It's a fun place for everyone, where you can learn about old times through exciting objects and stories.

title: Kajak & Uteliv
label: Activity
text: Kajak & Uteliv offers exceptional kayak experiences in the Stockholm archipelago, with kayak bases in Gräddö and Furusund. Located in the beautiful Gräddö region, where the lush inner archipelago meets the rugged outer archipelago, you can rent a kayak, take a kayak course, or join a guided kayak tour. At the kayak base in Furusund, you can rent a kayak for your own personal expedition.

title: Nynäshamn's Kayak rental
label: Activity
text: Nynäshamns Kayak Rental offers you the chance to create a unique experience. You can enjoy a day trip to a secluded sandy beach, spend a night in a tent on your own island, or go on an adventurous journey along the coast.

title: Solbrännan Restaurant & Café
label: Restaurant
text: Nestled in the Stockholm archipelago, Österskärs Havsbad offers a serene oasis for anyone seeking a delightful dining experience. Solbrännan is more than just a place to eat; it's a gathering spot for friends and family to enjoy delicious meals with breathtaking views. Whether you prefer dining indoors or outside on the veranda, the water will give you a relaxing ambiance. The restaurant offers diverse dining options, from lunch to à la carte and even a simple coffee in the sunshine. You can rent the entire restaurant for special occasions and personalize your experience.

title: Bullandö Krog
label: Restaurant
text: Bullandö Krog is a restaurant located on the beautiful coastline of Värmdö. It's a place where gastronomy meets the charm of the archipelago. The restaurant offers a generous terrace and panoramic windows, providing an outstanding archipelago view. Live music is available during the summer to make the evening more memorable.

contact.address: Bullandö krog, Bullandö Marina Krog, Värmdö, Sweden, 139 56 Värmdö
contact.label: bullandokrog.se

title: Restaurant Motorverkstan
label: Restaurant
text: For those seeking a relaxed atmosphere and a taste of archipelago life, Motorverkstan Djurö is the perfect choice. The archipelago restaurant, outdoor bar, and a varied à la carte menu attract land and sea travelers. Enjoy good food and drink in a unique environment by the sea.

title: Värmdö Musteri
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Värmdö Musteri uses local ingredients to produce high-quality musts, juices, jellies, and other delicious products. Visitors can sample these tasty treats and participate in the must-making process. Additionally, the café serves a variety of traditional Danish open-faced sandwiches (known as smørrebrød) and delectable apple pies. Those looking to bring a piece of the local culinary experience home can stop by the shop for a selection of local delicacies.

title: Brewery tour and tasting at Nynäshamns Ångbryggeri
label: Activity
text: Nynäshamns Ångbryggeri is not just a place to grab a drink; it's a place that embodies passion and a lifestyle. As one of Sweden's first microbreweries, it has a long history of craftsmanship and dedication to creating flavorful beers of the highest quality. From their open taps flows a wide range of ale, lager, stout, and specialty brews, all inspired by the character and charm of the surrounding archipelago.

title: Hamnkrogen
label: Restaurant
text: A beloved restaurant in Vaxholm since 1958, welcoming visitors for lunch, dinner, or drinks while overlooking the harbor. The restaurant serves, among other things, the popular Waxholm herring.

title: Kvarnsandsbadet
label: Excursion
text: A beautiful pine forest surrounds this sandy beach, offering around 190 meters of natural beauty along the water. Grisslehamn, located about 6 km away, is easily accessible and offers a beach volleyball court for some extra activity. Kvarnsandbadet is a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the peace and beauty of nature.

title: Kärleksudden
label: Excursion
text: Kärleksudden is a beautiful swimming spot in the heart of Norrtälje, between Norrtäljeviken and Kvisthamraviken. The site features a 50-meter-long sandy beach and a sloping lawn, making it a perfect place for relaxation and various activities. You can enjoy convenient facilities such as toilets, a kiosk, and a nearby restaurant for a complete beach experience.

title: Lommarbadet
label: Excursion
text: Lommarbadet is situated by Lake Lommaren in the eastern region of Norrtälje. It's a great place to unwind or have some fun water activities. You can experience the excitement of Sweden's second-longest water slide and enjoy a warm pool in the Vigelsjö outdoor area.

title: Lundabadet
label: Excursion
text: Lundabadet is a spacious bathing area in Norrtälje with two sandy beaches for visitors to enjoy. This location is ideal for a day of sunbathing and swimming. Norrtälje, about 8 km away, provides easy access to all the amenities you need for a comfortable beach experience.

contact.address: Lundabadet, Utlunda byväg, Norrtälje, Sweden, 76175 Lunda, Utlunda
contact.label: roslagen.se

title: Sandvikens bad
label: Excursion
text: Sandviken Baths is a stunning sandy beach that stretches for 60 meters and is right next to Väddö Havsbad & Camping. It's an ideal spot for a relaxing day by the water, with plenty of nearby amenities and entertainment options. Älmsta is just 3.5 km away, making it easily accessible for visitors.

title: Årsta havsbad
label: Excursion
text: Enjoy the peace of the large sandy beach at Årsta Havsbad, located just outside Västerhaninge. With swimming piers, diving towers, kiosks, and refreshments available during high season, you can experience relaxation and adventure.

title: Schweizerbadet
label: Excursion
text: Schweizerbadet, located near Dalarö, has two beaches. The first one is smaller, while the other one is larger. Both beaches have mostly fine-grained white sand and calm water. Due to its shallow depth, the water in Schweizerbadet is relatively warm, making it a trendy spot. It is advisable to bring a packed lunch if you plan on spending an extended period here, as food options are limited.

title: Nynäs Havsbad
label: Excursion
text: Nynäs Havsbad is a peaceful retreat just half an hour from Stockholm. It offers comfortable accommodations, delightful culinary experiences, and a serene spa and relaxation area on the cliffs overlooking the sea. Regardless of the season, you can look forward to a memorable experience during your stay here.

contact.address: Nynäs Havsbad, Oskarsgatan, Nynäshamn, Sweden, 149 34 Nynäshamn
contact.label: nynashavsbad.se

title: Lappdals Icelandic horses
label: Activity
text: Lappdals Islandshästar provides unforgettable experiences guided by knowledgeable and authorized staff. Visitors can explore nature on horseback while surrounded by the unique atmosphere that only Icelandic horses can offer. With a wide range of activities, Lappdals Islandshästar is the perfect destination for anyone seeking a genuine and safe riding experience in a welcoming environment.

title: Wildlife Safari Stockholm
label: Activity
text: True Nature Sweden provides safaris in Stockholm, offering a unique opportunity to witness Sweden's magnificent wildlife in its natural habitat. The tour offers an exhilarating wildlife viewing experience and engaging conversations about animal behavior, habits, and habitats.

title: Bogesund
label: Excursion
text: Bogesund provides a historical journey through time, where one can explore rune stones and Viking settlements. Bogesund Castle and its rich history of noble families complete this scenic excursion. Bogesund offers something for everyone, with hiking trails running along the water, providing opportunities to view the rich animal and bird life.

title: Söderarm
label: Excursion
text: The island Torskär is often called Söderarm after the lighthouse built here in 1839. The name comes from the relatively shallow open water area stretching like two arms toward the Sea of Åland. The lighthouse was built on the southern arm, which explains the name "Söderarm" (Southern Arm). Today, it is a public historical building well worth a visit. It's a good idea to bring binoculars! It isn't unusual to see both sea eagles and seals.

title: Grisslehamn
label: Excursion
text: Grisslehamn is an archipelago community with a long history and active boat and fishing life. Stroll in the harbor, buy fresh fish, and enjoy the sea air. The Havsbaden Hotel has lovely sea views and spa facilities close by. Many restaurants, cafés, adventurous mini golf courses, guest harbors, and camping facilities exist. There are daily trips with the Eckerö boat line (Eckerölinjen) running between Grisslehamn and Eckerö on Åland.

title: Ljusterö
label: Excursion
text: Ljusterö is one of the largest islands situated in the central Stockholm archipelago. The island has many attractions, ranging from restaurants and hotels to Iron Age burial sites and old archipelago villages.Ljusterö is a great place to visit for those interested in animals and nature. The island is primarily forested, occasionally interrupted by cultivated fields and pastures. You can find as many as 15 lakes here.Anyone who wants to experience Roslagen nature, lovely bathing cliffs, and brilliant views of the outer archipelago should plan a visit to the Östra Lagnö nature reserve.

title: Norrtälje
label: Excursion
text: The capital of Roslagen, Norrtälje, is charming with stunning historic buildings. This small town offers a lot, including shops, restaurants, cafés, art galleries, year-round events, and museums. Nature enthusiasts will find Södra Bergen and Norrtäljeån perfect for hiking and fishing. Moreover, boat trips from Norrtälje harbor offer excursions to archipelago islands like Lidö and Arholma, making the city a gateway to the beautiful Roslagen archipelago.

title: Stockholms Stadsmission Nytorget
label: Shop
text: Stockholms Stadsmission is a chain of second-hand shops, run by the Stockholm homeless shelter. Its 18 boutiques are scattered around Stockholm, from central locations like Nytorget or Hötorget to suburban locations like Solna or Farsta. Besides its shops, Stadsmissionen runs the brand Remake, producing garments from recycled materials.

title: Bar Montan
label: Restaurant
text: The humble thrift-store decors of Bar Montan, coupled with its rough industrial surroundings, might lower your expectations. Once you are seated, however, the knowledgeable and friendly staff will make you feel right at home. Also, the minimalistic information on in menu might feel too sparse, but the food is so tasty that you will soon forget you ever doubted.

contact.address: Bar Montan, Förbindelsehallen, Johanneshov, Sweden,  Johanneshov
contact.label: Bar Montan på Instagram

title: Dalarö
label: Excursion
text: Dalarö is a stunning archipelago gem situated by the seaside and beautifully preserved. The long beach of Schweizerbadet and a wide range of water activities make Dalarö a summer idyll. Art exhibitions and music events fill the island's calendar, making it a vibrant scene for residents and visitors alike.

title: Djurö/Stavsnäs
label: Excursion
text: Djurö and Stavsnäs can be found in eastern Värmdö and are linked by a beautiful bridge that overlooks Kanholmsfjärden. This archipelago village can be reached by bus from Slussen and offers many natural and cultural experiences. Stavsnäs summer harbor boasts an archipelago museum, bakery, bathing areas, and a restaurant. You can easily access many archipelago islands from the winter harbor via regular boat traffic or taxi boats. In Djurö village, visitors can enjoy restaurants, a café, a cultural center, nice walking paths, and bathing areas. Don't miss Djurö Church, built in 1683, and the oldest wooden church in the archipelago. For those who wish to stay overnight in the area, Djurönäset hotel and conference are available.

title: Lidö
label: Excursion
text: Lidö is an idyllic retreat located within the heart of Roslagens archipelago. It is a place where nature, relaxation and sustainability intersect. The island provides ample opportunities for kayaking, swimming, and forest walks, making it the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. Several lodging options are available on the island, including an inn, hostel and a self-sufficient farm open for visits.

title: Norröra
label: Excursion
text: Norröra is often called Saltkråkan after the filming of Astrid Lindgren's "Vi på Saltkråkan" (We on Seacrow Island). Guided tours are available for those who want to experience more of the island and life on "Saltkråkan."

title: Rånö
label: Excursion
text: Rånö is a beautiful family island with many child-friendly, shallow sandy beaches. In total, there are over 10km of coast. Here you'll find many beautiful walking trails and, if you like fishing, there are good fishing waters around the island. Getting to Rånö takes just an hour with Waxholm's boat from Nynäshamn. This makes the island a perfect destination if you have just one day. If you have more time, there are several lovely cottages to rent.

title: Ornö
label: Excursion
text: Ornö is - despite being the southern archipelago's biggest island - hardly exploited at all. Nature here is beautiful and largely unspoiled. In the woods, wildlife is abundant. Explore Ornö by bike or with skis if you come in winter.The buildings in Ornö are located around Kyrkviken. This is where you'll find the church, school, museum, library, and restaurant, as well as the many popular guest docks. You can go to Ornö year round by car ferry from Dalarö. In summer, there are small cottages for rent and many places to eat or have a coffee.

title: Kymmendö
label: Excursion
text: Kymmendö is a privately owned island with the same family since 1802. But because of "the Right of Public Access," everyone is welcome to come here for a visit. Enjoy the original and pristine nature with its breezy hazel and oak woods and beautiful flower meadows. Experience an old-fashioned, vibrant farm where horses and sheep graze in the pastures.Kymmendö's genuine archipelago milieu is well worth a visit any time of the year. In summer, business is bustling with archipelago farmers selling lamb products. There are also boat rounds, guided tours, shopping, and restaurants.

title: Fjärdlång
label: Excursion
text: Fjärdlång is one of Haninge's twenty nature reserves. Here, you can experience the pristine archipelago's diverse scenery and rich, exciting wildlife. Don't be surprised if you get to see elks, foxes, owls, and eagles. Follow one of the island's many hiking trails, which are of varying length and difficulty. Take the one that leads up to the lookout point Tysta Klint, 36 meters above the sea, and you'll see far over the ocean and bay.Fjärdlång is a great destination for the whole family. Aside from the many hiking trails, there are large grassy areas suitable for different ball games and activities. Swim from the rocks or the small sandy beach by the harbor. Rent a kayak or row boat and explore the waters around the island. In late summer and fall, Fjärdlång's berry and mushroom picking might be more appealing than swimming. Fishing, of course, can be done year-round.

title: Muskö
label: Excursion
text: Muskö is influenced mainly by the navy. The Swedish Navy had its headquarters here from the 1500s until the mid1900s. But Muskö has more to offer than naval warfare history. Come here and enjoy the beautiful nature. Walk over the vast open pastures and flowering coastal meadows. Muskö has many lovely areas and attractions to see year-round. But remember to take along a picnic lunch if you come in autumn or winter. The island's restaurant is open only in summer.

title: Ingmarsö
label: Excursion
text: If you like to hike, you'll enjoy Ingmarsö with all its marked hiking trails. Brottö Cultural Reserve and Kålgård Island's nature reserve are two popular destinations. In the harbor, you can eat well at the archipelago restaurant, watch boats in the guest harbor, or rent a canoe. Get off the archipelago ferry at one of the jetties and start exploring the island. If you wish to stay the night, there are several cottages and bed & breakfasts.

title: Rådmansö/Kapellskär
label: Excursion
text: Rådmansö is located on the coast of Roslagen in Norrtälje. The peninsula boasts a stunning landscape that offers breathtaking views of the archipelago. You can find several places to visit and explore here, including Kapellskär, Gräddö, Räfsnäs, and Södersvik. These places provide cultural experiences, entertainment, and adventures for people of all ages.Rådmansö has a variety of accommodations, camping spots with cabins, swimming areas, and rentals for sailboats, rowboats, and kayaks. Additionally, there are many cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and event-planning companies. If you're a boat owner, there are guest harbors and marine service stations available.If you're a nature enthusiast, you can visit Riddersholm's nature reserve, located furthest out on Rådmansö, by the Furusund fairway. This nature reserve is a perfect destination for excursions throughout the year.

title: Simpnäs/Skeppsmyra
label: Excursion
text: When you arrive in Simpnäs, you will see the old ferry berth located in the harbor, offering a beautiful view of Arholma. The harbor area has a summer kiosk and a convenience store. In the same building, there is a summer café that serves homemade bread, coffee, and light meals. The restaurant located above the café provides a wonderful view of the small harbor. Make sure to visit the Björkö-Arholma maritime museum, which showcases the golden era of sailing ships in Björkö during the 1800s.Skeppsmyra, situated in the southern part of Björkö, is surrounded by serene surroundings, beautiful archipelago scenery, woods, farmland, sea, and beaches. You can spend the night in Lyckhem's cabins. Additionally, don't forget to check out the summer art exhibit.

title: Nämdö
label: Excursion
text: Nämdö is an entire archipelago where the main island, Nämdö, is surrounded by hundreds of islands and islets. Nämdö is an archipelago of nature at its most beautiful. From its lush forests and flowering meadows to the outer archipelago's barren rocks and cliffs, Nämdö is one of the few large islands that still shows off original buildings and still remains unexploited.

title: Runmarö
label: Excursion
text: Runmarö is a lively island of exciting and varying nature that has inspired many artists including Tranströmer, Strindberg, Forsell, and Törneman. Commonly known as "the author's island," Runmarö is one of the nearest islands in the Värmdö archipelago; the boat trip from Stavsnäs takes just 10 minutes and the boats go regularly all year round. In summer, the meadows bloom orchids and Runmarö can show off 27 different species. Runmarö showcases a very exciting and varied nature, and the island actually has nine lakes, although they call them marshes here. One of these is the Magical Silver Swamp, which was acknowledged by Strindberg. Runmarö is a great starting point for kayak tours. On the southern part of the island, by Solberga Gård, you can rent kayaks, shop for handmade crafts in the farm shop, or enjoy the view from the garden café. Telegrafberget - the island's highest point can also be found there. It's a popular destination with breathtaking views of all the outward islands.

title: Triton
label: Restaurant
text: Triton is run by nerdy food lovers who want you to feel right at home. The laid-back premises on Ringvägen mirror the ambitions, with guests being offered a full view into the open kitchen. A dinner package consists of an entrée and two main courses, with wine package or dessert to be ordered on the sida. For its reasonable prices and high ambitions, Triton has been awarded the Michelin Bib Gourmand award.

contact.address: Restaurang Triton, Ringvägen, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: triton.restaurant

title: Waxholms Hotell
label: Excursion
text: Waxholms Hotell sits in charming Vaxholm, where the archipelago's beauty meets the city's pulse in a perfect symbiosis. This hotel has been a haven for guests seeking good food, a friendly atmosphere, and beautiful views of the Vaxholm fjord for over a century. With modern meeting rooms that retain their classic charm, Waxholms Hotell welcomes guests all year round to an experience where every season has its beauty.

title: Skeviks gård
label: Excursion
text: With the sea and nature nearby, Skeviks Gård is a beautiful place to find peace and inspiration. Visitors can enjoy cozy accommodation and delicious food and experience a lovely spa with hot tubs and a relaxing sauna. For the adventurous, there is a wide range of activities such as mountain biking, kayaking or SUP, hiking in scenic areas, fishing, and much more. It is an ideal destination to experience, rest, and have fun.

title: Strawberry Arena
label: Activity
text: With a capacity of up to 75,000 audience members, Friends Arena is Stockholm's largest concert, sports, and event venue. Completed in 2012, Friends has hosted concerts by the likes of Taylor Swift, Depeche Mode, Beyoncé, Pearl Jam, The Rolling Stones, Bruce Springsteen, and Eminem. Friends Arena also serves as Sweden's national football arena and home arena for the AIK fotball club.

title: Fredriksborg Hotel
label: Excursion
text: Discover Fredriksborg Hotel, a historic gem located near Vaxholm. Each room in the hotel has its own unique story to tell. You can get here by car, RIB boat, bus, or shuttle boat, which takes about 45 minutes from Vaxholm. Once you arrive, you will be greeted by an idyllic oasis with a historic fortress, a cannon tower, an orangery, lush gardens, and vast natural areas. The restaurant has a classic menu for all tastes and during the summer they also have grill nights. Fredriskborg offers free guided tours for restaurant and hotel guests during high season.

contact.address: Fredriksborg Hotell & Restaurang, Fredriksborgsvägen, Värmdö, Sweden, 13990 Värmdö
contact.label: fredriksborghotel.se

title: Njuta Spa
label: Activity
text: Njuta Spa, located in Nacka Strand, is an exceptional place to experience relaxation and harmony. It is perfect for those who seek a moment of tranquility. You can enjoy a breathtaking sea view from the wooden deck and watch boats glide by. Njuta Spa offers a personalized spa experience free from congestion and stress.

title: Marholmen Spa
label: Activity
text: At Mareld Marholmen Spa, you will step into a peaceful and harmonious world that allows you to unwind from everyday stress completely. Enjoy a calm environment with panoramic views of Roslagen's stunning nature.

title: Svensk Båtutbildning
label: Activity
text: Discover the Stockholm archipelago with Svensk Båtutbildning. A guided boat tour starts on Djurgården and takes you through the picturesque waterways of the archipelago with a stop for lunch at Fjäderholmarna where you relax while a guide tells you about the island's history and culture. The tour continues through Skurusundet, past Smedsudden, over Baggensfjärden, and into the narrow channels towards Näsudden and Ingarö harbor for further travel towards Strömma.

title: A.C. Perchs Thehandel and Tea Room
label: Shop
text: In A.C. Perchs Tea Room in Stockholm, afternoon tea is served in quiet and cozy surroundings. Here you get a selection of English finger sandwiches, petit fours, scones with jam, lemon curd, and whipped cream accompanied by a pot of tea of your choice from Perch’s tea card. At Perchs Thehandel there is a large range of high-quality teas from all over the world and the skilled staff can help you find a new potential favorite tea.

title: Petri
label: Restaurant
text: Petri is an elegant restaurant with a down-to-earth approach. The restaurant's credo is evident both in its name – "petri" being shorthand for petrichor; the scent of rain falling on dry soil – and menu. Petri works closely with local producers and farmers for a menu that mixes simple ingredients with elaborate cooking techniques.

title: Skyddsvärnet Secondhand
label: Shop
text: The non-profit organization Skyddsvärnet was founded in 1910 and in 2024 the org. opened a second-hand boutique on Hornsgatan on Södermalm. You'll find the store stacked with clothes, books, design objects, and furniture, and all proceeds go back into new charitable projects. Skydsvärnet also runs a larger second-hand store, in the northern suburb of Spånga.

title: Ramen Manga
label: Restaurant
text: Lunch restaurant Ramen Manga serves brothy ramen soups with chicken, pork, or veggie options in mild or spicy combinations. Located on Pilgatan, directly adjacent to Hantverkargatan, it's a great place for a quick lunch in the middle of Kungsholmen.

title: Francis & Francis
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Francis & Francis have served inventive blends of soft-serve ice cream with anything-goes toppings, on severeal different Stockholm locations, since 2017.

title: Arlanda Helicopter
label: Activity
text: Arlanda Helicopter AB is based at Bromma Airport in Stockholm and offers both sightseeing tours and fast transport. You can experience an exciting helicopter ride over Stockholm, take a tour of Stockholm's inner or outer archipelago and fly over Vaxholm or Sandhamn. It is also possible to tailor your very own helicopter tour. All passengers receive a headset to be able to easily follow the pilot's guidance over the city and the islands of the archipelago.

title: Kiki's Tour Stockholm
label: Activity
text: When legendary animator and filmmaker Hayo Miyazaki was crafting the world for Kiki's Delivery Service, his fifth feature-length film, he drew much inspiration from architecture and buildings in Stockholm and Visby. Kiki's Tour Stockholm takes you past 22 Stockholm locations that can be seen in the movie and tells the story of how the beloved director ended up in Sweden in the first place. Bookings are made on the tour's webpage, and available languages are English, Japanese, German, and Swedish.

title: The Cell
label: Museum
text: The Cell, a joint venture between The Museum of Science and Technology and the Karolinska Institute, opened in 2024. In the exhibition hall, cutting-edge life science meets contemporary art in innovative and surprising collaborations. Discover artworks that explore scientific discoveries, questions about life and humanity, and present new finds in unique ways.

title: Café Klotet
label: Restaurant
text: Café Klotet, restaurant Gondolens sibling, is a relaxed bar and restaurant with a simple and playful menu. Klotet is located on the floor above Gondolen, in Katarinahuset, overlooking Slussen. The name is borrowed from an older restaurant  located on the building's ground floor between 1877-1935.

title: Skog
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Sundbybergs Kafé och Gelateria, or Skog for short, is an artisan ice cream parlor in the northern Stockholm suburb of Sundbyberg. The café serves chilled deserts all year round with both evergreen flavours and unique creations.

title: Monrads
label: Restaurant
text: Deli -and restaurant Monrads in Djursholm have served fresh seafood since 2007. In April 2024 Monrads branched out with a second location in central Stockholm, but the idea is the same. Relax and have a lovely fish, lobster, or shellfish in the dining room, or buy delicacies over the deli counter to bring back home.

title: Slow Fashion Hub
label: Shop
text: Founded by a trio of designers and vintage lovers, the Slow Fashion Hub is a space where independent designers and smaller shops can rent a pop-up table to sell second-hand, vintage, and re-design treasures. Together with their neighboring shops on Hornsgatan, SFH has formed the Slow Fashion District with a total of 19 boutiques within walking distance from one another.

title: Pelago
label: Restaurant
text: Summer rooftop restaurant Pelago is one of the new additions to the family of restaurants in Katarinahuset, Slussen. The large outdoor bar and restaurant is open during the summer and offers a great view of central Stockholm. The food is primarily bbq-dishes from the Middle East and Argentina, complimented by canned cocktails from Stockholms Bränneri.

title: Parken
label: Restaurant
text: Despite its name, Parken is located indoors, near Ellen Keys on Östermalm. Founded by influencer Penny Parnevik and Swedisch Master Chef-winner Christin Kashous, Parken's menu offers a mix Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisine.

title: NOFO Wine bar
label: Bar
text: NOFO Wine bar is located at the eponymous hotel in Södermalm. The mood is relaxed and informal, with a wine list that aims to surprise. During summer the bar opens up its cozy courtyard area.

title: NÒR Södermalm
label: Restaurant
text: NÒR Södermalm is the restaurant and bar at the Clarion Hotell on Ringvägen. The establishment has long been popular for casual after-work hangouts and drinks and has hosted the LGBTQi-club "Hotellhänget" since 2013. The menu mixes flavors from Sweden and Southern Europe. The drink list is a blend of the bar's signature creations and timeless evergreens.

title: Allegrine
label: Restaurant
text: Allegrine is chef Daniel Couet's hommage to his grandmother's classically French cooking, with typical French herbs, spices, and seasonal ingredients. But what was rustic and simple, has been reinterpreted in a modern take. Across the street, you'll also find the restaurant's wine bar Bar Etablé.

title: Créme
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Ice cream café Créme opened in May 2024 on Brännkyrkagatan on Södermalm. Specializing in creamy soft-serve cones and cups, the frozen deserts are in various flavors and with crunchy and sweet toppings.

title: Dashi
label: Restaurant
text: Dashi is named after the eponymous Japanese broth; a cornerstone in Japanese gastronomy used in soups, sauces, marinades, and much more. The umami-tasting broth is also prominent on the restaurant's seasonal menu, served osusume-style (ie. "the chef's daily recommendations"). Since May 2024, the restaurant has one star in the Guide Michelin.

title: Vind o Vatten
label: Activity
text: Vind o Vatten organizes adventurous sailing trips in the archipelago. Choose from half-day excursions, up to three-night adventures where you'll be a part of the ship's crew. Shorter sailing courses are also available, both in groups or private lessons.

title: Humana City
label: Shop
text: Humana is a second-hand chain with two stores in Stockholm; on Norrmalm and Södermalm. The Norrmalm store offers a curated selection of vintage clothes, shoes and accessories. Here you'll find the latest fashion trends, designer brands, key pieces, and unique vintage finds. You can also hand in clothes you don't use anymore and give them a second chance.

title: Independent Kostym
label: Activity
text: Independent Kostym is the largest costume rental in the Nordics, catering to industry professionals and private individuals alike. Here, you can find the perfect outfit for your themed party (or take your Halloween game to the next level.) Fashionistas can pre-book a study visit, browsing endless costume corridors with a professional guiding your way. If you find something you like – rent it and bring it home with you!

title: KD Court: Tensta
label: Activity
text: KD Court is a colorful public basketball court located in Tensta, in the Järva area of Stockholm. The court opened in 2023, and the project was initiated by basketball superstar Kevin Durant together with the organizations Brilliant Minds and Hoop Dreams.

title: Ruben
label: Restaurant
text: Ruben's menu describes itself as a global fusion. With influences from the Nordics, Italy, Asia and Africa, Ruben aims to take their guests into a flavourful trip around the world - all while feeling right at home in the neighborhood restaurant located in the heart of Norrmalm. With spontainety being the overall theme at Ruben, the restaurant leaves half of their sitting places open for drop-in guests. The menu and wine list are both updated regularly according to the restaurant's mood and seasonal produce.

title: BAP - Burgers & Pastrami
label: Restaurant
text: BAP's menu combines two kinds of sandwiches; juicy burgers (meat or vegan options available) and spicy Italian pastrami. The restaurant on Östermalm has been hailed as one of the best burger joints in Sweden and also serves shakes, drinks and the customary burger sides like fries and onion rings.

title: Bonden & Burgaren
label: Restaurant
text: Bonden & Burgaren ("The farmer & the burger") might be Stockholm's most local burger. The restaurant is run by Väddö dairy farm in the northern Stockholm Archipelago, with meat and cheese sourced from its cows.

title: Musikflotten
label: Activity
text: Take a tour along the waters of Kungsholmen with Musikflotten. A wooden raft tour where you bring your own food and drinks whilst Musikflotten takes care of the live music and great atmosphere. The tour takes 2 hours and starts at the Klara Strand café.

contact.address: Musikflotten, Klarasjö rampen, Stockholm, Sweden, 111 52 Stockholm
contact.label: musikflotten.se (site in Swedish)

title: GreenKayak
label: Activity
text: GreenKayak engages people in the fight for cleaner environment. You can paddle their kayaks for free under two conditions - spend your time in a GreenKayak collecting trash and share the experience on social media. There are two locations in Stockholm, one right beside the City Hall of Stockholm and another near The National Maritime Museum.

title: Animo
label: Restaurant
text: Animo is a modern neighborhood restaurant. Their á la carte menu follows the seasons, feeling and creativity. There is also an innovative cocktail bar with a lively wine list of handpicked favorites.

title: The Stockholm City Hall Tower
label: Attraction
text: During the summer season (from May to mid-August) you can go up the City Hall tower.The tower is 106 meters high and has an unbeatable view of Stockholm's inner city. On the way up, you pass through the Tornmuseet. The museum displays sketches and models of various objects, statues etc. from the City Hall and City Hall Park.NOTE: The elevator only reaches the mid level, so to ascend to the top, you will need to climb some stairs.Important information! The City Hall Tower is open for the 2026 summer season, but will then be closed to visitors during a planned renovation in 2027–2028.

contact.label: The City Hall website
contact.booking_label: Book a timeslot for the City Hall Tower

title: Acaza
label: Restaurant
text: When Acaza opened in the summer of 2023 it was the first of its kind in Stockholm; a cozy neighborhood pub all about Portuguese cuisine. Traditional classics like bacalhau, bitoque, and caldo verde are served in a relaxed and homey atmosphere.

title: LOKAL Koppartråden
label: Restaurant
text: LOCAL Koppartråden is a new restaurant in the historic factory building from the end of the 19th century in central Sundbyberg. Here the focus is on local, seasonal ingredients and the menu includes some classics prepared in a modern way.

title: Lu
label: Restaurant
text: When Lu opened in Malmö, in 2019, it quickly became one of the city's most talked about eateries. When the family-owned restaurant branched out to Stockholm in the summer of 2024 diners were more than ready for its spicy Cantonese specialties. The menu takes its cues from the gastronomic melting pot that is Hong Kong – with wontons, whiteleg shrimp, and Chinese broccoli – and is served family style with small plates for the whole table to share.

title: Södertälje
label: Excursion
text: Hometown of Swedish titans of industry Scania and Astra Zeneca, Södertälje is Stockholm's closest neighbor. Located about 36 kilometers (approx. 22 miles) south of the city and easily be reached by taking the commuter train (line no. 41, 45-50 minutes), Södertälje is perfect for a day trip. Some of Södertäljes most popular attractions are the Torekällberget outdoor museum and Tom Tits interactive science museum.

title: The Stockholm Archipelago Trail
label: Activity
text: The Archipelago Trail is a unique hiking trail through the Stockholm archipelago. It is 270 km long (almost 168 miles) divided into 21 legs, of varying length and difficulty. The trail is spread across 20 islands – from Arholma in the North to Landsort in the South – and takes hikers through pristine nature and picturesque fishing hamlets. Individual sections of the trail can be reached by public transportation ferry, with resting and picnic spots along the way. The Stockholm Archipelago Trail is on Time's list of 'The World's Greatest Places 2025.'

title: Långholmens Padel Club
label: Activity
text: At Långholmen Padel Club you can play in a beautiful outdoor environment, in the middle of Stockholm. There are 6 courts for you to book with family and friends – or join one of the recurring tournaments organized by the club.

contact.address: Långholmen Padelklubb, Alstaviksvägen, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: langholmenpadelclub.com (in Swedish)

title: Racehall Gokart
label: Activity
text: Since August 2024, Botkyrka is home to Sweden's largest indoor track for go-kart racing. The track is 1000 meters, and 8 meters wide at the narrowest point – so there is always plenty of space to overtake! There are several different go-kart models for adults, children, and the physically impaired. If you get hungry after the race, you can kick back at the O'Learys restaurant on the premises.

contact.address: Racehall Stockholm AB, Skälbyvägen, Grödinge, Sweden, 14791 Grödinge
contact.label: racehall.com

title: Bio Fågel Blå
label: Activity
text: Bio Fågel Blå was resurrected in the fall of 2023, with a renovated auditorium, a new bar, and a bistro. The cinema initially opened in 1926, making it one of Stockholm's oldest. Famously, Fågel Blå was one of Ingmar Bergman's favorite theatres. The famed director grew up in the same block and regularly visited Bio Fågel Blå; both as a child and adult. This legacy is honored to this day with "Bergman Modays" showing his films with English subtitles.

title: Botica
label: Restaurant
text: Botica is a Portuguese restaurant in the heart of Stockholm. There is an open kitchen bar where guests can sit and interact with chefs preparing dishes on a charcoal grill. You can also savor wines at their cozy wine bar next door to the main restaurant.

title: Skärisbiografen
label: Activity
text: Skärisbiografen is located in the Stockholm suburb of Skärholmen, in the same building as Kulturhuset Stadsteaterns satellite (which also runs the cinema). The movie theater is open to all but is the first in Stockholm to focus on films for children and teenagers (ages 5-19). Besides its regular programming Skärisbiografen hosts film festivals, educational screenings and "knattebio"; movies for toddlers.

title: Skörden
label: Restaurant
text: Skörden is a new neighborhood restaurant on Södermalm. The menu is varied and offers a wide range of dishes at different prices and flavors from the world's different cuisines. Skörden also houses the trainee program Chefs Camp, which will shape future chefs.

title: Moe's Burger
label: Restaurant
text: Moe's Burger in the suburb of Kista serves high-quality burgers and is among the best burger places in Sweden according to Burgerdudes, one of the world’s leading websites for hamburger reviews!

title: Bistro Zissou
label: Restaurant
text: A cute, French-ish family bistro, where Kalle Lindborg (of Kagges and Sillkaféet fame) have set out a romantic, southern European course with his partner and sommelier Emma Skerfe. The menu and wine list are short, but change often!The care and craftsmanship are not only tangible in the kitchen, where sustainable ingredients in season reign superior, but also in the home-grown flowers and the art on the hand-painted walls. Children and dogs are welcome. Open Wednesday to Saturday.

contact.address: Bistro Zissou, Lilla Nygatan, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: Instagram @bistro.zissou

title: ergo.
label: Restaurant
text: Ergo is an informal fine-dining restaurant with high ambitions, with a staff is hand-picked from top restaurants in Stockholm (and throughout the world) by head chef Petter Johansson, himself a veteran of numerous Michelin-star establishments.At Ergo, seasonal ingredients are prepared using French methods. The result is a modern take on a tasting menu, allowing the guests to modify its contents in a relaxed atmosphere. For parties of up to 12, there is also a chambre separée with its own kitchen and entrance. Received its first Michelin star in 2025

title: Mad Axe
label: Aktivitet
text: På Mad Axe i centrala Stockholm får du och dina vänner (om ni är 18 eller äldre) lära er att kasta yxor på ett säkert sätt, och sedan tävla mot varandra! Det finns ingen servering i lokalen, men ni kan själva ta med er fika/picknick.

contact.address: Mad Axe Throwing Club - Stockholm, Kammakargatan, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: madaxe.se

title: MXCO
label: Restaurant
text: MXCO is a tortilleria, taqueria and cocktail bar. MXCO puts a great emphasis on using the best ingredients to create authentic Mexican food. Tortillas here are always made directly to order and the lime is pressed for each Margarita. The interior of the venue is inspired by a classic taqueria in Mexico City.

title: Jeanerica
label: Shop
text: Jeanerica is a brand renowned for its innovative designs and timeless styles. It was founded in Stockholm in 2018, and now it returns to its roots and locates its first flagship store at the heart of Östermalm. The flagship store has been designed by Swedish interior designer Daniel Östman and Jeanerica and reflects Jeanerica's commitment to craftsmanship, simplicity, and modern elegance.

title: Sailing Sweden
label: Activity
text: Explore Stockholm’s archipelago, home to over 30,000 islands. Sailing Sweden offers tailor-made sailing experiences based on your wishes—whatever they may be. Aboard Evita, a 46-foot yacht, you can depart from central Stockholm or the tranquil outer archipelago. Choose from full-day adventures or evening cruises under the long northern daylight.

title: Café Cuvée
label: Bar
text: Café Cuvée is a charming and relaxed bistro-style restaurant in central Södermalm. Though the menu is international, it leans heavily on French and Swedish cuisine, and the wine list consists mostly of French wines.

title: The Living History Forum
label: Museum
text: The Living History Forum is a public agency, located in Stockholm's Old Town. Through school projects and workshops, it advocates democracy, tolerance, and equal rights for all. It also runs an admission-free public museum with exhibitions on history and social struggles.

title: Rara
label: Restaurant
text: Himalayan cuisine is not well-known in Sweden, to say the least. At Rara, visitors get a rare opportuniy to sample Nepalese dishes, such as Momo dumplings in savory broth, Hakka noodles with chicken, and much more – all made on-site from scratch. Vegetarian options abound, and the playful coctail menu is definitely worth a glance.

contact.address: Rara restaurant, Torsgatan, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: rararestaurant.se

title: Brännerian
label: Bar
text: Brännerian is the small bar belonging to local distillery Stockholms Bränneri. Armed with unmatched expertise, the classic cocktail ingredients are modified (or swapped completely), to create new variations based on new ideas and local ingredients. Their aim is to produce all the spirits they serve in the bar on site! While the focus – naturally – lies on the beverages, hungry guests are offered a small but delicious bar menu featuring simple dishes such as pie, grilled cheese, and oysters.

title: Lake Life Stockholm
label: Activity
text: Lake Life Stockholm is a family business offering guided tours, courses, and other outdoor experiences all year round –from kayaking to cross-country skating and disc golf. They also operate the café the Ängsjö outdoor park.

contact.address: Ängsjö Café x Lake Life Stockholm, Ängsjövägen, Järfälla, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: lakelifestockholm.com

title: Actionpadel
label: Activity
text: Actionpadel welcomes you to play in two courts in Stockholm: One in Nacka, and one in Kungsängen. They offer training groups for all levels, as well as regular series games. Here, you will also find fully equipped padel shops and changing rooms.

contact.address: Actionpadel Kungsängen, Kraftvägen, Kungsängen, Sweden,  Stockholm

title: Alphaspel
label: Shop
text: At Alphaspel in Southern Stockholm, you'll find everything you'll need for your next game night. The shop has one of the largest selections of games in the Nordics; board games, tabletop role-playing games, miniature games, trading card games, and various accessories like binders, dice, paints, and more. Alphaspel regularly hosts tournaments and game nights, and next to the store is a bar serving drinks, food, and snacks.

title: Out Seglingsevenemang
label: Activity
text: Out Seglingsevenemang organizes sailing and archipelago activities where participants themselves are active. They have their beloved places and are happy to give you suggestions for a suitable route based on your wishes. Maybe you want to eat a good lunch at an archipelago restaurant, anchor in a bay, eat a freshly grilled dinner on the rocks or enjoy a dip in the sea with a sauna. Out Seglingsevenemang offers, among other things, city ​​sailing, archipelago sailing (one and several days between islands), transport sailing, winter sailing, etc.

title: Official Self-guided tours of Stockholm
label: Activity
text: The City Museum of Stockholm and the Medieval Museum have developed audio guides, free and available for both smartphones or web browsers. The tours offer tours on The Unesco World heritage site The Woodland Cemetery (Skogskyrkogården) but also tours of Gamla Stan and more!

title: Siggesta Gård
label: Activity
text: Idyllic Siggesta gård is both a restaurant, and hotel in the inner Stockholm archipelago. Located in serene surroundings, it's a great place for a day trip or an overnight stay. Explore the surrounding nature, rent a kayak or mountain bike, play disc golf, or hang out with the local farm animals.

title: Bar Brahe
label: Bar
text: Jazz -and cocktail bar Brahe is Hotel Reisen's cozy backdoor hang-out spot. The bar has a separate entrance and offers great ambiance, refreshing drinks, and live music.

title: Napoli Centrale
label: Shop
text: Napoli Centrale is a vintage store located on Södermalm in Stockholm. All garments are purchased directly from Italy. The range reflects the passion and elegance of Italian culture and focuses on timeless design and sustainability. Here you will find exclusive vintage from big brands such as Gucci, Dolce & Gabbana, and Valentino, as well as tributes to iconic influencers such as Maradona and Napoli. The store has two locations on Södermalm; Sankt Paulsgatan 3 and Götgatan 1.

title: Mama Wolf
label: Restaurant
text: Mama Wolf on Södermalm serves Japanese street food and everyday day-dishes. For example, onigiri (fuffed rice balls), don (rice bowls with various toppings), and thick udon noodles. There are several vegan and vegetarian options available, and the drink menu has an assortment of sho-chu, Japanese whiskey and beer, and several varieties of sake; from strong to sweet, even sparkling.

title: Birka Bowling & Dart
label: Bar
text: Birka Bowling has kept balls rolling (against pins) since the 1970s. The bowling alley is one of central Stockholm's largest with 17 lanes for classic bowling, disco bowling, and VIP bowling. You'll also find a dart arena, karaoke rooms, and a sports bar serving beer and burgers.

title: Svarta Hästen
label: Bar
text: Nothing is black and white at Svarta Hästen, even as the establishment has become a watering hole for Stockholm's chess aficionados. The wine bar is warm and cozy and even offers chess tutoring for anyone who wants to hone their skills.

title: Kanon
label: Restaurant
text: Barbecue restaurant Kanon opened its doors in October 2024. The cozy restaurant is on Tjärhovsgatan, a short walk from Slussen or Medborgarplatsen. The menu features a spicy mix of delicacies from the Middle East, the Mediterranean, and South America, such as pointed cabbage with dukkah or lamb skewers with Aleppo chili. The dishes are served with various relishes, salads, fries, pita bread, and more.

title: The Flying Horse
label: Bar
text: The Flying Horse has been a meeting place for Vasastan's sports fans since 2010. The pub, located near Odenplan, screens SHL, Premier League, Champions League, La Liga and much more. The bar has a wide selection of tap beer, whisky, wine, and cocktails, and the kitchen serves hearty pub dishes that go perfectly with sports; burgers, nachos, club sandwiches, and more.

title: Bistro Bestick Gamla Stan
label: Restaurant
text: After having been a mainstay on Bryggargatan for 10 years, family-owned Bistro Bestick opened a second location in early 2025. The restaurant, founded by Stadshuskälaren's former head chef Björn Fischer, serves a mix of sophisticated French cuisine and beloved Swedish classics.

title: ok ok
label: Restaurant
text: Laidback neighborhood restaurant ok ok served its first meal in 2023, just a short walk from Tessinparken on Östermalm. The menu treats diners to a seasonal offering of midsize dishes, a relaxed ambiance, and a handpicked selection of ciders from small and independent producers.

title: Florentine
label: Restaurant
text: Florentine is inspired by the Italian 1970s, something that is evident when looking at the theatrical interior. The restaurant offers dishes from all over Italy and craft cocktails at the bar. Imagine an Italian family dinner where everyone shares Italian classics with a modern twist.

title: Basta
label: Restaurant
text: On the fourth floor of Åhléns City, there is a restaurant inspired by the sunsets of Capri. On warmer days, you can dine outside on the rooftop terrace. The menu is based on Italian classics with a twist, and the restaurant remains open even after the store has closed.

title: Rentbike
label: Aktivitet
text: Här bokar du din cykel online och hämtar ut den på vald plats. Rentbike finns i flera städer och på flera olika adresser i Stockholm. Rentbike erbjuder allt från elcyklar och moutainbikes till lastcyklar och barncyklar.

title: Rentbike
label: Activity
text: Book your bike online and pick it up at one of the available pickup points. Rentbike operates in multiple cities and at several addresses in Stockholm. They offer everything from electric bikes and mountain bikes to transport bikes and kids' bikes.

title: Stockholm Audio Tours
label: Activity
text: Get to know the beauty of the Stockholm Old Town with a 20-stop audio tour! The British Lady in Stockholm guides you through the cobblestoned streets and famous sites of this historic district. Through geofencing, the app activates audio commentary when near a point of interest.Although GPS location is necessary, you can download the app with Wi-Fi and do the walk without using your data.

title: Kafé Plattan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: In the lowest level of the iconic Kulturhuset, in the very heart of Stockholm, lies Kafé Plattan. The atmosphere is casual and friendly, and all fika and light meals served are 100% vegan. Everything on the menu is made in-house, from artisanal sourdough bread and kimchi to modern, plant-based meat dishes.

contact.address: Kafé Plattan, Sergels Torg, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: kafeplattan.se

title: Kersh
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: At Kersh, they serve their own coffee alongside fika and traditional Swedish snacks. The café, located in a former tobacco shop, has quickly become a popular gathering spot in Södermalm. In addition to the food and drinks, visitors appreciate the music and the welcoming atmosphere.

title: 3Arena
label: Activity
text: A stadium for both sports and entertainment, this venue serves as the home field for local soccer teams Hammarby and Djurgården and also hosts major concerts. More than one million people visit this stadium every year, and some of the artists who have performed here include Madonna, The Rolling Stones, and Avicii.

title: Slaktkyrkan
label: Activity
text: Despite the name, this is not a repurposed old church but a building previously used in the slaughter business, which once characterized the area. The venue still somewhat resembles a church with its high ceilings. Today, it is a popular concert venue that can host up to 750 people, offering performances in all styles, from techno to punk.

title: Hus 7
label: Activity
text: A venue where you can discover bands and artists before they make it big. In a short time, Hus 7 has become an important part of Stockholm’s underground scene and has served as the stage for several music videos. It features a smaller stage, allowing for an intimate experience with the artists. During summer, the outdoor area between Slaktkyrkan and Hus 7 is transformed into an open-air club.

title: Studio 95
label: Shop
text: A vintage store with a carefully curated selection that is frequently updated with new items – that's Studio 95. Here, there are no limits or strict rules, but you can expect a unique mix of clothing for both men and women. If you're lucky, you'll time your visit with one of the store’s restocks.

title: Björk and berries
label: Shop
text: Björk and Berries is a Swedish perfume house with its roots in Swedish nature. The purpose of their store is to offer a deeper experience of their scents, allowing visitors to explore the full collection and find a personal favorite. By combining natural ingredients with innovative perfume-making, they strive to create sophisticated and timeless fragrances.

title: Holidays American Bar and Restaurant
label: Bar
text: Even though it might not look like anything special, Holidays has a lot to offer. They serve beer at a reasonable price, and the kitchen prepares American classics. On the TVs, they show various sports, and the outdoor seating on Götgatan is perfect for guests who want to experience the pulse of the city.

title: Berns Hotel
label: Activity
text: Staying at Berns Hotel means being in the heart of it all. Just a few steps down, you'll find one of the city's most popular nightclubs, while top-notch shopping awaits around the corner, and restaurants in every direction. Berns Hotel is a boutique hotel at a classic address, where you can experience modern Stockholm while feeling the echoes of its history.

title: The Sparrow
label: Bar
text: A mix between a bar and a restaurant, where you can enjoy French influences from breakfast through to the evening. The focus is on creating an inviting after-work hangout, where champagne and wine are paired with small delicacies. The bar is created in collaboration with French champagne producer Moët & Chandon – so expect fresh bubbles in tall glasses.In addition to its restaurant and bar at the heart of the hotel, The Sparrow features an outdoor seating area that stretches along Birger Jarlsgatan 24–26, from the wine bar past the lounge to the hotel lobby. It’s an ideal spot to enjoy the afternoon sun.

title: Panza
label: Restaurant
text: At Panza, they serve Italian classics like lasagna, risotto, and pinsa to suit all tastes. With a strong passion for Italian food culture, the restaurant aims to offer a genuine experience through well-prepared dishes. They also provide babysitting for parents who want to enjoy a child-free meal.

title: Glenn Miller Café
label: Restaurant
text: The archetype of what a jazz club should be. Here, you sit close to the band and can enjoy both the food and the music. Glenn Miller Café has made a name for itself among jazz fans, and the club takes great pride in the artists who have played here over the years. If you plan to eat, you’ll need to book a table—but it's also possible to sit at the bar and enjoy the music.

title: Paul & friends
label: Shop
text: A true gem for anyone who appreciates men's fashion. Since its founding in 1989, trendy Stockholmers have lined up to shop a curated selection of international fashion houses, emerging designers, and innovative Swedish brands. The store is located on the second floor of the Nordiska Kompaniet building.

title: Stockholm by Boat
label: Activity
text: With Stockholm by Boat, you can tailor your archipelago experience to suit your wishes. Whether you’re a couple planning a romantic outing, a family looking for something for all ages, or a larger group seeking a unique experience, the tour is adapted to your needs. For those who would like to combine the trip with fishing, that option is also available. Stockholm by Boat offers guided private boat tours by motorboat, sailboat, or yacht.

title: Framfickan
label: Restaurant
text: The theatre Maxim has its own restaurant, designed to extend your cultural experience. Here, you can enjoy Asian small plates with Scandinavian inspiration—or simply have a drink at the bar. Friendly dogs are welcome, as long as the restaurant isn’t too crowded.

title: Ponti
label: Restaurant
text: At this restaurant, Italy and California meet—with a twist. After working at some of Stockholm’s most well-known restaurants, three chefs joined forces to create a dining experience inspired by the dishes that have shaped them. Ponti also has a bar that, in a short time, has become popular among the locals.

title: Globen Shopping
label: Shop
text: Under the slogan “Here you’ll find everything you need,” Globen Shopping offers a wide selection of stores and services. Here, you’ll find everything from bookstores and clothing shops to popular restaurants and cafés. When major events take place at Avicii Arena or 3Arena, many visitors choose to start their evening here.

title: Funky Chicken Food Truck
label: Restaurant
text: The food truck that changed the hamburger scene in Stockholm. Many compete to make the best burger in town, but for five straight years, Funky Chicken Food Truck has been named Sweden’s best burger by Burger Dudes. They’re also ranked fifth in the world by the same list. Today, burger lovers line up to enjoy Funky Chicken Food Truck’s creations.

title: House of Tell
label: Shop
text: If you are looking for timeless pieces of the highest quality, you’ve found the right place. Here, the focus is on offering a highly selective assortment of premium and contemporary luxury fashion. This vintage store has, in a short time, become a favorite among both shoppers and sellers.

title: Beau Travail
label: Activity
text: Close to Vita Bergen, in a small 16th-century home, the gallery Beau Travail has found its home. The gallery is artist-run and focused on contemporary art. Here, traditional exhibitions are mixed with performances in a unique and inviting environment.

title: STANCE
label: Activity
text: The name of the gallery originates from the idea of taking a firm and distinct position in the contemporary art realm. Stance Gallery is primarily focused on international emerging or mid-career artists, and features a mix of paintings, sculptures, and installations. The gallery promises a unique perspective with the goal of standing out.

title: Coulisse
label: Activity
text: A gallery that aims to highlight emerging and innovative artists from both near and far. The goal is to connect these artists with art lovers from around the world, even though collectors in Stockholm have the advantage of proximity. It’s not uncommon for the art exhibited to revolve around themes such as environmental concerns, gender issues, and queer identities.

title: Saskia Neuman Gallery
label: Activity
text: A gallery known for more than just its trailblazing art, as it also hosts events such as talks and performances. Many Swedish and international artists have made their debut here on the Swedish gallery scene. The focus is on discovering interesting artistry before it becomes established.

title: The Sacred Sauna
label: Activity
text: As its name implies, Sacred Sauna is not your routine sauna visit; the lighting, sound, and music are all carefully designed to maximize your relaxation. Here, gentle sauna operators guide you through 60-minute sessions, helping you with breathing techniques, cold baths (if you so wish), and German aufguss.

contact.address: The Sacred Sauna, Hallvägen 7A, Johanneshov, Sweden, 12162 Johanneshov
contact.label: thesacredsauna.se

title: Beckmans College of Design
label: Attraction
text: Since 1939, Beckmans College of Design has educated students in various fields of design, always grounded in an artistic foundation. The college emphasizes a high level of creative energy, supported by a professional teaching staff and a strong connection to important social issues. Every year, many locals visit the college’s degree exhibition.

title: Studio B3
label: Shop
text: Studio B3 is Stockholm’s largest showroom for furniture, lighting, and materials. Spanning three stories, it features inspiring exhibitions across fields such as architecture, interior design, and product design. It also hosts a variety of events, including product launches and lectures.

title: LÖPLABBET Stockholm City
label: Shop
text: The store with everything you need—whether you're a professional runner or a happy amateur. Everyone working here has a personal connection to running. Guided by their own experience and methods, their goal is to provide every customer with the equipment they need.

title: Runners' Store
label: Shop
text: Store with an impressive selection of running shoes, as well as sports electronics. Runners’ Store was founded in 2006 by experienced runners. At the store, you can also get assistance from an orthopedic technician, provided you schedule an appointment in advance.

title: Tekniska in Tensta – Tekniska museet
label: Museum
text: In the northern suburb of Tensta, the Swedish National Museum of Science and Technology’s has a local branch. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to experience mathematics in new ways. You can create music, solve code puzzles, and build robots. The activities, including exhibitions and educational programs welcome school classes on weekdays, offer club activities after school, and are open to the public on weekends and school holidays.Open to the public Friday–Sunday, otherwise open for school visits and booked groups.

contact_text.text: During school holidays and in the summer, the museum has extended opening hours for the public.

title: Le Pop
label: Coffee Shop / Café
