text: At Le Pop, in Ringen Centrum, Södermalm, you'll find handcrafted ice cream on a stick. Choose between different dips and toppings based on what you like!

title: Bullandö Glassfabrik
label: Café
text: At Bullandö Glassfabrik in the Stockholm archipelago, fresh gelato has been made daily for the past 14 years. The ice cream factory is strongly influenced by Sicilian traditions, inspired by the founders’ many trips to the town of Stintino. The factory at Bullandö is open on weekends.

title: Persona
label: Restaurant
text: The team behind Persona hails from the acclaimed Frantzén, and their culinary roots are evident in every dish, combining high ambition with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. Guests are offered a tasting menu, with the option of a carefully curated drink pairing. The restaurant takes its name from Ingmar Bergman’s 1966 film Persona.

title: Bacchi Syre
label: Restaurant
text: At Järntorget in Stockholm’s Gamla Stan (Old Town), you'll find Bacchi Syre – a green meeting place spread over three floors, featuring restaurants, bars, and a café. In addition to plant-based food and drinks, the space includes discussion stages, workspaces, event areas, and an art gallery.

title: Marieviks Kajbad
label: Activity
text: With three pools and views of Årstaviken, the quay bath in Marievik is a popular swimming spot in Stockholm. Extending 44 meters out into the water, it features a 25-meter lap pool, a play pool with a diving tower, and a children’s pool for younger visitors. The bath is also open for winter swimming, with access kept ice-free so visitors can take a cold dip even when the bay freezes over.

title: Gelato Crema
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Gelato Crema, part of Café Crema, offers authentic Italian gelato. Every day you’ll find 12 different gelato and sorbet flavors made from scratch. Gelato Crema is located at Hornsbergs strand and Kungsholms strand.

title: Stockholm 1897
label: Restaurant
text: The team behind Sandhäxan and Frippe are now opening Stockholm 1897 by the Djurgårdsbron bridge. This year-round bakery, café, and restaurant offers Swedish flavors for every occasion. They’re also opening a sauna down by the water, complete with a beer tap and the opportunity to take a dip in the canal.

title: Edge & Brace
label: Activity
text: Sea kayaking for beginners or enthusiasts. Edge & Brace offers courses and guided tours. For more information, please see the website.

title: Gamla stan 1859
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Gamla stan 1859 is located in the heart of Stockholm’s Old Town. The premises date back to the 1600s and offer creamy, locally produced gelato made from carefully selected ingredients. In addition to gelato, they also serve coffee, an exclusive selection of teas, and confectionery.

title: Stockholm à la carte (adult)
label: Activity
text: Stockholm à la carte offers guided tours in Stockholm with various themes, based on neighborhoods, themes, or museums. Book a private tour for you and your group at a time that suits you. Thematic tours focus on different aspects such as food, cycling, or art in the subway, to name a few.

title: Lundbergs Konditori
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Lundbergs Konditori opened in Gröndal (Tvärbana Line 30) in 1946 and has preserved the same interior atmosphere ever since. In the past eight years, they’ve also started making their own ice cream — and quickly gained recognition with three medals at the Swedish Ice Cream Championships. Their stracciatella, for instance, has been awarded the title of Sweden’s best.

title: Gelateria Amore
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Gelateria Amore on Långholmsgatan 5 in Stockholm is the perfect spot for anyone in search of gelato. In addition to traditional gelato, they also offer vegan options. You’ll also find handmade cakes, gelato cakes, homemade chocolate, pralines, and desserts.

title: Sjöstaden Gelato
label: Café
text: In Hammarby Sjöstad, you'll find freshly made Italian artisan gelato, served daily since 2021. Their Italian gelato is crafted using Swedish milk, a splash of cream, fruit purées, nuts, and chocolate sourced from around the world

title: Scandikidstours
label: Activity
text: Guided tours specially designed for children (ages 6–12), featuring a variety of themes that capture their interests — from culture and history to storybook characters and museums. The tours are available for private and group bookings in English and French.

title: Vana Spa
label: Activity
text: At Vana Spa in Vasastan, Stockholm, you’ll find access to a pool, jacuzzi, steam and dry saunas, an aroma room, and a 300 square-meter gym. Choose from delightful spa treatments such as massages, pedicures, and luxurious signature treatments, challenging workouts with personal training, and total relaxation.

title: RiRi
label: Restaurant
text: Located by Hornstulls strand, the restaurant RiRi is connected to the cinema Bio Rio. At the heart of the kitchen stands a large grill where fresh ingredients are cooked over an open flame. The cuisine is inspired by the Mediterranean, with a strong focus on seasonal flavors. RiRi offers drop-in seating at the bar.

title: Stockholm Stadshotell
label: Restaurant
text: At Stockholm Stadshotell, food and drink take center stage, with two restaurants offering Nordic flavors and global influences. During the summer, they also open up the inner courtyard.The bistro changes its menu daily to prepare and serve what's in season. In the upstairs restaurant, guests are treated to a more curated experience in the old chapel. Since Stockholm Stadshotell also has 32 rooms, you can enjoy breakfast here as well.

title: Susan Szatmáry
label: Shop
text: The swedish brand Susan Szatmáry is a modern luxury brand founded in Sweden 2018. Influenced by her multiple and diverse cultural backgrounds, Susan creates high end accessories with a unique identity, combining function & simplicity with delicate elegance. You’ll find the brand att Villa Dagmars concept store.

title: Tessinparken - Den lilla staden
label: Park
text: Near Gärdet metro station, you'll find Tessinparken and the newly renovated playground whose theme, “The Little City,” was voted for through public dialogue. It’s inspired by the 1930 Stockholm Exhibition, functionalism, and the buildings surrounding Tessinparken.The playground features playhouses in functionalist style, a construction crane, a tram, a slide, a sand play area, and climbing equipment. Close to the park activity building, there’s a large area with many new swings. You’ll also find a mini-golf course, a combined basketball and bandy court (which is iced over in winter).

title: Rögrund Sjökrog & Boende
label: Activity
text: Rögrund is a small archipelago island located right at the edge of the outer archipelago, off the coast of Ingarö between Stavsnäs and Dalarö. Here, you'll find a bed & breakfast and a seaside restaurant. The rooms accommodate four or six people, and there are also a few simpler cabins available for rent.Breakfast, which is included, is served at the Sjökrogen, where you can also have lunch and dinner. Guests also have access to a shared kitchen, lounge, shower, and sauna.

title: Ärla
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurant Ärla is housed in a former pizzeria, parts of which remain intact. The setting evokes the feeling of a living room in a white-painted brick villa from the 1970s, where the only decorations are a few small paintings with rustic themes. Here, you can enjoy flavorful small plates or the fixed four-course dinner menu, all in a mid-range price category. The ambition is everyday fine dining.

title: Season Hotel
label: Restaurant
text: Season Hotel is set to open in May 2025 in Jungfrusund, Ekerö. This family-owned hotel will feature a spa, a restaurant, and its own brewery. The design brings together Scandinavian minimalism and Cape Cod elegance.The hotel’s spa offers seasonal treatments, two heated pools, an ice bath, a Finnish sauna, and a steam room. Right next to the hotel, a local microbrewery will open with a taproom bar, beer tastings, and direct-to-consumer sales. Guests can also enjoy the hotel’s rooftop bar, panoramic views over Lake Mälaren. Just beside the hotel, Brasserie Season will open.The project is driven by three local families – Björklund, Hamberg, and Jalilian. The hotel will feature 37 rooms.

title: Ring Katarina
label: Restaurant
text: As the name suggests, Ring Katarina is located at the corner of Ringvägen and Katarina Bangata.A small wine and food bar with 25 indoor seats and a summer outdoor patio. Serving exciting natural wines and small dishes with European influences, the menu is updated regularly.

title: A Retro Tail
label: Shop
text: A Retro Tale is a Stockholm-based store specializing in authentic vintage and second-hand luxury goods from major brands.Located inside the MOOD shopping gallery, A Retro Tale ensures the authenticity of its inventory through careful verification and by owning all products outright.Here, you’ll primarily find bags, accessories, watches, and jewelry.

title: Hilma af Klint's studio
label: Attraction
text: Launched as a meeting point for inspiration, knowledge, and artistic exploration in the spirit of Hilma af Klint. Located in an old rectory—just an island away from where Hilma af Klint had her own studio—this space serves as an introduction to her visionary world. You can stay in one of the buildings if you book through Airbnb. As Hilma af Klint’s Ateljé is run by volunteers, opening hours may vary. Always check their website before planning your visit.

title: Tvättomaten
label: Travel info
text: At Tvättomaten by Odenplan, you can either drop off your laundry or wash it yourself. In addition to regular water washing, they also offer mangling, pressing, dry cleaning – and even rug cleaning.

title: Nymans Ur
label: Shop
text: At Nymans Ur, you’ll find carefully curated watches and jewellery from some of the world’s most exclusive brands. In the service workshop, certified watchmakers repair and maintain timepieces – a tradition upheld since 1851.

title: Bastardo
label: Restaurant
text: The corner of Surbrunnsgatan and Birger Jarlsgatan has a proud restaurant tradition dating back to the 18th century. Today, you’ll find an Italian restaurant here that blends strict tradition with creativity and unexpected combinations.Behind the concept are Jesper Skemark, Daniel Gunneriusson, and Joakim Mering Andersson. For larger groups seeking privacy, a Chambre Séparée is available to book.

title: Bacchanale
label: Restaurant
text: At Ringvägen 110 you’ll find Bacchanale, a restaurant run by the same team behind Främmat in Vasastan. The menu features flavours mainly from Southern European cuisines, using local ingredients. Most of the cooking is done in the large wood-fired oven. During the summer months, the restaurant extends with an outdoor seating area.

title: Celeste
label: Restaurant
text: A young and ambitious restaurant in an interesting location. Celeste is the sister restaurant to Etoile, and here you can choose between a tasting menu in the dining room or drinks on the rooftop terrace—or why not a combination of both? Head Chef Jonas Lagerström is a well-known Swedish chef who has won the TV competition Kockarnas Kamp twice. The restaurant was awarded its first Michelin star in 2024.

title: Beck Kaffebar
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Close to Medborgarplatsen, you’ll find Beck Kaffebar. In addition to organic coffee, they offer a selection of sandwiches, freshly baked treats, and salads. There are also great options for vegans, vegetarians, and those who are gluten intolerant.

title: Baggio Kaffebar
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Baggio is a small Italian coffee bar in Sibirien that draws espresso enthusiasts from near and far. They serve a carefully curated coffee menu, classic pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch pizza. The atmosphere is warm and familiar – just like at the espresso bars in Italy.

title: Café Skeppsholmen
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Café Skeppsholmen offers views of both the Old Town and the Royal Palace. The café is part of the hostel and is open year-round. It serves simple hot dishes, pastries, and drinks. During the summer, there’s also outdoor seating available.

title: Photo Exploring
label: Activity
text: Explore the city with your own personal photography guide and receive expert advice on capturing stunning photos to take home. The guided tours are private and Photo Exploring offers four different tours, each of them three hours long. The professional guide will show you creative ways to photograph the city’s most beautiful sites.

title: Muttley & Jack’s
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: On Södermalm, you’ll find Muttley & Jack’s, a coffee bar offering a wide selection of coffees and beans. Their coffee is roasted at their own roastery out on Vaxholm. In addition to classic pastries, they serve breakfast and lunch, and on weekends, brunch is also available.

title: Larsen / Warner
label: Excursion
text: Larsen / Warner is a gallery for contemporary art. Over the past 30 years, the gallery – in its various forms – has been a space for exhibitions across multiple genres. It presents a dynamic program featuring both emerging and established artists from Scandinavia, as well as international names introduced to a Swedish audience.

title: Pom & Flora Rörstrandsgatan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Pom & Flora runs several cozy neighborhood cafés in Stockholm. One in Södermalm and two in Vasastan. Popular for its breakfast menu, of bowls, porridge, and sandwiches, Pom & Flora is also a good place for a light lunch or afternoon fika.

title: Belenius
label: Sevärdhet
text: Galleriet på Ulrikagatan i Stockholm som grundades 2006 av Niklas Belenius drivs idag tillsammans med Katarina Sjögren. Galleri Belenius visar och representerar både svenska och internationella konstnärer. Galleriet har gjort sig känt för sitt generationsöverskridande perspektiv, där samtida konst ställs i kontrast till modernistiska verk från konsthistorien.

title: Ditte Lauridsen Gallery
label: Excursion
text: Ditte Lauridsen Gallery is located right across from Stockholms Auktionsverk on Nybrogatan, with a large glass front facing the street. The gallery’s focus is Scandinavian art, with a twist of Latin America.

title: SUPKAJAK
label: Activity
text: Right in the heart of Stockholm, on Söder Mälarstrand, you’ll find SUPKAJAK. In addition to paddleboards and kayaks, you can rent a so-called BigSUP, a giant board for up to 10 people! From the rental dock, you can easily choose between different paddling routes: take a shorter trip to the City Hall or around Långholmen and Reimersholme. For those who want a longer paddle, there’s also the option to go around Kungsholmen, a route of about 13 kilometers.

title: Cliff Barnes bränneri
label: Activity
text: Cliff Barnes and its sister restaurant Sue Ellen in Vasastan have launched Cliff Barnes Distillery. You’re invited to a tasting that begins in the distillery, followed by samples and stories about the colorful history of spirits, from medicine to beverage at the restaurant Sue Ellen. The evening ends with time for questions and mingling.

title: Galerie Nordenhake
label: Activity
text: Galerie Nordenhake is an international gallery for contemporary art with a presence in both Europe and Latin America. The gallery was founded in 1976 in Malmö by Claes Nordenhake.Today, Galerie Nordenhake is located in three cities: Berlin, Stockholm, and Mexico City. All three galleries share the same core philosophy, but each maintains its own independent character with distinct programs, forms of presentation, and architecture.

title: Bistro Mirabelle
label: Restaurant
text: In the restaurant-dense Sibirien district, you’ll find the French Bistro Mirabelle. The menu offers simple, rustic dishes without any fuss. There are 30 seats, an open kitchen, emerald-green wainscoting, plain wooden tables, and a chalkboard menu. Every Sunday, a three-course set menu is served.

title: Bar Abrovinsch
label: Restaurant
text: Bar Abrovinsch on Kungsholmen calls for a bit of spontaneity, as there are no reservations or website. You’re welcome whether you’re stopping by for after-work drinks or a full dinner. The menu is divided into three parts: snacks, small plates, and larger dishes. Outdoor seating is available during the summer months.

title: Bröd & Salt Tullhuset
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Bröd & Salt is a chain of artisanal bakeries found in several locations across Stockholm. The bread is freshly baked daily, made with sourdough and lactose-free. In addition to fresh bread, buns, and pastries, there’s also a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps for those looking for lunch.Bröd & Salt Tullhuset also has outdoor seating.

title: Restaurant Essence
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurant Essence, with only ten seats arranged around an open kitchen counter, offers a close connection between the chef and the evening’s guests. Stefan Taylor, a Scottish-born chef, serves a tasting menu prepared right in front of you at the kitchen counter.

title: Craft Island - Fjäderholmarna
label: Activity
text: At Fjäderholmarna, Craft Island offers small, well-curated workshops in silversmithing, blacksmithing, watercolor painting, and seasonal experiences, all led by local artisans.

title: Tours For Fans
label: Activity
text: Tours For Fans offers guided tours to iconic locations connected to idols or phenomena, together with other fans. The tours are led by guides who share both their expertise and personal stories. During the tour, you’ll also meet people who can share exclusive anecdotes about what really happened behind the scenes. One example is tours related to ABBA.

title: Munkbrohamnen
label: Activity
text: Here you'll find a new wooden pier where it's possible to take a dip. The swimming area has an opening in the middle and a basket with a net under the water, which protects swimmers from strong currents. The new swimming spot at Munkbron connects to the popular “kajbalkong” (quay balcony), which has been in place since 2024. Munkbrohamnen and the quay balcony were among the top three finalists for the Stockholm Building of the Year 2025 and have transformed what was once a dull backside into a popular quay with a fantastic view of Riddarfjärden.

title: Söder Mälarstrand - swimming pier
label: Activity
text: The swimming pier at Söder Mälarstrand offers a simple and safe way to take a dip in central Stockholm, with views toward Stockholm City Hall and Riddarholmen. The wooden pier is designed to protect swimmers from currents and passing boats. The site is open year-round, and in winter the water is kept ice-free for cold-water swimming. It connects to the existing quay balcony at Söder Mälarstrand, close to Münchenbryggeriet in Södermalm.

title: Norr Mälarstrand - Kajbad
label: Activity
text: An existing sun deck has now been complemented with a swim ladder and lifesaving equipment to enable safe swimming.

title: Sjövikskajen
label: Activity
text: There are three existing piers here, which are now officially open for swimming. The surrounding water area is marked with buoys to indicate the boundary for boat traffic and alert passing boats that swimmers may be present in the water.

title: Urban Deli Sveavägen
label: Restaurant
text: Urban Deli Sveavägen is just a stone’s throw from Hötorget and includes a hotel, restaurant, deli, bar, rooftop park, café, food studio, and conference facilities. There's always something going on here, from morning to evening, every day of the week, with breakfast, lunch, and dinner served daily. The rooftop park on the 9th floor features a bar and a park area that’s open all year round. In the deli and shop, you’ll find cheese, charcuterie, meat, and seafood, along with homemade bagels and salads.

contact.address: Urban Deli Sveavägen, Sveavägen, Stockholm, Sweden,
contact.label: urbandeli.se/sveavagen

title: Urban Deli Sickla
label: Restaurant
text: At Urban Deli Sickla, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. Sit down in the restaurant or grab something from the deli counter, or pick up a ready-made dinner kit from the store. You’ll also find Urban Deli on Sveavägen, in Hagastaden, and at Nytorget.

title: Urban Deli Hagastaden
label: Restaurant
text: Urban Deli Hagastaden consists of two parts with separate entrances. One is a shop and deli offering bagels & schmear, whole grain croissants, chopped salads, and a variety of soups. The other is a larger restaurant, a mix between a French brasserie and a modern American diner. Lunch is served Monday through Saturday, and à la carte is available Tuesday through Saturday. You’ll also find Urban Deli in Sickla, on Sveavägen, and at Nytorget.

title: Villa Foresta
label: Restaurant
text: On Lidingö, just 10 minutes from Stockholm City, Villa Foresta is perched on a cliff with views over Stockholm and the archipelago. Guests can enjoy the restaurant and the bar. Stockholm’s Villa Foresta offers 103 hotel rooms and 7 meeting rooms.

title: Historical ghost tour - Gamla Stans Guide App
label: Activity
text: Historical ghost tour in Old Town, for curious kids and brave adults, now available in a new app guide. A time-travel adventure into Stockholm’s dark past, filled with gruesome events, haunted locations, facts, and ghosts from history.With an audio guide, video quiz, and an easy-to-use GPS map, you can explore Old Town at your own pace, all year round.The app can be downloaded via the App Store and Google Play. It’s available in both Swedish and English.

title: Brasserie Lou Lou
label: Restaurant
text: In the heart of Stockholm, by the iconic Katarinahissen elevator, lies the French-style Brasserie Lou Lou. Everyday luxury and character define this eatery, with white linen napkins, garlic butter, and glasses of wine that suddenly appear your hands. Cosy art-deco interiors complete the authentic feel of this parisian eatery.

contact.address: Brasserie Lou Lou, Katarinavägen, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
contact.label: brasserieloulou.se

title: Swedish Spy Tours
label: Activity
text: If you are interested in the secret life of spies and agents who have operated in Stockholm, this tour is for you. It offers a unique experience with exciting stories from the Second World War and the Cold War. Different themed tours and walks are available, for example, those focusing on female spies, and mission-based experiences are also part of their offer.

title: Alewalds
label: Shop
text: Here you will find outdoor equipment such as clothing, shoes, and backpacks. Choose from major international brands or local Swedish designers. The store offers a large selection of cross-country skis and touring skates, as well as two outlet stores, one for men and one for women, just a short walk from the main location.

title: Indoor Playground Glädjefyllt
label: Aktivitet
text: An indoor playground for children of preschool age. With bright colors, ball pits, and plenty of toys, there’s something for every little one—and there’s a café for adults. Glädjefyllt also rents out equipment for parties.

title: Skeppsbro Bageri
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Skeppsbro Bageri can be proud of its view and the quality of its goods. Down by the docks in Gamla Stan, the bakery bakes organic bread and buns, milling all its flour in-house for moister loaves. Often among the top when Stockholm’s best baked goods are ranked.

title: Le Bar
label: Bar
text: A French-inspired bar focusing on drinks and champagne. Located 84 meters above sea level, it offers a unique view of Stockholm. Besides drinks, Le Bar offers a bar menu with a French theme.

title: Villa Dahlia
label: Restaurant
text: Hotel with a popular restaurant and rooftop bar. You’re steps from the greenery of Tegnérlunden Park and can enjoy first-class food and drinks. In the courtyard, you can also play boules and table tennis. The rooftop bar is open only in good weather, when it offers panoramic views of Stockholm.

title: Galleri Duerr
label: Aktivitet
text: Galleri Duerr, located in Stockholm's Gallery District, is a contemporary art gallery dedicated to the long-term representation of artists. It features emerging and established Swedish and international artists with a Swedish connection, working in painting, sculpture, installations, and photography. The space also hosts events and conversations in dialogue with the exhibitions.

title: Ristorante Rodolfino
label: Restaurant
text: A restaurant that has stayed true to its Italian heritage since 1972. If you desire Italian classics in a historic environment, this is the restaurant for you. Even the drinks menu leans heavily on Italy, with a wide selection of wines and grappa.

title: VintageMall
label: Shop
text: If you’re looking for vintage clothing with a story, this is the place for you. Many pieces in the shop come from movie sets, and the rest have been handpicked by stylists and costume designers. Men and women alike can find unique new favorites here.

title: Head Spa Nordic
label: Activity
text: Head Spa Nordic offers a new kind of treatment that originates in Japan. It combines traditional head and scalp massage techniques with modern dermatology and hair care. The treatment focuses on stimulating blood circulation in the scalp, relieving tension, and creating a deep sense of relaxation.

title: JumpYard Täby Arninge
label: Activity
text: JumpYard has several indoor trampoline parks in Stockholm: Täby Arninge, Barkarby, Nacka Forum, and Heron City. In Täby Arninge, besides bouncing on the trampolines, you can climb colorful walls, zip along the SkyRider, and tackle the ninja course. Perfect for anyone looking for an active day indoors.

title: JumpYard Barkarby
label: Activity
text: JumpYard has several indoor trampoline parks in Stockholm: Täby Arninge, Barkarby, Nacka Forum, and Heron City. In Barkarby, as in the other parks, you can bounce on the trampolines, challenge yourself on the climbing walls, brave the SkyRider, or tackle the ninja course. Suitable for anyone who enjoys physical activity and is ages three and up.

title: JumpYard Heron City
label: Activity
text: JumpYard has several indoor trampoline parks in Stockholm: Täby Arninge, Barkarby, Nacka Forum, and Heron City. In addition to the trampolines, you can try the climbing walls, complete a ninja course, jump into the foam pits, and play dodgeball. Even if it’s pouring outside, you can enjoy a day full of physical activity.

title: JumpYard Nacka Forum
label: Activity
text: JumpYard has several indoor trampoline parks in Stockholm: Täby Arninge, Barkarby, Nacka Forum, and Heron City. At the Nacka Forum park, you can climb colorful walls, practice your flips in the foam pits, and try the ninja course. Perfect if you’ve got lots of energy and want to burn it off.

title: Cartinavia
label: Activity
text: If you don’t want to walk but still want a private guided tour, Cartinavia could be the perfect alternative. An electric golf cart takes you around Stockholm, and thanks to its compact size it can reach places other tour vehicles can’t. Since it runs on electric power, it’s quieter and more sustainable than many of its competitors.

title: Södertobak
label: Restaurant
text: An old tobacco shop has swapped cigarettes and candy for wine and small dishes. Drop by in the late afternoon or evening for spicy food and something good to drink. One of the owners also roasts his own coffee, which is sold in the restaurant.

title: Sperling & Co
label: Restaurant
text: Sperling & Co brings a modern European grill experience to the heart of Stockholm, led by Michael Andersson, Sweden’s 2024 Chef of the Year. Named after the historic Sperlingens Backe, the restaurant serves premium cuts of meat cooked over open flames, combining global grilling techniques with classic and rare selections. The two-floor space features an open kitchen, a generous bar, and interiors of dark-stained ash wood, leather, and custom-designed details, creating a lively and elegant atmosphere. The wine list highlights selections from Europe and the U.S., making Sperling & Co a destination for visitors seeking both flavor and ambiance.

title: Shibumi
label: Restaurant
text: Shibumi offers a modern take on Japanese izakaya cooking in central Stockholm, led by award-winning chef Sayan Isaksson. First opened in 2015, the restaurant helped introduce the izakaya concept to the city, and the new version brings back a few classics alongside dishes created just for this space. Guests can expect a warm, lively setting with dark wood, a large bar, and rock records from the 70s–90s playing throughout the night.

title: Pizzeria Vanadis
label: Restaurant
text: Pizza place that takes pride in the quality of its ingredients and offers something for everyone. Here you can order classic Italian-style pizza, but also modern Swedish classics like kebab pizza. Hamburgers and pasta dishes are on the menu alongside several plant-based options.

title: Historical Walks
label: Activity
text: Discover Stockholm’s history for free on your phone. Historical Walks is a collaboration between the City Museum and the Medieval Museum, offering free audio guides to historic Stockholm. The English selection is limited but growing, and you can already explore favourites such as the Old Town and the World Heritage Site Skogskyrkogården.

title: Tosto
label: Restaurant
text: Tosto is a new Stockholm restaurant shaped by Italian influences but interpreted in a confident, playful way. The kitchen blends traditional techniques with contemporary ideas, working with in-house charcuterie, slow-aged fish and meat, and fresh pasta made by hand each day. The wine list highlights less familiar grapes alongside global inspiration, while the cocktails lean on ingredients sourced from the kitchen. With seating for 60, a generous bar, and a lively atmosphere, Tosto is designed to feel warm, creative, and welcoming from day to night.

title: Giorgio’s Trattoria
label: Restaurant
text: Giorgio’s Trattoria is opening in Stockholm's upscale Östermalm district, drawing inspiration from 1960s Milan and Florence. The menu blends traditional Italian cooking with modern touches, and the atmosphere is warm and lively – designed to be a welcoming gathering place for anyone who enjoys Italian food and a relaxed sense of style with an interior that nods to mid-century Italy and a bar serving classic cocktails and carefully selected wines.

title: Noema
label: Restaurant
text: Noema is opening on Birger Jarlsgatan with a modern Mediterranean approach that blends classic flavors with contemporary ideas. The kitchen takes a broad and curious approach, creating dishes that feel welcoming while still offering something new to discover. The restaurant features a spacious dining room, a lively bar and, in summer, a large outdoor terrace on the square. Noema aims to be a warm, inclusive destination in central Stockholm for dinner, gatherings with friends or a weekend brunch.

title: Pascal Coffee Roastery
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: At Café Pascal's first coffee roastery in Stockholm, guests can enjoy a cup at the bar while watching the roasting process! The space has a light industrial character and will supply all Pascal cafés with freshly roasted beans. With a focus on thoughtful sourcing and small-batch production, the roastery marks the next step for a family-run brand that began in Stockholm more than a decade ago. It’s a great spot for anyone interested in quality coffee and the craft behind it.

contact_text.text: Café Pascal operates four locations across Stockholm: the original café on Norrtullsgatan in Vasastan, an artisanal bakery and café on Skånegatan in Södermalm, a smaller spot on Sturegatan in Östermalm, and the new roastery and café on Gävlegatan.

title: Krog Agrikultur
label: Restaurant
text: Beneath Stockholm’s Golden Bridge at Slussen, Krog Agrikultur offers a relaxed and welcoming take on Nordic dining. The focus is on high-quality ingredients and well-composed three-course dinners, rather than fine dining formality. The setting comes with stunning views of Gamla Stan and Lake Mälaren, adding to the overall experience. In summer, an outdoor seating area looks out over the water, making it an easygoing spot from day to evening.

title: Il Merlo
label: Bar
text: Il Merlo is a small Italian wine bar and sandwich spot in the Södermalm area of Stockholm, with a particular love for Sicilian wines. The menu centers on grilled Italian sandwiches that change over time, served in a warm and relaxed setting inspired by Italian culture and classic cinema. Il Merlo is designed to feel more like a neighborhood living room than a traditional wine bar.

title: Socker Sucker
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Socker Sucker is an award-winning pastry café in central Stockholm, known for reimagining classic Swedish baked goods with precision and creativity. The pastries balance familiarity with surprise, offering layered flavors and refined textures. Set in a warm, minimalist space, the café serves everything from fresh bread and buns to carefully crafted desserts. It’s a natural stop for anyone curious about Stockholm’s contemporary fika culture.

title: Dramatized History Walks by Historiska Vingslag
label: Activity
text: Come face to face with executioners, plague doctors, and Swedish kings! Historiska Vingslag (Wings of history) offer unforgettable experiences for anyone who dares to join. The city tours are a walking-theater experiences, where visitors learn about Stockholm's history from well-read actors with strong connections to the area.

title: VREX City
label: Activity
text: VREX City is for anyone looking to do something active and fun together. You and your group step into a shared VR experience where you move freely, work as a team, and compete in the same game. No previous experience is needed, it’s easy to get started and just as suitable for friends, families, and colleagues wanting to try something different in Stockholm.

title: Teuf
label: Restaurant
text: Teuf is a lively meat-focused restaurant in Stockholm’s Old Town, built around a simple idea: quality meat, fries, and sauce, done well. The menu keeps choices to a minimum, letting the ingredients and atmosphere do the talking. A dedicated wine bar and a selection of cheese and charcuterie round out the experience.

title: Bistrot Pastis
label: Restaurant
text: Bistro Pastis is a long-standing French bistro in the heart of Stockholm’s Old Town. The menu focuses on traditional French comfort food, seasonal and prepared with care. An attentive team is happy to recommend wines from well-known French regions, making it an easygoing spot for a classic bistro dinner.

title: Presentmakeriet
label: Shop
text: Presentmakeriet is an artist-run gift shop with an inspiring and personal range, where you can often buy the gift directly from the creator. The team behind the shop also arranges recurring courses and workshops for learning arts and crafts.

title: Stora Bageriet Vasastan
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Stora Bageriet at Sankt Eriksplan in Vasastan is a popular café focused on freshly baked goods and a relaxed, neighborhood feel. It’s a natural stop for breakfast visit, coffee or a casual lunch in one of Stockholm’s lively areas.

title: Paraden
label: Restaurant
text: Paraden is a neighborhood restaurant on Östermalm set inside a former 1930s cinema. The multi-level space includes a bar, dining room, balcony seating, and an open kitchen, creating a lively and social feel. The menu focuses on small plates inspired by Southern Europe, local beer, and shareable dishes meant for relaxed, communal dining.

title: Hornsgatan
label: Restaurant
text: Hornsgatan Kvarterskrog & Barservering is a neighborhood restaurant and bar in Stockholm, open from early morning until late in the evening. The menu blends classic cooking, modern comfort food, and simple Southern European influences. A relaxed, welcoming spot suited for everything from casual meals to a drink at the bar.

title: Parma Kök & Bar
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurant, sports bar, and karaoke in Fruängen.

title: Brasserie Hötorget
label: Restaurant
text: Brasserie Hötorget is as an all-day meeting place and restaurant in in central Stockholm. Open from breakfast to late evening, it welcomes both locals and visitors looking for anything from a quick lunch to a full dinner. With its central location and relaxed atmosphere, it feels like a neighborhood living room in the heart of the city.

title: Bockholmen
label: Restaurant
text: Bockholmen is set on a small island in the Royal National City Park, surrounded by water and greenery just north of central Stockholm. Housed in a turn-of-the-century villa by the water, the restaurant serves Scandinavian dishes with Mediterranean touches. In summer, guests gather in the garden and by the dock, while the colder months draw guests into the historic villa for a more intimate setting.

title: Retro Bar Kungsholmen
label: Bar
text: Retro Kungsholmen is a sports bar and restaurant at Fridhemsplan. It attracts both dedicated supporters and groups who mostly want a good atmosphere. Expect sports on the screens and a menu that is just as suitable for AW as for a full night out.

title: The Crib by Retro
label: Bar
text: The Crib by Retro is a sports bar and restaurant in the middle of Sveavägen that aims to be an obvious meeting place regardless of company – from AW with colleagues to dinner or a full evening at the bar.

title: Retro Bar Sveavägen
label: Bar
text: Retro Sveavägen is a sports bar and restaurant in Stockholm, right by Odenplan. It combines American-inspired pub food with TV screens showing football, hockey and other major sporting events. A good choice for both spontaneous AW and when you want to watch the game and eat properly.

title: Bar Lido
label: Bar
text: Bar Lido is the film bar at Bio Skandia in central Stockholm, combining Italian small plates with a carefully selected wine list. Guests can stop by before or after a screening, or simply enjoy a relaxed drink in a cinema setting rich in film history. The bar extends the movie experience while also standing on its own as a social meeting spot in the city center.

title: Slussporten
label: Restaurant
text: Slussporten is set beneath Stockholm’s Golden Bridge at Slussen, overlooking the water and the Old Town skyline. The menu takes its starting point in Swedish cooking while drawing on international influences, shaped by the seasons. With both a restaurant and bar, it offers a lively meeting place at one of the city’s most central waterfront locations.

title: Thriftin’
label: Shop
text: A charming and well-loved vintage and second-hand shop on Rörstrandsgatan in Vasastan. The store features a carefully curated collection of clothing from various eras, blending timeless vintage pieces with trendy, one-of-a-kind finds.

title: Klädverket
label: Shop
text: Klädverket is a modern second hand store with retro influences, offering a carefully selected range of clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories for women, men, and youth, as well as a growing selection of home décor.The store was founded by two friends, Mona Lindskog and Nina Stahl, both with backgrounds in retail. With Klädverket, they aim to inspire a more sustainable lifestyle and build a business that is sustainable in the long term — “a good deal for both you and the planet.”

title: Biblioteket Live
label: Restaurant
text: Biblioteket Live is a restaurant and bar in Medborgarhuset at Medborgarplatsen in Södermalm – a place where you can start with lunch, stay for dinner and end the evening with cocktails and music.It is also an attractive address for events: from small meetings to large corporate events, in premises that combine a historic environment with modern technology.

title: Hagastrand Spa
label: Activity
text: Hagastrand is a spa hotel by Brunnsviken, close to central Stockholm. It combines Nordic bathing traditions with modern spa design in a natural setting. In addition to the spa, Hagastrand also offers food and drinks in its restaurant, which serves seasonal dishes with views of the water.

title: Lundin & Anderssons
label: Shop
text: Lundin & Anderssons is a vintage and second hand store offering carefully selected, well-preserved clothing, primarily from Nordic brands, dating from the early 1900s to the 1980s. The focus is on quality, craftsmanship, history, and sustainable fashion.

title: Chic Konditori
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Chic Konditori is a classic Stockholm café and bakery on Södermalm, known for its wide selection of cakes, pastries, and Swedish fika favorites. Locals stop by for coffee, sandwiches, or a light lunch throughout the day. Sit inside the traditional café setting or grab a table outside and watch the everyday life around Mariatorget.

title: Gunnarsons Specialkonditori
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Gunnarsons Specialkonditori is a classic Stockholm bakery and café in Södermalm, dating back to 1946. Known for its wide selection of cakes, pastries, buns, and seasonal treats like Swedish semlor, the counter is often filled with freshly baked favorites made using traditional methods. A longstanding spot for Swedish fika in the lively Södermalm district.

title: Park Bageri & Konditori
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Park Bageri & Konditori is a classic bakery dating back to 1924 in Bromma, western Stockholm. Bread, buns, and traditional cakes are baked fresh daily, and with breakfast and simple lunch dishes also on the menu, it has long been a natural neighborhood meeting place.

title: Thelins Konditori
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Thelins Konditori is a classic Stockholm bakery and café with roots dating back to the early 1900s. Known for its wide selection of bread, buns, cakes, and traditional pastries, Thelins now has several locations across the city. With everything from Swedish fika to sandwiches and light meals, it has become a popular meeting spot for both locals and visitors.

title: Nordic Brew Lab
label: Shop
text: Nordic Brew Lab has its flagship store in Stockholm at Torsgatan 46. Explore a curated selection of coffee beans, brewing gear, and an experience bar with selected menus, plus recurring workshops and events.

title: AudaTours
label: Activity
text: Discover Stockholm with self-guided audio walking tours.

title: Sessanta – Italian Wine & Dining Bar
label: Restaurant
text: Sessanta is an Italian wine bar and restaurant on Karlavägen in central Stockholm, where Italian flavors are combined with a light Scandinavian touch in a relaxed and lively environment. The menu offers Italian-inspired small dishes, stone-baked sourdough pizza, and homemade pasta, perfect for sharing with wine from different Italian regions. Its location near Östermalmstorg and Stureplan makes the restaurant ideal for dinner, a glass of wine, or after-work drinks.

title: Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm
label: Restaurant
text: Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm at Vasagatan 26 is a vibrant addition to the city center, bringing together a restaurant, bar, live music venue, and Rock Shop® under one roof. With classic favorites on the menu, new drinks, and iconic music memorabilia, the venue offers an energetic experience that is just as suitable for dinner as it is for an evening of music and excitement in the heart of Stockholm.

title: Worn Vintage
label: Shop
text: Worn Vintage offers curated vintage garments and designs in upcycled leather and suede, made from recycled materials from existing production. The collections are produced in limited editions and are created to last season after season.

title: RUFF Golf Drottninggatan STHLM
label: Activity
text: RUFF Drottninggatan is a modern clubhouse in central Stockholm where golf, mini golf, food and drinks meet. The venue offers three TrackMan simulators, an 18-hole mini golf course, social dining with Swedish classics RUFF-style, two bars and a lounge for after-works, events and conferences.

title: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri – Södermalm
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri at Mariatorget, Södermalm, is an artisan bakery known for cakes, bread, and classic pastries with a modern twist. Everything from sourdough bread to buns and handcrafted cakes is baked using Swedish flour and carefully selected ingredients. In addition to Swedish fika, the Stockholm bakery offers custom-made cakes and options for various dietary needs.

title: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri – Kungsholmen
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri is a Stockholm artisan bakery with several locations, known for cakes, bread, and classic pastries with a modern twist. Everything from sourdough bread to buns and handcrafted cakes is baked using Swedish flour and carefully selected ingredients. In addition to Swedish fika, the bakery offers custom-made cakes and options for various dietary needs.

title: House of Q
label: Activity
text: House of Q is a queer-run cultural and social hub in Stockholm’s Hamnkvarter (Värtahamnen), bringing together art, community, food, music, and nightlife – day to night. House of Q’s mission is to highlight and bring queer culture and queer history to life – on its own terms, with the ambition to create a community-first space that feels distinctly different the moment you step inside.

contact.address: House of Q, Malmvägen 1, 115 41 Stockholm, Sweden,
contact.label: houseofq.se

title: Bryggan
label: Activity
text: Bryggan is located right by the water near Djurgårdsbron. Here, you can rent kayaks, canoes, rowboats, and pedal boats if you’d like to explore Djurgården by water. Lunch and dinner are also served here.

title: Tumba Paper Mill Museum
label: Attraction
text: Just outside Stockholm, in a lush and historically rich setting, lies Tumba Paper Mill Museum – a place where the story of Sweden’s money comes to life. Here, at the old paper mill dating back to the 18th century, banknote paper was produced for over 250 years, and traces of both the craftsmanship and the people who lived here remain.At the museum, you can move through authentic environments, learn how paper was transformed from raw material into finished banknotes, and gain insight into what life at the mill was like – where work, family life, and community were closely intertwined. In the workshop, you can even try making paper yourself, just as people have done for thousands of years.Outside the museum, you can enjoy a peaceful walk in the surrounding area or take a break at the Brukscafé, where you can savor a cup of coffee made from beans roasted by the café itself.

title: Kid Sthlm
label: Shop
text: In the middle of Hornsgatan that is lined with a variety of second hand-gems, you’ll find Kid Sthlm. They focus exclusively on children’s clothing and toys offering a wide selection: ranging from modern pieces to vintage finds from various brands, with a mix of styles and prices.

title: Stockholm Boating
label: Excursion
text: Stockholm Boating offers personalized archipelago experiences – guided tours, corporate events, and water taxis – right from the dock. Modern boats cruise to Stockholm’s most beautiful islands, from the classic Sandhamn to hidden gems like Gällnö and Finnhamn. Every tour is tailored to your preferences – from romantic evening cruises to guided day trips.

title: Balue
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Balue is a small and stylish café in Södermalm, focused on high-quality coffee and tea. Here, Scandinavian minimalism meets influences from both Japan and Korea in a calm and understated setting.The café is known for its carefully curated selection of specialty coffee with distinct flavor profiles, as well as matcha and hojicha.

title: Perla Stockholm - Create Your Own Jewelry
label: Activity
text: Perla is a small jewelry café located in Östermalm, where a world of creativity and inspiration unfolds. Here, visitors are given the opportunity to create their own unique jewelry – from sparkling bracelets to elegant necklaces and stylish earrings. The jewelry café is a meeting place for both beginners and enthusiasts who want to bring their ideas to life and explore their artistic side.

title: SKHLM Konsthall
label: Museum
text: In the centre of Skärholmen is SKHLM Art Hall, a hub for contemporary art - where local perspectives engage in dialogue with national and global ones. Through exhibitions, workshops, and talks, the art hall brings forward stories and artists from the surrounding community, with the ambition of making the art world more accessible while also placing Skärholmen on the cultural map.

title: Bibon
label: Restaurant
text: Bibon is a modern European bistro where the energy of New York’s dynamic restaurant scene meets Stockholm’s clean, Scandinavian aesthetic. It creates a vibrant gathering place in Biblioteksstan – perfect for lunch and dinner or a spontaneous drink at the bar.

title: Mr. Bronck
label: Restaurant
text: A New York–style brasserie with a concept-driven menu and an international wine program, located in the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel. Drawing strong inspiration from New York’s vibrant brasserie culture and firmly rooted in Scandinavian ingredients, it offers a setting that blends relaxed comfort with lively metropolitan energy, flowing seamlessly from lunch into late evenings.

title: Deglabbet
label: Restaurant
text: Deglabbet aims to create a relaxed meeting place centered around food, drinks, and social connection. Guests can gather over a glass of wine or a beer and enjoy pizza in a calm and welcoming atmosphere. The concept places a clear emphasis on the craft behind the pizza, with particular focus on the dough.Deglabbet can be found in several locations across Stockholm, including Södermalm, Kungsholmen, Östermalm, and Vasastan.

title: SpigaMadre
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Spigamadre is an Italian bakery in southern Stockholm. The bakery specializes in sourdough bread, focaccia, and pastries inspired by Italian tradition, along with a selection of Swedish classics.

title: ReRobe
label: Butik
text: ReRobe is a second-hand store focused on contemporary fashion from established Scandinavian and international brands. The selection consists of carefully curated garments in good condition, with an emphasis on quality and longevity. The company operates two stores in Stockholm: one in Vasastan and one in the MOOD shopping mall.

title: Bar Othilia
label: Bar
text: Bar Othilia is Operakällaren’s bar in central Stockholm, located adjacent to the historic restaurant setting at Karl XII’s Square. The focus is on cocktails and an extensive wine selection connected to the Nobis wine cellar. The concept moves between classical elegance and a more contemporary bar profile, where selection, pace, and spatial atmosphere interact. As part of Operakällaren, the bar offers a more informal setting while maintaining a clear connection to the establishment’s traditions.

title: The Node
label: Co-working space
text: The Node is a modern music venue at Sergels torg where you can enjoy live concerts, discover new artists or create music yourself. With studios for recording and rehearsals, stages for performances and events ranging from lunch gigs to evening shows, it’s a creative hub in the heart of the city – for both visitors and musicians.

title: Bio Kaskad
label: Activity
text: Bio Kaskad in Blackeberg is a charming neighbourhood cinema with roots in the 1950s, where retro flair meets a vibrant cultural offering. Here you’ll find everything from current releases to independent films, often complemented by themed screenings, performing arts and local events. The foyer features a cosy café and bistro in a 1950s style.

title: Brasserie Astrid
label: Restaurant
text: Brasserie Astrid is a new concept  at Slussen in Södermalm by restaurateur Napolyon Sürer, described as a modern brasserie moving in rhythm with the city, from lunch to late evening. Set across three levels with views over the water, it brings together classic brasserie dishes and international influences in a lively, social setting.

title: Climbing on Stockholms granite cliffs
label: Aktivitet
text: Stockholm is known for its waterfront views and green spaces, but just beyond the city centre you’ll also find granite cliffs and scenic outdoor climbing areas. Join a certified local instructor for a half-day climbing experience with fika and guidance tailored to your level. It’s a different way to experience Stockholm’s natural surroundings all within easy reach of the city.

title: Rentboat
label: Activity
text: Rentboat offers boat trips starting from the Essingen Islands in Stockholm. Behind the business are three captains who have been sailing since childhood. Their boats Silvia, Evelyn and Paula are suitable for groups of up to 12 people. While there is no catering on board, guests can bring their own food and drinks.

title: Hemma Vasastan
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurant Hemma is a warm and inviting neighborhood bistro in the heart of Stockholm. Inspired by the flavors of Southern Europe, the cuisine combines Swedish favorites with Southern European classics, prepared with carefully selected ingredients. The restaurant has a smaller dining room with a bar and a larger dining room a few steps up.

title: Restaurang Liv
label: Restaurant
text: Restaurang Liv is located at Mälarterrassen in Slussen, with wide views over Vattentorget and Stockholm’s Old Town. The restaurant, by chefs Tommy Myllymäki and Pi Le, combines ambitious, high-quality cooking with a warm and approachable atmosphere, designed for everything from lunch to longer dinners.

title: Flattered
label: Butik
text: Flattered is a Swedish brand designing timeless shoes, bags, and accessories with a focus on craftsmanship and sustainability since 2013. Here, you’ll discover ballet flats, loafers, and bags, all crafted in family-owned factories across Europe. Behind the brand are Hanna Kwiatkowska Tisner and Gustav Lidén.

title: ERA Second Hand PK-huset
label: Shop
text: ERA Second Hand is a Stockholm-based store offering a curated selection of second-hand clothing, accessories, and shoes. The range focuses on quality, strong trend awareness, and personal style, with a mix of second-hand and vintage finds. Visitors can shop more sustainably and discover unique pieces not found in regular retail chains. The store caters to those interested in circular fashion and conscious consumption, and has two locations in Stockholm.

title: ERA Second Hand Sergelgatan
label: Shop
text: ERA Second Hand is a Stockholm-based store offering a curated selection of second-hand clothing, accessories, and shoes. The range focuses on quality, strong trend awareness, and personal style, with a mix of second-hand and vintage finds. Visitors can shop more sustainably and discover unique pieces not found in regular retail chains. The store caters to those interested in circular fashion and conscious consumption, and has two locations in Stockholm.

title: Bollos Bakery
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Bollos Bakery is a small bakery and baking studio on Vikingagatan in Vasastan. Here, you can find croissants, maritozzo, macarons, focaccia and cakes – and most of it is vegan or vegetarian! The bakery also offers baking courses and workshops.

title: Amalia
label: Restaurant
text: A stone's throw from Hötorget you'll find this relaxed little bistro and wine bar. Here, small and medium-sized dishes with seasonal ingredients are served, featuring flavors from several cuisines: the menu has included pike-perch crudo, cavatelli, and lamb pie for two.The wine list includes many European producers and a wide selection of wines (including orange ones) as well as sparkling wines.

title: Napolyon
label: Restaurant
text: Napoleon is a charming bistro in the heart of Östermalm, offering a European-inspired menu with daily fresh fish dishes. The restaurant also features a carefully curated wine selection, and its warm, attentive service has made it a favorite among Stockholmers—especially for its lively bar and the intimate chambre séparée, which seats up to 30 guests.

title: Volta
label: Restaurant
text: On a quiet side street in Södermalm, you’ll find Volta – a small, laid-back speakeasy with late-night energy. Here, an ambitious natural wine list is served, and though the bar is new to Stockholm’s scene, it has quickly become a favorite among many. A place for evenings that linger.

title: At Six
label: Bar
text: Housed in a brutalist former bank building at Brunkebergstorg, At Six is a design hotel that also serves as a destination for food, drinks, art and city life. Contemporary art and striking architecture provide the backdrop to a vibrant collection of restaurants and bars, including Dining Room, the wine bar Blanche & Hierta, Cocktail Bar and the popular rooftop venue SUS (Stockholm Under Stjärnorna), overlooking central Stockholm. The hotel also features extensive event spaces at Social and a gym for training and recovery. A lively blend of design, culture and gastronomy in the heart of the city.

title: Leo Boat Tours
label: Activity
text: LeoBoatTours offers private boat tours in the Stockholm archipelago for families and smaller groups, with room for up to seven passengers. Tours depart from central Stockholm – for example Strandvägen or Slussen – and range from scenic cruising to island visits or guided historical tours.

title: Lilla Sauna
label: Activity
text: At Lilla Sauna you can book a private small wood-fired sauna with a crackling fire and panoramic views over Riddarfjärden on Södermalm. The saunas are located close to nature and water, with the possibility of a cold bath directly from the bathing jetty. Lilla Sauna also has saunas in Vaxholm, Täby and Åkersberga.

title: Ersta Minigolf
label: Activity
text: Ersta Minigolf is a cozy 18-hole felt course located in Lilla Blecktornsparken on Södermalm, offering bangolf in a nostalgic setting since 1954. Here, you can enjoy coffee, drinks, sausages, pastries, and ice cream at an outdoor café under a roof – perfect for a break between games. The course, the only competition-approved felt course within the city limits, is situated near Medborgarplatsen and is a favorite among many Södermalm residents. NOTE: Only open May through August.

title: Malmö Chokladfabrik
label: Shop
text: Malmö Chokladfabrik is a cozy little shop on Grev Turegatan, near Sturegallerian and Östermalms saluhall. Here you’ll find award-winning organic chocolate—free from nuts, gluten, soy, and palm oil—as well as pralines, gift boxes, and chocolate tastings. All chocolate is produced in their own chocolate factory.

title: Confidencen
label: Attraction
text: Confidencen at Ulriksdal Palace Theatre is Sweden’s oldest preserved and active Rococo theatre, dating back to 1753. During the 18th century, it was a hub for prominent musicians and artists, and its stage was graced by figures such as Carl Michael Bellman, artists from across Europe, and kings like Gustav III. After nearly 200 years of decay, the theatre was saved and revived by the opera singer Kjerstin Dellert.Today, Confidencen is a unique cultural-historical venue and a vibrant stage for everything from hip-hop to opera, dance, contemporary circus, concerts, theatre, and educational programs for children and schools.

title: Nynäs Boat
label: Activity
text: Nynäs Boat is a boat rental service located in the heart of Nynäshamn Harbour. Rent one of four identical Terhi 450C boats, each equipped with a 40 hp outboard engine – perfect for up to five adults. No boating licence or previous experience is required, and the staff are happy to provide instructions and local tips before you set off. From Nynäshamn, you can quickly reach smooth granite cliffs, sandy beaches, and popular island destinations such as Nåttarö, Ålö and Utö.

title: Mon Village Caîo
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Mon Village Caîo is a family-friendly café in the Vasastan district, offering a welcoming space for both adults and children. The café serves breakfast, brunch, lunch, coffee and pastries, and features a dedicated play area as well as spaces designed with families in mind.In addition to its café offering, Mon Village Caîo hosts workshops, networking events and activities for parents and children, making it much more than a traditional café.

title: Herr Berg
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Herr Berg Gelato is a cozy little gelateria in Annedal, Bromma, serving daily fresh, handmade gelato and sorbet – crafted from the finest natural ingredients. With 14 flavors available every day, each one is carefully made from scratch. They also offer waffles and coffee.

title: Saunify Skåvsjöholm
label: Activity
text: Self-service sauna by Trälhavet, just outside Åkersberga where Stockholm's inner archipelago begins. Book a spot in a shared session or reserve the entire sauna for your group. You'll receive a door code by email, and the sauna will be warm and ready when you arrive, all year round. This is an archipelago sauna that's easy to visit even on a weekday evening – around 25 minutes by car from central Stockholm, with no boat required.

title: Saunify Kaggeholm
label: Activity
text: Lakeside sauna on the shore below the park at Kaggeholm Manor on Ekerö. The glass front overlooks Lake Mälaren, and the swimming jetty for a refreshing dip is just a few steps from the door. Book a spot in a shared session or reserve the entire sauna for your group. You'll receive a door code, and the sauna will be warm and ready when you arrive. Especially atmospheric on a cold evening, when the park is quiet and mist rises from the lake.

title: Saunify Riddersvik
label: Activity
text: Sauna by Lake Mälaren below Riddersvik Manor in Hässelby, just a one-minute walk through the woods to the jetty. Book a spot in a shared session or reserve the entire sauna for your group. You'll receive a door code by email, and the sauna will be warm and ready when you arrive. Open year-round from 6 am to 11 pm, it's equally suited to an early morning swim before work or a relaxing evening sauna by the water.

title: Andetag
label: Activity
text: Andetag (Swedish: breath, breathing) is one of Stockholms newest museum – an immersive experience where light, textile and music move in sync with a shared breath. The artworks are woven from optical fibre and glow from within. The light shifts slowly, synchronized to a breathing rhythm that never repeats. Every artwork is connected to a global system that synchronizes the exhibition with works held by collectors in the US, Costa Rica, Portugal and Sweden. All breathing together, in real time.Andetag is created by artists Malin and Gustaf Tadaa.

title: Villa Valentina
label: Restaurant
text: Villa Valentina is a Spanish restaurant at Mälarterrassen in Slussen, overlooking Stockholm’s Old Town. Inspired by Andalusian farmhouses and Mediterranean cooking, the menu centers on seasonal sharing dishes rooted in Spanish flavors. A spacious terrace adds plenty of room for long lunches, dinners, and drinks during the warmer months.

title: Bergstrands Bageri
label: Coffee Shop / Café
text: Bergstrands Bageri is an artisan bakery near Odenplan. Here, Tobbe and Sara Bergstrand bake everything from scratch – from sourdough bread and cardamom buns to Viennese pastries and semla (traditional Swedish cardamom bun).  A favorite among many Vasastan residents.

title: Hallen – Kollektivet Livet
label: Bar
text: Hallen is an indoor bar street in Slussen, open to all ages and types of groups. Here, you can play board games, darts, sing karaoke, rent a party room, or dance in Slottet – all while enjoying sandwiches and drinks.

title: Basto
label: Activity
text: Basto was born from a simple idea: making saunas more accessible. It’s easy to book, easy to use, and hassle-free. They offer saunas in several scenic locations with the option to take a cold plunge outside: at Stora Essingen, Hagaparken, and Gåshaga on Lidingö. When you book a session, the sauna will be warm and ready when you and your group arrive!

title: Ornö Skärgårdshotell
label: Excursion
text: Ornö Skärgårdshotell (Swedish: Archipelago Hotel) is a waterfront hotel on the shores of Brunnsviken on Ornö in Stockholm’s southern archipelago. The hotel offers accommodations in bright double rooms and apartments with private kitchens, as well as food and drinks at Restaurant Sågverket during the summer season. Ornö is one of the largest islands in the archipelago, with varied nature and proximity to the outer archipelago. The hotel is open year-round.

title: Savoj Pizza Södermalm
label: Restaurant
text: Savoj serves Neapolitan pizza with dough culture inspired by Tokyo, Naples, Seoul, and Los Angeles – cold-fermented for 48 hours, baked at 450°C, with produce delivered directly from small family-owned producers in Campania, and gluten-free dough is always available. On Sundays, the brothers serve their kebab pizza a la Alcamo, made with kebab sauce from the legendary Alcamo pizzeria in Jönköping, and on Mondays a soft-serve ice cream buffet is included with your meal.

title: Savoj Pizza Vasastan
label: Restaurant
text: Savoj Pizza's original location, where brothers Jonathan and Andreas Azizsson started baking their Neapolitan-style pizzas in 2021. The venue holds a main dining room, a secluded room two flights up, and a sunny outdoor terrace. For drinks  natural wines and a selection of rarer bottles on the list.

title: Quezzle
label: Activity
text: Located in Vasastan, near Rådmansgatan, Quezzle offers escape room experiences in Stockholm with five themed rooms for 2–7 players. Here, you are locked in a room and have 60 minutes to solve the puzzles and escape!

title: The Mad Hatter
label: Bar
text: At the Mad Hatter you can taste your way through craft beer on twelve taps – both local and imported – alongside self-imported whisky. Hot dogs, chicken wings and American-style sandwiches keep hungry company fed.  With quiz nights and an outdoor terrace in summer, the bar welcomes everyone curious about beer.

title: V Italiano Moderno
label: Restaurang
text: V Italiano Moderno i MOOD Stockholm serverar hantverkspizza, pasta och italienska smårätter mitt i city. Menyn rymmer både klassiska smaker och mer moderna kombinationer, och restaurangen är ett populärt stopp för lunch, middag eller after work.

title: 450 Gradi
label: Restaurang
text: Unna dig en tjockkantad neapolitansk pizza, gjord på italoiensk tippo 00-mjöl, på 450 Gradi. Pizzerian är härligt belägen med utsikt mot Lilla Värtan, och är perfekt avslutning efter en dags utforskande av Lidingö.

title: Adam/Albin
label: Restaurang
text: ADAM/ALBIN är Adam Dahlberg och Albin Wessmans mest ambitiösa restaurangsatsning hittills. På Regeringsgatan, med utsikt över Kungliga slottet, Operan och Riksdagen, serveras en gastronomisk upplevelse där säsongens råvaror, precision och personlig gästfrihet står i centrum. Restaurangen sträcker sig över tre våningar och kombinerar genomtänkt design med en varm och välkomnande atmosfär.

contact_text.text: Adam/Albin fick sin första Michelinstjärna 2022.

title: Agnes
label: Restaurang
text: På den trivsamma och kvalitetsmedvetna bistron Agnes infinner sig snabbt en känsla av gemenskap. Hit kan man gå för en öl i baren, familjemiddag eller helkväll på krogen. Både inredning, meny och vinlista uppmuntrar till flexibilitet vad gäller möjligheter att kombinera smått och stort – ta plats vid ett långbord eller välj ett lugnare alternativ i baren. Menyn spänner över en bred skala; välj bland smårätter som ostron, chark och ost eller njut av en varmrätt som delas på flera.

title: Ai Ramen
label: Restaurang
text: En av Stockholms bästa ramenbarer, Ai Ramen, har sedan 2015 serverat gudomliga nudelsoppor, donburi och saké till Södermalmsbornas förtjusning. På den tiden har restaurangen hunnit bli ett av Söders allra populäraste hak, vare sig det gäller lunchgäster, middagssugna eller AW-sällskap. År 2019 öppnade Ai Ramen en ytterligare restaurang på Gamla Brogatan 27, mitt i centrala Stockholm.

title: AIRA
label: Restaurang
text: I mars 2020 öppnade Tommy Myllymäki och Svenska Brasserier finkrogen AIRA på Biskopsudden på Djurgården. Målet är att ett besök på restaurangen ska vara värt en resa i sig – en tydlig hint för den som kan sin Guide Michelin. Fokus ligger på nordiska råvaror efter säsong, traditionell matlagning och internationell smaksättning. Välj mellan à la carte och avsmakningsmeny, beroende på hur mycket tid och pengar du vill lägga på upplevelsen. I juni 2023 fick AIRA sin andra, välförtjänta stjärna i Guide Michelin.

title: Arc
label: Restaurang
text: Restaurangen och baren Arc, belägen högst upp i Blique by Nobis, har utnämnts till en av världens bästa takbarer av Forbes magazine. Menyn fokuserar på en koreansk Ssäm-meny, och när vädret tillåter bjuder utomhusterrassen på en fantastisk utsikt över Stockholms norra delar. Om du har barn finns också särskild barnpassningsservice utan extra kostnad.

title: Artilleriet
label: Restaurang
text: Innanför den massiva muren som omgärdar Armémuseum hittar du även den här gömda pärlan till restaurang. Artilleriet serverar lunch, middag, spännande cocktails och prisvärd cava. Livejazz på tisdagar och DJ:s på fredagar. Hundar är också välkomna!

title: Asplund
label: Restaurang
text: Asplund har tagit sitt namn från Gunnar Asplund, den legendariske arkitekten som designat det vackra 30-tals hus som restaurangen är belägen i. Menyn blandar smaker från hela världen – Asien, Europa och Amerika – med färska och närodlade råvaror.

title: At Kungsholmen
label: Restaurang
text: Kvarterskrog på Kungsholmen av trion bakom Petit France. Inspirationen är hämtad från brasserier i New York och på fredagar bjuds det på livemusik till middagen. I den lilla saluhallen finns allt från lunchlådor till sötsaker att köpa med sig hem.

title: B.A.R.
label: Restaurang
text: Området Blasieholmen har den senaste tiden fått en renässans, med flera spännande nyetableringar. Senast i raden är B.A.R, den trendiga havsgrillen där du väljer fisk och skaldjur direkt ur akvariet.

title: Babas Burgers Högdalen
label: Restaurang
text: Varför finns det så få bra restauranger med rimliga priser i förorterna? Det är frågan som gänget bakom Babas Burgers and Bites ställde sig, och som fick dem att öppna sin första restaurang i Rågsved. Idag har Babas flyttat till Högdalen, men serverar samma mat som fått burgarentusiaster från hela Stockholm att vallfärda dit.

contact_text.text: Babas har flera restauranger i Stockholm: Nacka, Heron City, Kista, Sundbyberg, Fruängen och Tyresö. Besök deras hemsida för mer info.

title: Babette
label: Restaurang
text: Babette är restaurangen som har lyft in pizzan i finrummet och serverar den till utvalda viner som byts ut på menyn varje dag. Vinet är helt enkelt i fokus på denna pärla som förutom pizza även serverar snacks och à la carte.

title: Bar Agrikultur
label: Restaurang
text: Bar Agrikultur är lillasyster till Agrikultur. I likhet med sin syskonrestaurang fokuserar Bar Agrikultur på organiska och närodlade säsongsråvaror, serverade i en inbjudande och hemtrevlig miljö.

title: Bar Central
label: Restaurang
text: Bar Central är en stimmig centraleuropeisk restaurang, bistro och bar på Södermalm som serverar rustika klassiker som schnitzel, gulasch och apfelstrudel. Hit kommer både stammisar och nyfikna besökare för traditionell husmanskost med rötter i Tyskland, Österrike och Ungern.

title: Barbro
label: Restaurang
text: Populära kvarterskrogen Barbro serverar mellanrätter av asiatisk fusionmat vid Liljeholmsbrofästet i Hornstull. En trappa ner hittar du också baren Under Barbro som med jämna mellanrum huserar filmklubbar, spelningar och mindre evenemang.

title: Barobao
label: Restaurang
text: Taiwanesiska bao – ångkokt bröd som serveras med olika fyllningar är en relativt ny företeelse i Stockholms krogliv. På Söder finns Barobao, en nytänkande, trendig och prisvärd asiat som bjuder på snabbmat med ekologiska förtecken. Tillbehörsmenyn som varieras med årstiderna kompletterar de goda, fluffiga bröden. En urban inredning i avskalad stil i ljust trä förstärker det snabba intrycket men de goda smakerna är värda att lägga tid på. Här är populärt och prisvärt och det går inte att boka bord.

title: Barrels Burgers & Beer
label: Restaurang
text: Kurrande mage efter en dag på Slottet eller Livrustskammaren? Varför inte ta en härlig lunch eller middag på Barrels, bara några kvarter bort? Här hittar du saftiga burgare, både med kött eller vego, och (som namnet antyder) ett grymt urval av öl att skölja ner dem med.

title: Bastard Burgers
label: Restaurang
text: Med inspiration från New Yorks gatumatskultur och 100 procent förnybar energi från norrländska älvar kom konceptet Bastard Burgers till. Världsstäder har fått ge namn åt de olika burgarna, och det finns även en helt vegansk meny. Restaurangen i Vasastan öppnade i februari 2018 och var Bastard Burgers första lokal i Stockholm. Hamburgerkedjan expanderar snabbt och finns numera på ett dussin ställen runtom i Stockholm.

title: Bergamott
label: Restaurang
text: Bergamott är en av Stockholms mest älskade franska bistros. Här får du smaka typiska och enkla rätter från det franska köket, gjorda på dagsfärska råvaror. Vinkällaren är klädsamt inriktad på det bästa som den franska vinkulturen har att erbjuda.

title: Berns Asiatiska
label: Restaurang
text: I välbevarad miljö från 1863 serveras modern mat inspirerad av hela Asien omgiven av förgyllt tak och magnifika kristallkronor. Cocktailmenyn har flera signaturdrinkar och vinlistan är världsomspännande. På helgerna bidrar DJ:s till den livliga stämningen.

title: Bierhaus
label: Bar
text: Ölhall av klassiskt tyskt snitt komplett med träpanel, långbord och tegelväggar. Beställ din favorit av de 18 tyska ölsorter som finns på fat eller få tips från den vänliga personalen. Från köket serveras traditionella tyska rätter som hemgjorda korvar och surkål, till ett bra pris.

title: Bistro & Grill Ruby
label: Restaurang
text: Texas eller Paris? Sida vid sida i Gamla Stan ligger systerkrogarna Bistro Ruby och Grill Ruby med var sin profil på meny och inredning. Välj mellan grillat i sydstatsamerikansk opretentiös stil eller fransk husmanskost ackompanjerat av vita dukar och vin.

title: Bistro Bananas
label: Restaurang
text: Familjeägda och trendiga Bistro Bananas lever i allra högsta grad upp till devisen “något för alla”. Menyn fångar den urbana matkulturen med precision – från fantastiska pizzor till trerätters veganmeny. Här samsas vedugnen med kitschig neon i en opretentiös miljö. På sommaren finns en uteservering som kantar det klassiska strykjärnshuset på Skånegatan.

title: Bitza
label: Restaurang
text: Bitza serverar krispiga italienska pizzor fast med smaker och ingredienser typiska för matlagningen i Palestina, Syrien och Libanon. Tahini, hummus, shawarma, haloum och zataar-kryddblandningen för att nämna några.

title: Blå Porten
label: Restaurang
text: Ett klassiskt slutmål för stockholmare på helgpromenad eller museibesök på Kungliga Djurgården. Vacker gammal lokal och trädgård med bohemisk atmosfär. Frestande bakverk och lunchrätter med touch av medelhav.

title: Bleck
label: Restaurang
text: I Lilla Blecktornsparken gömmer sig en liten pärla där hipster-Söder möter barnfamiljer och par på dejt. Parken gör den lummiga uteserveringen till en härlig oas sommartid. Den som hellre sitter inne väljer med fördel det nya inglasade och lummiga uterummet med braskamin. Menyn består av smårätter att dela på och på helgen serveras även brunch.

title: Boqueria
label: Restaurang
text: Boquerian är Mood-gallerians självklara mötesplats för en lunch, brunch, middag eller kvällsdrink. Den populära spanska restaurangen har tapas och pintxos som fokus men det finns också en meny av spanska rätter som du kan äta på plats eller som take away

title: Brisket & Friends
label: Restaurang
text: Brisket & Friends på en rejäl BBQ-måltid, oavsett väder och tid på året. Grillrestaurangen tar kött på allvar och serverar bringa, fläsksida och ribs, rökta och kryddade enlig Texas-tyradition, med goda sides och kall öl. Du kan antingen besöka ursprungsrestaurangen i Årsta, strax söder om innerstaden, eller i Vasastan.

title: Broms
label: Restaurang
text: Broms på Östermalm är en kombinerad restaurang, café och deli - här kan du äta dagens alla mål. Om du föredrar take-away så finns det mesta på menyn att ta med och missa inte godsakerna från delin och det egna bageriet.

title: Bun Meat Bun Farsta Strand
label: Restaurang
text: Startat av två burgarentusiaster 2012, öppnade Bun Meat Bun sin första restaurang i Stockholmsförorten Farsta. Succén var snart ett faktum och idag kan du även smaka deras enkla men goda hamburgare i centrala på K25 och Central Food Hall i Stockholm City.

title: Calle P
label: Restaurang
text: Calle P ligger vackert beläget i Berzelii Park, precis mellan det anrika nöjespalatset Berns, Chinateatern och Kungliga Dramaten. Ta en middag innan en föreställning eller konsert, eller njut av en härlig uteservering med utsikt över Nybroviken.

title: Campfire
label: Restaurang
text: Under dagtid så är Campfire en perfekt plats för en stärkande frukost mitt i Stockholm. Under kvällen förvandlas dock hotellrestaurangen till en livlig bar med härliga drinkar, mysig atmosfär och en faktisk lägereld där gästerna kan grilla marshmallows.

title: Cirkus Restaurang
label: Restaurang
text: Ute på vackra Djurgården i centrala Stockholm ligger den anrika scenen Cirkus, ett fantastiskt tillhåll för framför allt teater, musikaler och shower. Deras restaurang är en kreativ och lekfull bistro inspirerad av Cirkus glada historia. Här kan man välja mellan mindre rätter, tillbehör och varmrätter med franska, asiatiska och amerikanska influenser. Njut av en kopp kaffe, en drink eller en måltid i den vackra miljön inomhus eller på den soliga uteserveringen.

title: Coco & Carmen
label: Restaurang
text: Gänget bakom Punk Royal vände upp och ner på en av Östermalms äldsta kvarterskrogar när de tog över Coco & Carmen. Lunchen har fortfarande à la carte, medan middagen består av en fast niorättersmeny med tydliga influenser från deras punkigare Södermalmskrogar. Trångt, trendigt och prisvärt trots att summan på slutnotan blir allt annat än låg.

title: Copine
label: Restaurang
text: Krögarduon Jim & Jacobs restaurang Copine är en modern sydeuropeisk krog och cocktailbar på Östermalm. Efter en större uppfräschning har restaurangen fått en ny, social matbar med utsikt in i köket – en avslappnad plats för lunch, middag eller ett senare stopp under kvällen. Menyn kombinerar klassiska förrätter, varmrätter och desserter inspirerade av södra Europa och Medelhavet, och deras populära majsbröd finns lyckligtvis kvar. Här finns även chambre séparée för större sällskap och en vinlista med mycket att upptäcka. Läget på Kommendörsgatan 23 gör det enkelt att ta sig vidare i city.

title: Crispy Pizza Bistro
label: Restaurang
text: Lyxiga finpizzor i Vasastan gjorda på närodlade råvaror och ingredienser. Pizzabotten må vara av klassiskt neapolitanskt snitt, men toppingen är allt annat än. Bulgogi, butternutpumpa, rökt sidfläsk, honung, tryffelolja för att nämna några.

title: Järnet
label: Restaurang
text: Ännu ett tillskott till Gamla stans spännande nya krogar och matbarer. Till Järnet väntas den som vill ta ett glas vin och en aptitretare efter jobbet, avnjuta en enklare middag eller dröja sig kvar med en drink i baren. På menyn står tapas med skandinaviska inslag och viner för vinintresserade.

title: Delikatessen Bistro Bar
label: Restaurang
text: En mysig restaurang med bistrokänsla på Södermalm.
